14110193.name: Enable/Disable Wave Use For Unit
14110193.hint: If wave use is disabled for a unit, the AI will not use that unit in waves.

17616294.name: Wait For Bank
17616294.hint: Waits for the specified bank file to finish reloading.

18377668.name: Unit Is Created
18377668.hint: This event fires when a unit is created.  Use "Created Unit" to refer to the unit created.  Use "Ability That Created Unit" to get the ability that created the unit.  Use "Behavior That Created Unit" to get the behavior that created the unit.

20000000.name: Rescue Unit
20000000.hint: Causes a unit to be rescued, changing ownership and changing or retaining its color.

20830338.name: Unit Acquires Target
20830338.hint: This event fires when a unit acquires a target.  Use "Acquired Target" to get the target that was acquired.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the owner of the unit that acquired a target.  Use "Triggering Unit" to get the unit that acquired a target.

21456699.name: Set Talent Tree Selection Panel Auto Show
21456699.hint: This prevents the  the Talent Tree Selection Panel from automatically showing up at the start of the game

23421792.name: Call Original Tactical AI Think
23421792.hint: SetThink can change a unit type's AI think routine to a trigger action. This action calls the original routine from before it was changed. This lets you override some behavior but still keep most AI intact. Nothing happens if the think data has not been changed.

24872502.name: Map Is Blizzard
24872502.hint: Returns true if the map currently being played is an official Blizzard map.

25747069.name: Set Talent Tree Pause Game When Selection Panel Shown
25747069.hint: This will cause the game to be paused when the Talent Tree Selection Panel is visible.

26888592.name: Set Dialog Size
26888592.hint: Sets the width and height of a dialog.

29445666.name: Create Explosion At Point
29445666.hint: Creates an explosion at the specified point.  This explosion does not cause damage or other gameplay effects.

30000000.name: Pause/Unpause Unit
30000000.hint: Pauses or unpauses the specified unit.

31573276.name: Triggering Victim Unit
31573276.hint: Returns the victim unit of the event.  Used in response to "Unit Gains Experience".

31638492.name: Save Data Table Value (Actor)
31638492.hint: Saves an actor value into a data table.  Data tables allow you to store and recall values using a string identifier.  If you save a data table value using a string identifier that already exists, you will overwrite the old value, even if it is a different data type than the value you are saving.

31733644.name: Mercenary Panel Selection Changed
31733644.hint: This event fires when a player selects the specified MercenaryId on the mercenary panel.

32062490.name: Value From Data Table (Region) - Instance
32062490.hint: Returns a region value from a data table instace.  Data tables allow you to store and recall values using a string identifier.
32062490.category: Data Table > Instance Version > Load Value

33503427.name: Victory Panel Play Mission Again
33503427.hint: This event fires when a player clicks the play again button on the victory panel.

33761368.name: Set Dialog Item Camera
33761368.hint: Sets a Dialog Item's Camera.  Currently supported for types Portrait and Unit Model.

34012595.name: Value From Data Table (Portrait)
34012595.hint: Returns a portrait value from a data table.  Data tables allow you to store and recall values using a string identifier.

34041821.name: Triggering Wave
34041821.hint: Returns the triggering attack wave in response to "Player Sends AI Wave" events.

36030744.name: Send Transmission For Player (deprecated)
36030744.hint: Sends a transmission with sound and an optional portrait actor to the specified players from a source unit or model.  Use "Last Sent Transmission" to refer to this transmission after it has begun.

36426157.name: Queued Unit Type In Training Queue Slot
36426157.hint: Returns the unit type of a unit in a specific training slot.

39051196.name: Load Variable Value Into User Data
39051196.hint: Modifies user data for the given type, instance, and field. User data is defined in the Data module. Only works for fields marked as modifiable.

39426421.name: Set Unit Info Tip
39426421.hint: Sets the info tip for the specified unit without modifying the text or subtip

40828170.name: Unit Can Attack Unit Old
40828170.hint: Returns true if the specified unit is currently able to attack the specified target unit.

41665764.name: Get Path Display Minimum Linear Distance
41665764.hint: Linear distance is "as the crow flies" - it ignores all pathing obstacles.

43342724.name: Purchase Item Is Recently Purchased
43342724.hint: Returns true if the specified purchase item is flagged as recently purchased.

43549439.name: Beacon Is From User
43549439.hint: Was the specified beacon set by a human player or by the computer.

44564204.name: Name Of Campaign Difficulty Level
44564204.hint: Returns the campaign name of the difficulty level.

45802373.name: Value From Data Table (Wave Target)
45802373.hint: Returns a wave target value from a data table.  Data tables allow you to store and recall values using a string identifier.

46091664.name: Set Data Conversation Choice Picked Count
46091664.hint: Sets the picked count for a conversation choice.

48707541.name: Texture Slot Component
48707541.hint: Query a texture and returns which component this texture belongs to.  (Diffuse, Normal, Specular or Emissive)

49540656.name: Charge Regen Full For Unit Behavior
49540656.hint: Returns the full charge regen time for the specified ability charge link.  If Adjustment Only is true, it will only return the "bonus" amount added to (or subtracted from) the full regen time.

50000000.name: Make Unit Invulnerable
50000000.hint: Makes a unit vulnerable or invulnerable.

51260275.name: Actor From Dialog Item
51260275.hint: Returns the actor for the specified dialog item.

56331453.name: Catalog Field Value Modify
56331453.hint: Modifies the value of a field for an entry.  To find the name of a field path, open the data editor and turn on View Raw Data.  For example, if you wanted to set the unit for the first index of a train ability, your field path string would be "InfoArray[0].Unit".

56726146.name: Value From Data Table (Transmission Source) - Instance
56726146.hint: Returns a transmission source value from a data table instace.  Data tables allow you to store and recall values using a string identifier.
56726146.category: Data Table > Instance Version > Load Value

58931983.name: Move Objective to End
58931983.hint: Places the objective at the end of the list, causing it to display below all other existing objectives.  Objectives created later will still be added after this objective.

61475924.name: Status Increment
61475924.hint: Constructs and returns a StatusIncrement actor message.  This message is used to increment an existing status variable, specified by the Status Variable parameter, on an actor.  If the status variable count is raised above 0 a StatusOn message tied to that status variable is sent to the actor, which would respond in a pre-determined fashion to having that status.  Note: This is a relatively advanced actor concept, as it requires an actor be setup to respond to a StatusOn or StatusOff message to have any effect.

62292946.name: Set Camera Data
62292946.hint: The active camera data determines how the camera moves and responds to player input. Camera data can be configured in the Data module.

63148912.name: Sound Portrait Model
63148912.hint: Returns the portrait model, if any, defined for the sound in data.

63385694.name: Set Player Race
63385694.hint: Sets the race of the specified player.

64952742.name: Unit Count In Region Matching Condition
64952742.hint: Returns a count of units that match the specified filters.

65586447.name: Preload Model Animation
65586447.hint: Preloads a model animation.  The file must be explicitly identified (it won't work if you plug in a variable to that parameter).  Preloading will force an asset or data entry to be loaded into memory before the map starts, rather than be loaded on demand as the map runs.

66289439.name: Combat Diff Flag Sort Buildings Priority
66289439.hint: When enabled, allows the combat AI to prioritize the order it will attack buildings in.

66474248.name: For Each Integer
66474248.hint: Executes a For Loop using an integer value. This will run the action set included in the For Loop a number of times determined by the Start, End, and Increment parameters, increasing the integer variable by the Increment parameter each time. For example: If you set up a For Loop to start at 1, end at 10, increment by 1, and made a single "Chat Message" action inside of the For Loop that converted the <Variable> integer parameter into text, it would count from 1 to 10 in the chat message area.

68765003.name: Attach Set Position From
68765003.hint: Constructs and returns an AttachSetPositionFrom message.  Sets the position of a model's attach point (or potentially multiple attach points if you use an attach method) to a location or site op from a specified actor.

69602796.name: Player Property (Real)
69602796.hint: Returns the value of the specified player property as a real.

70036484.name: Set Portrait Channel
70036484.hint: Sets the render-to-texture channel for the specified portrait, which determines where the portrait textures can appear in the game.

70818612.name: Enable Campaign Completed Saves
70818612.hint: If campaign completed saves are enabled, all saves made will be copied into the file specified by the CompletedSaveName field in Campaign Data in GameUI Data for the current campaign

71337636.name: Mission Time Paused
71337636.hint: Returns whether Mission Time is currently paused or not

71596144.name: While
71596144.hint: Executes a While Loop.  If the specified conditions are met, the action set will be run, and the conditions will be checked again.  This will continue until the conditions are not met.  If the conditions are not met the first time they are checked, nothing will happen and they will not be checked again.

71609202.name: Set Research Tier Max Purchases Allowed
71609202.hint: If this number is set higher than 0, when setting the state of one of the Research Items of this tier to Purchased, logic will execute to ensure the rest of the Research Items are set to disabled.

72412092.name: Value From Data Table (Text Tag) - Instance
72412092.category: Data Table > Instance Version > Load Value

77877287.name: Set Path Display Line Tile Length

80021754.name: Set Gravity Of Text Tag
80021754.hint: Sets the acceleration on the Z axis at which a text tag will adjust its velocity.

80410686.name: Set Unit Ping Cursor
80410686.hint: Sets the highlight cursor for the specified unit while in ping targeting mode.

81737707.name: Clamp (Integer)
81737707.hint: Adjust the value to make sure it stays within the provided bounds.

83263181.name: Display Screen Button
83263181.hint: Creates a screen button, with an identifier chosen by the ScreenButtonID parameter, at the specified anchor, with the specified size and offset. The Callback parameter determines what trigger is run when this button is used.

84312307.name: Set Research Category Current Level
84312307.hint: Sets the current level for the specified research category to the specified level.

90629198.name: Pause Tradeshow Game Time Remaining
90629198.hint: Only for use in Blizzard tradeshows.

90684127.name: Add Charge Regen Time For Game (Deprecated)
90684127.hint: Adds to the amount of time it takes to regenerate the specified global charge link.

93669118.name: Save Data Table Value (Region) - Instance
93669118.hint: Saves a region value into a data table instace.  Data tables allow you to store and recall values using a string identifier.  If you save a data table value using a string identifier that already exists, you will overwrite the old value, even if it is a different data type than the value you are saving.
93669118.category: Data Table > Instance Version > Save Value

98959816.name: Objective Priority
98959816.hint: Returns the Priority of an objective.

F7CE0B02.name: Remove Ability
F7CE0B02.hint: Removes an ability from a unit.

A03D3C7F.name: Add Ability
A03D3C7F.hint: Added ability may not be able to be cast without command buttons. You can set a ability to automaticly create command button, by go to the ability's Command+ field, and assigne default button for them. "Use Default Button" and "Create Default Button" flags needs to be check to allow the button to be auto created. The position of the auto-created button can be set in the Button data.

D00F9D6F.name: Unit Uses Ability
D00F9D6F.hint: This event fires when a unit uses an ability.  Use "Triggering Ability" to get the ability that was used.  Use "Triggering Ability Stage" to get the stage the ability was in when the event fired.  Use "Triggering Ability Target Point" to get the target point for the ability.  Use "Triggering Ability Target Unit" to get the target unit for the ability.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the player that used the ability.  Use "Triggering Unit" to get the unit that used the ability.  If the parameter "Include Shared Abilities" is set to true, instead of matching the specific event, it will match any event that has the same ability set id (AbilSetId).

791E7DE3.name: Unit Changes Ability Auto Cast State
791E7DE3.hint: This event fires when a unit changes an ability's auto cast state.  Use "Triggering Ability" to get the ability that was used.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the player that used the ability.  Use "Triggering Unit" to get the unit that used the ability.  If the parameter "Include Shared Abilities" is set to true, instead of matching the specific event, it will match any event that has the same ability set id (AbilSetId).

00000314.name: Triggering Ability
00000314.hint: Returns the triggering ability.  Used in response to "Unit Uses Ability".

00000309.name: Triggering Ability Stage
00000309.hint: Returns the triggering ability stage.  Used in response to "Unit Uses Ability".

00000312.name: Triggering Ability Target Point
00000312.hint: Returns the triggering ability target point.  Used in response to "Unit Uses Ability".

00000313.name: Triggering Ability Target Unit
00000313.hint: Returns the triggering ability targeted unit.  Used in response to "Unit Uses Ability".

102B1CE1.name: Triggering Ability Other Unit
102B1CE1.hint: Returns the "other unit" when an ability is used.  For inventory abilities, this is the item used.  For transports, it's the unit being unloaded.

E7FCABB7.name: Ability From Item or Trigger
E7FCABB7.hint: If the ability was triggered by an item, it returns the items ability.  Otherwise it returns the triggering ability.

11EB5EB1.name: Created Unit
11EB5EB1.hint: Returns the unit that was created.  Used in response to "Unit Is Created".

049B93BD.name: Behavior That Created Unit
049B93BD.hint: Returns the behavior that created the unit.  Used in response to "Unit Is Created".

5FB839EE.name: Ability That Created Unit
5FB839EE.hint: Returns the ability that created the unit.  Used in response to "Unit Is Created".

B5CB5FC8.name: Show/Hide Ability For Unit
B5CB5FC8.hint: Shows or hides the specified ability on the specified unit.

00000154.name: Ability Enabled For Unit
00000154.hint: Returns true if the specified ability is enabled/disabled for the specified unit.

00000384.name: Number Of Abilities On Unit
00000384.hint: Returns the number of abilities on a unit.

00000385.name: Unit Ability
00000385.hint: Returns the ability in the specified unit's ability array at the specified index.

5F3777F3.name: Unit Ability By Class
5F3777F3.hint: Returns the ability of specified class in the specified unit's ability array at the specified index.

F8758140.name: Unit Ability Command State
F8758140.hint: Returns true if a unit's ability command is at a certain state.

00000153.name: Unit Has Ability
00000153.hint: Returns true if a unit has a specified ability.

00000152.name: Enable/Disable Ability For Unit
00000152.hint: Enables or disables an ability on a unit.

CCD3C6A0.name: Add Level To Unit Ability
CCD3C6A0.hint: Adds level(s) to the specified ability on the specified unit.

0D7D74B4.name: Current Level For Unit Ability
0D7D74B4.hint: Returns the current level of the specified ability on the specified unit.

45E6592C.name: Maximum Level For Unit Ability
45E6592C.hint: Returns the maximum level for the specified ability on the specified unit.

E5B89CB1.name: For Each Ability On Unit
E5B89CB1.hint: Runs the contained actions once for each ability on the specified unit.

9B2E2FB2.name: For Each Learnable Ability On Unit
9B2E2FB2.hint: Runs the contained actions once for each learnable ability on the specified unit.

6D48FFE8.name: Reset Unit Learn Ability
6D48FFE8.hint: Reset the specified learn ability on the specified unit.

C12B1578.name: Add Learn Ability Level For Unit
C12B1578.hint: Add learned level(s) the specified learn ability index on the specified unit. Consumes skill points.

B6FCFE39.name: Current Learn Ability Level For Unit
B6FCFE39.hint: Returns the current learned level of the specified learn ability index on the specified unit.

A951B49E.name: Add Skill Points To Unit Learn Ability
A951B49E.hint: Adds point(s) to the specified learn ability on the specified unit.

B01E0F60.name: Learn Ability Skill Point For Unit
B01E0F60.hint: Returns the current point of the specified learn ability on the specified unit.

2F0D3EEE.name: Attach Model To Actor (Deprecated)
2F0D3EEE.hint: Creates a generic actor with the specified model attached to an actor at the specified attach point. Use "Last Created Actor" to get the attached model's actor.

423CB348.name: Last Created Actor Scope (Deprecated)
423CB348.hint: Returns the last actor scope successfully created by the user via cheat, data or script.

AF651D06.name: Last Created Actor (Deprecated)
AF651D06.hint: Returns the last actor successfully created by the user via cheat, data or script.  Includes actors created by the Create message, but only if it is sent via cheat or script.  Does not include AutoCreates, request creates, or Create messages in response to actor events.

3A43F8C8.name: Attach Model To Unit
3A43F8C8.hint: Creates a generic actor with the specified model attached to a unit at the specified attach point. Use "Last Created Actor" to get the actor.

E5916D67.name: Attach Model To Unit (Inherit Visibility)
E5916D67.hint: Creates a generic actor with the specified model attached to a unit at the specified attach point. Use "Last Created Actor" to get the actor.  If the unit is hidden, the attached model will also be hidden.

1B1310D9.name: Attach Model To Actor
1B1310D9.hint: Creates a generic actor with the specified model attached to an actor at the specified attach point. Use "Last Created Actor" to get the attached model's actor.

F0857987.name: Last Created Actor Scope
F0857987.hint: Returns the last actor scope successfully created by the user via cheat, data or script.

A0C127E0.name: Last Created Actor Scope by Message
A0C127E0.hint: Returns the last actor scope successfully created by the user via cheat, data or script.

0F696993.name: Last Created Actor
0F696993.hint: Returns the last actor successfully created by the user via script. Does not include AutoCreates, request creates, or Create messages in response to actor events.

4DA2E9BC.name: Last Created Actor by Message
4DA2E9BC.hint: Returns the last actor successfully created by the user via cheat, data or script.  Includes actors created by the Create message, but only if it is sent via cheat or script.  Does not include AutoCreates, request creates, or Create messages in response to actor events.

57380ECA.name: Attach Actor To Unit
57380ECA.hint: Creates an actor attached to a unit at the specified attach point.  Use "Last Created Actor" to get the actor.

80B0856C.name: Attach Actor To Actor
80B0856C.hint: Creates an actor attached to an actor at the specified attach point.  Use "Last Created Actor" to get the attached actor.

5C695F56.name: Create Actor Scope
5C695F56.hint: Creates an empty actor scope.  You can get the scope that was created by using "Last Created Actor Scope".  An actor scope is a container for a set of actors.  Therefore, this action is only useful if you intend to create actors in the scope you create. Actor Name is an optional name for the actor to create, not the true name of the scope. If the name is "" or "*" it is ignored, otherwise the function will try to create an actor with the specified name to put into the scope.

0165CF77.name: Create Actor
0165CF77.hint: Creates an actor.  The Scope parameter can be null if you do not want to create the actor in an existing scope.  The Name parameter is the string ID of the actor you are creating.  The Content parameters are optional, and allow you to specify additional properties for the actor being created.  Running the "Last Created Actor" function immediately after this action will return the actor created by this action.

46B99CA4.name: Create Actor Region
46B99CA4.hint: Creates a region actor from a game region.  You can use a region actor to send an actor message to all of the actors that are currently inside it.  If you set a variable to "Last Created Actor" after running this action, your variable will be set to the region actor created by this action.

6A72FDF0.name: Create Actor At Point
6A72FDF0.hint: Creates an actor at the specified point.  Running the "Last Created Actor" function immediately after this action will return the actor created by this action.

9E360BAC.name: Create Model At Point
9E360BAC.hint: Creates a generic actor with the specified model at the specified point.  Running the "Last Created Actor" function immediately after this action will return the actor created by this action.

F9E1F767.name: Create Model With Point Facing
F9E1F767.hint: Creates a generic actor with the specified model at the specified point and sets its facing to match the point.  Running the "Last Created Actor" function immediately after this action will return the actor created by this action.

0343B95F.name: Send Actor Message
0343B95F.hint: Sends an actor message to an actor.  An actor message will perform an action and/or trigger an event on the actor it is sent to.

ECF84383.name: Send Actor Message As Text
ECF84383.hint: Sends an actor message to an actor.  An actor message will perform an action and/or trigger an event on the actor it is sent to.

E1552C18.name: Send Actor Message To Unit
E1552C18.hint: Sends an actor message to a unit's actor.  An actor message will perform an action and/or trigger an event on the actor it is sent to.

A51886E9.name: Send Actor Message To Scope
A51886E9.hint: Sends an actor message to all actors in the specified scope.  An actor scope is a container for a set of actors.  An actor message will perform an action and/or trigger an event on the actor it is sent to.

F96FCAE7.name: Send Actor Message To Actor Region
F96FCAE7.hint: Sends an actor message to all the actors contained within the specified region actor.  An actor message will perform an action and/or trigger an event on the actor it is sent to.

2F1BA360.name: Send Actor Message To Actor Region With Filters
2F1BA360.hint: Sends an actor message to all the actors contained within the specified region actor.  The Intersect Type parameter defines which radius will be used to determine intersection with the region.  The Class Filters parameter is used to specify which types of actors should receive the message.  The format for Class Filters is a list of comma delimited actor types.  The Terms parameter is used to specify a condition that an actor in the region must meet in order to receive the message.  The format for Terms is a list of semi colon delimited actor terms.  An actor message will perform an action and/or trigger an event on the actor it is sent to.

7317E443.name: Send Actor Message To Game Region
7317E443.hint: Sends an actor message to all the actors contained within the specified game region.  An actor message will perform an action and/or trigger an event on the actor it is sent to.

0912762F.name: Send Actor Message To Game Region With Filters
0912762F.hint: Sends an actor message to all the actors contained within the specified game region.  The Intersect Type parameter defines which radius will be used to determine intersection with the region.  The Class Filters parameter is used to specify which types of actors should receive the message.  The format for Class Filters is a list of comma delimited actor types.  The Terms parameter is used to specify a condition that an actor in the region must meet in order to receive the message.  The format for Terms is a list of semi colon delimited actor terms.  An actor message will perform an action and/or trigger an event on the actor it is sent to.

C8E8FB03.name: Send Actor Message Via Name
C8E8FB03.hint: Sends an actor message to an actor that is related to another actor.  The Actor parameter is used to specify the primary actor, and the Name parameter is used to specify a reference (such as ::Host) that will derive a secondary actor from the primary actor.  The message gets sent to the secondary actor.  An actor message will perform an action and/or trigger an event on the actor it is sent to.

03EC4BB7.name: Send Actor Message As Text Via Name
03EC4BB7.hint: Sends an actor message to an actor that is related to another actor.  The Actor parameter is used to specify the primary actor, and the Name parameter is used to specify a reference (such as ::Host) that will derive a secondary actor from the primary actor.  The message gets sent to the secondary actor.  An actor message will perform an action and/or trigger an event on the actor it is sent to.

22688BC7.name: Actor Msg 1
22688BC7.hint: Constructs and returns an actor message with a single parameter. The actor message returned is formed by combining the Msg Name and Param 1 string parameters. This function is primarily used by other "Actor" type functions to assemble actor messages, although it can be used to assemble any actor message from scratch with the right know-how.

E79AE4CF.name: Actor Msg 2
E79AE4CF.hint: Constructs and returns an actor message with two parameters. The actor message returned is formed by combining the Msg Name, Param 1, and Param 2 string parameters. This function is primarily used by other "Actor" type functions to assemble actor messages, although it can be used to assemble any actor message from scratch with the right know-how.

7CAF43B4.name: Actor Msg 3
7CAF43B4.hint: Constructs and returns an actor message with three parameters. The actor message returned is formed by combining the Msg Name, Param 1, Param 2, and Param 3 string parameters. This function is primarily used by other "Actor" type functions to assemble actor messages, although it can be used to assemble any actor message from scratch with the right know-how.

4F54AC74.name: Actor Msg 4
4F54AC74.hint: Constructs and returns an actor message with four parameters. The actor message returned is formed by combining the Msg Name, Param 1, Param 2, Param 3 and Param 4 string parameters. This function is primarily used by other "Actor" type functions to assemble actor messages, although it can be used to assemble any actor message from scratch with the right know-how.

667BFCB5.name: Action Damage
667BFCB5.hint: Constructs and returns an ActionDamage actor message. Sends a notification message to the game that damage has happened, so the target can react appropriately.

20C6912A.name: Action Impact
20C6912A.hint: Constructs and returns an ActionImpact actor message. Sends a notification message to the game that an Impact has happened, so the target can react appropriately.

8CE9D5F5.name: Alias Add
8CE9D5F5.hint: Constructs and returns an AliasAdd actor message based on the parameters.  This message can be used to associate the Alias parameter with an actor as an alias.  Actor aliases are additional names that can be used to refer to an actor in other functions and actions.

511FEFCC.name: Alias Remove
511FEFCC.hint: Constructs and returns an AliasRemove actor message based on the parameters.  AliasRemove messages are used to remove existing aliases associated with an actor.  The Alias parameter determines which alias to remove.

91D998DE.name: Anim Baseline Start
91D998DE.hint: Returns an AnimBaselineStart actor message.  This message can be used to tell an actor to begin playing its baseline animations, which include animations such as stand and move.  It will only work on actors with models that have animations.

0B0D7DF0.name: Anim Baseline Stop
0B0D7DF0.hint: Returns an AnimBaselineStop actor message.  This message can be used to tell an actor to stop playing its baseline animations and remain completely still unless specifically told to perform an animation by another actor message.  It will only work on actors with models that have animations.

58A0FCE5.name: Anim Blend Time Apply
58A0FCE5.hint: Constructs and returns an AnimBlendTimeApply actor message based on the parameters.  This message will set the default blend time for animations played by the actor it is sent to.  It will only work on actors with models that have animations.

6DA18A65.name: Anim Blend Time Remove
6DA18A65.hint: Constructs and returns an AnimBlendTimeRemove actor message based on the parameters.  This message will remove any existing animation blend time messages on the actor it is sent to, causing it to revert to the default animation blend time.  It will only work on actors with models that have animations.

BD1A4B1B.name: Anim Bracket Resume
BD1A4B1B.hint: Constructs and returns an AnimBracketResume actor message based on the parameters.  This message will resume a stopped animation bracket being executed by an actor.  It will only work on actors with models that have animations.

A0515E2B.name: Anim Bracket Start
A0515E2B.hint: Constructs and returns an AnimBracketStart actor message based on the parameters.  This message tells an actor to begin an anim bracket with the specified parameters.  An anim bracket is refered to by its name, determined by the name parameter, and consists of three animations defined as Opening Props, Content Props, and Closing Props.  The Opening Props parameter determines which animation the actor will play at the beginning of the anim bracket.  The Content Props parameter determines the intermediate animation.  If Content Props is set to an animation that loops it will play until the anim bracket is ended, otherwise it will only play once.  The Closing Props parameter determines which animation is played when the anim bracket ends.  It will only work on actors with models that have animations.

FA920336.name: Anim Bracket Stop
FA920336.hint: Constructs and returns an AnimBracketStop actor message based on the parameters.  This message will stop an anim bracket with the same name as the Anim Name parameter being played by an actor, causing it to play its closing animation and return to normal behavior.  It will only work on actors with models that have animations.

9E701E85.name: Anim Clear
9E701E85.hint: Constructs and returns an AnimClear actor message.  This message will clear an animation sequence with the same name as the Anim Name parameter being played by an actor.  It will only work on actors with models that have animations.

F9CD403E.name: Anim Clear All But
F9CD403E.hint: Constructs and returns an AnimClearAllBut actor message.  This message will clear all animation sequences except that with the same name as the Anim Name parameter being played by an actor.  It will only work on actors with models that have animations.

9D857F1C.name: Anim Dump DB
9D857F1C.hint: Debug tool.  Outputs all animations on a specified model.

BB55CA40.name: Anim Group Apply
BB55CA40.hint: Constructs and returns an AnimGroupApply actor message based on the parameters.  The AnimGroupApply message is used to apply an extra animation group such as Burrow or Flying onto the normal animations such as Walk or Stand.

ED6A6613.name: Anim Group Remove
ED6A6613.hint: Constructs and returns an AnimGroupRemove actor message based on the parameters.  The AnimGroupRemove message is used to remove an extra animation group such as Burrow or Flying that has been apllied onto normal animations such as Walk or Stand.

AEC5207F.name: Anim Group Remove All
AEC5207F.hint: Constructs and returns an AnimGroupRemoveAll actor message based on the parameters.  The AnimGroupRemoveAll message is used to remove all extra animation groups such as Burrow or Flying from an Actor model.

6EB4CCC9.name: Anim Play
6EB4CCC9.hint: Constructs and returns an AnimPlay message.  This message will play an animation for the model based on the parameters given.  It will only work on actors with models that have animations.

65F2B34D.name: Anim Play Sequence
65F2B34D.hint: Constructs and returns an AnimPlaySequence message.  This message will create an animation sequence based on the animations listed in the Sequence list, and assign it an animation name.  It will only work on actors with models that have animations.

FB6A1C18.name: Anim Set Completion
FB6A1C18.hint: Constructs and returns an AnimSetCompletion actor message.  This message will set the animation to be a percentage complete.  It will only work on actors with models that have animations.

6E7FC0EB.name: Anim Set Duration
6E7FC0EB.hint: Constructs and returns an AnimSetDuration actor message.  This message will set the duration in seconds it takes to play the animation.  It will only work on actors with models that have animations.

44B7EA9B.name: Anim Set Paused
44B7EA9B.hint: Constructs and returns an AnimPlayPaused message.  This is used to pause or unpause all animations for a model.  It will only work on actors with models that have animations.

0237F8A4.name: Anim Set Time
0237F8A4.hint: Constructs and returns an AnimSetTime actor message.  This message will set the animation to be a set time through completion.  It will only work on actors with models that have animations.

B1F81BE5.name: Anim Set Time Scale
B1F81BE5.hint: Constructs and returns an AnimSetTimeScale actor message.  This message will set the time scale of the animation.  It will only work on actors with models that have animations.

95693EFD.name: Anim Set Time Scale Global
95693EFD.hint: Constructs and returns a AnimSetTimeScaleGlobal actor message.  This message alters the games global animation speed scale.

C358BFC4.name: Attach Set Bearings
C358BFC4.hint: Constructs and returns an AttachSetBearings message.  Sets the bearings of a model's attach point (or potentially multiple attach points if you use an attach method) to the specified world coordinates and rotation.

E59EA897.name: Attach Set Bearings From
E59EA897.hint: Constructs and returns an AttachSetBearingsFrom message.  Sets the bearings of a model's attach point (or potentially multiple attach points if you use an attach method) to a location or site op from a specified Actor.

6C5ACBFE.name: Attach Set Position
6C5ACBFE.hint: Constructs and returns an AttachSetPosition message.  Sets the position of a model's attach point (or potentially multiple attach points if you use an attach method) to the specified world coordinates.

1B030597.name: Attach Set Rotation
1B030597.hint: Constructs and returns an AttachSetRotation message.  Sets the rotation of a model's attach point (or potentially multiple attach points if you use an attach method) to the specified rotation.

B2D07F84.name: Attach Set Rotation From
B2D07F84.hint: Constructs and returns an AttachSetRotationFrom message.  Sets the rotation of a model's attach point (or potentially multiple attach points if you use an attach method) to a location or site op from a specified actor.

FF9A25CE.name: Create
FF9A25CE.hint: Constructs and returns a Create actor message.  This message will create an actor.  Content parameter is optional.  Works on all actor types.

0EA028E2.name: Create Copy
0EA028E2.hint: Constructs and returns a CreateCopy actor message. This message will create an actor copy of another actor.

70AEFF69.name: Death Customize
70AEFF69.hint: Constructs and returns a DeathCustomize actor message.  Used for alternate death sequences depending on different conditions.  Example: burrowed/unburrowed

543901A7.name: Destroy
543901A7.hint: Constructs and returns a Destroy actor message.  This message destroys the actor it is sent to, removing it from the game entirely.

A7079E20.name: HostSiteOpsSet
A7079E20.hint: Constructs and returns a HostSiteOpsSet actor message.  This is used to change the site ops for an actor.  The Host Name parameter is used to indicate which host you want to modify the site ops for.  Typically, this will just be ::Host, but could refer to other host references as well.

6CBE8D94.name: List Add
6CBE8D94.hint: Constructs and returns a ListAdd actor message.  This can only be sent to an actor list.  Adds the referenced actor to the actor list.  The purpose of a list is so all actors in the list could have the same actions applied (example: tree doodads in an area all catch fire).

1B47B527.name: List Remove
1B47B527.hint: Constructs and returns a ListRemove actor message.  This can only be sent to an actor list.  Removes the referenced actor from the actor list.

D9339BB5.name: Missile Tentacle Return
D9339BB5.hint: Constructs and returns a MissileTentacleReturn actor message.  This message causes an actor to return to its origin point immediately.  It will only work on missile actors that are flagged as tentacles.

ED17978F.name: Model Event Suppress
ED17978F.hint: Constructs and returns a ModelEventSuppress message.  Suppress a class of model events.  This allows you to toggle whether a specific model event affects an actor.

C1374D79.name: Model Swap
C1374D79.hint: Constructs and returns a ModelSwap actor message.  This message will swap the current model of an actor with an model to the specified Model and Variation number.

07AE20F9.name: Mover Set Acceleration
07AE20F9.hint: Constructs and returns a MoverSetAcceleration actor message.  This will set the acceleration velocity of the mover.  It will only work on a mover site actor.

35657B65.name: Mover Set Deceleration
35657B65.hint: Constructs and returns a MoverSetDeceleration actor message.  This will set the deceleration velocity of the mover.  It will only work on a mover site actor.

5B8AEB0F.name: Mover Set Destination 2D
5B8AEB0F.hint: Constructs and returns a SetMoverDestination2D actor message.  This message alters an actor's 2D map grid destination based on the X,Y parameters.  It will only work on a mover site actor.

A96A3C0D.name: Mover Set Destination From
A96A3C0D.hint: Constructs and returns a SetMoverDestinationFrom actor message.  This message alters an actor's 2D map grid destination relative to the actor referenced.  It will only work on a mover site actor.

B0951308.name: Mover Set Destination H
B0951308.hint: Constructs and returns a SetMoverDestinationH actor message.  This message alters an actor's relative height based on the ground level and the parameter set.  It will only work on a mover site actor.

24BDA990.name: Mover Set Destination Z
24BDA990.hint: Constructs and returns a MoverSetDestinationZ actor message.  This message set an actor's absolute height based on the parameter set.  It will only work on a mover site actor.

0CA0580A.name: Mover Set Speed
0CA0580A.hint: Constructs and returns a MoverSetSpeed actor message.  This will set the movers current speed.  It will only work on a mover site actor.

D348380E.name: Mover Set Speed Max
D348380E.hint: Constructs and returns a MoverSetSpeedMax actor message.  This will set the movers maximum speed.  It will only work on a mover site actor.

4DA2F9A8.name: Mover Set Speed From Duration
4DA2F9A8.hint: Constructs and returns a MoverSetSpeedFromDuration actor message.  This will set the movers speed based on a duration of time.  A shorter time will cause it to move faster.  It will only work on a mover site actor.

B78EB09C.name: Mover Move
B78EB09C.hint: Constructs and returns a MoverMove actor message.  Starts the actor in motion according to the conditions that have been given to the mover.  It will only work on a mover site actor.

FF497CED.name: Mover Stop
FF497CED.hint: Constructs and returns a MoverStop actor message.  Tells the mover to stop, it will decelerate based on its current deceleration value before coming to a complete halt.  It will only work on a mover site actor.

BED7C7FE.name: Mover Stop Now
BED7C7FE.hint: Constructs and returns a MoverStopNow actor message.  Stops the mover directly and immediately regardless of deceleration or speed.  It will only work on a mover site actor.

FB726C91.name: Multiply Scale
FB726C91.hint: Constructs and returns a MultiplyScale actor message.  This will multiply the current scale of the actor by the multipliers specified over the duration specified.  Will only work on actors with a model.

3C273629.name: Print
3C273629.hint: Constructs and returns a Print actor message.  This message will display the String parameter in the debug log.  It is a useful debugging tool for ensuring that an actor is behaving as desired, as oftentimes actors are behind the scenes.

06FA2BA0.name: Query Persistent
06FA2BA0.hint: Constructs and returns a QueryPersistent actor message.  This message will instruct a region actor to send a message to other actors when they enter or leave that region actor.  The Enter Response Actor parameter determines what message will be sent to actors entering the region actor, and the Leave Response Actor determines the actor message sent to actors exiting the region actor.  This message only works on region actors.

B26FF700.name: Query Radius
B26FF700.hint: Constructs and returns a QueryRadius actor message.  This message will search a radius equal to the Radius parameter around an actor, and send an actor message determined by the Response Actor parameter to any actors it finds in that radius.

8782BEB2.name: Query Region
8782BEB2.hint: Constructs and returns a QueryRegion actor message.  This message searches a region actor determined by the Region Actor parameter and sends a message determined by the Response Actor parameter to any actors found inside of the region actor.

A804684B.name: Ref Clear
A804684B.hint: Constructs and returns a RefClear actor message.  The Actor Ref name parameter determines the actor ref to clear.  This will remove the actor associated with that reference, but leave the reference for future use.  An actor ref can have any type of actor assigned to it.

20C84C20.name: Ref Create
20C84C20.hint: Constructs and returns a RefCreate actor message.  This message creates an actor reference that client code and data can use to store references to other living actors.  The Actor Ref Name parameter determines the name of the actor reference, which is used to call it through other actor messages.

31123B1B.name: Ref Destroy
31123B1B.hint: Constructs and returns a RefDestroy actor message based on the parameters.  This message destroys an existing actor reference with a name equal to the Actor Ref Name parameter.  Once it is destroyed it will no loner be accessible.

AFF0AFBF.name: Ref Dump
AFF0AFBF.hint: Constructs and returns a RefDump actor message based on the parameters.  This message will display the contents of an actor reference, chosen through the Actor Ref Name parameter, to the debug log.  This is a useful debugging tool as it allows you to see what is being stored inside of the selected actor reference.

EC390E46.name: Ref Notify
EC390E46.hint: Constructs and returns a RefNotify actor message based on the parameters.  Typically used with a target, this message allows one actor to send a ref to another actor.  The signal parameter allows you to differentiate RefNotify messages if multiple messages are used in the same context.

AD353D8C.name: Ref Set
AD353D8C.hint: Constructs and returns a RefSet actor message based on the parameters.  This message will store an actor determined by the Ref Source parameter, into an existing actor reference determined by the Actor Ref Name parameter.  Note: This will only set a value in an actor reference that already exists, it will not create a new reference.

AFECF7B1.name: Ref Set From Msg
AFECF7B1.hint: Constructs and returns a RefSetFromMsg actor message based on the parameters.  This message will store an actor determined by the Message parameter, into an existing actor reference determined by the Actor Ref Name parameter.  Note: This will only set a value in an actor reference that already exists, it will not create a new reference.

E672DFB5.name: Ref Set From Actor
E672DFB5.hint: Constructs and returns a RefSetFromActor actor message based on the parameters.  This message will set an actor relative to another actor.  For example, "RefSetFromActor ::global.test ::Creator ::Host" would set the ::global.test ref to the host of the actor that created the actor from which this message is being sent.  Note: This will only set a value in an actor reference that already exists, it will not create a new reference.

EC829255.name: Ref Set From Request
EC829255.hint: Constructs and returns a RefSetFromRequest actor message based on the parameters.  This message uses an actor request to determine what actor should be stored in the reference.  The Ref Name parameter is the reference to store the actor in once it is found.  Note: Utilizing this function requires a strong knowledge of the actor system.

E425C4B1.name: Ref Set Refresh Name
E425C4B1.hint: Constructs and returns a RefSetRefreshName actor message based on the parameters.  This can be used to update a ref which doesnt update automatically in the actor system, although most should update automatically.  Actor should automatically refresh references in special cases (for instance, you have a squib hosted off a hydralisk which turns into an egg.  Actor needs to update the host of the squib to host off an analogous attach point on the egg), but this is there just in case it's needed at some point.  Note: This will only set a value in an actor reference that already exists, it will not create a new reference.

4F763EBD.name: Ref Table Dump
4F763EBD.hint: Constructs and returns a RefTableDump actor message based on the parameters.  This message dumps an entire actor reference table.  The Space parameter determines which ref table will be dumped: 1 will dump the global ref table, 2 will dump the scope ref table, and 3 will dump the actor ref table.  When a table is dumped, all existing actor references in that table's category will be printed to the debug log.

AAA4F3A3.name: Set Bearings
AAA4F3A3.hint: Constructs and returns a SetBearings actor message based on the parameters.  This message will set the 3D position and 3D rotation of an actor.  The Position X, Y, and Z parameters correspond to the 3D map grid location.  The Forward X,Y,Z parameters and the Up X,Y,Z parameters correspond to the 3D rotation of the actor.  It will only work on actors that have bearings, such as model actors or doodad actors.

37F6CF56.name: Set Bearings From
37F6CF56.hint: Constructs and returns a SetBearingsFrom actor message based on the parameters.  This message will set the 3D position and 3D rotation of an actor to the same 3D position and 3D rotation of another actor chosen with the Actor parameter.  It will only work on actors that have bearings, such as model actors or doodad actors.

6967D3E5.name: Set Bearings H
6967D3E5.hint: Constructs and returns a SetBearingsH actor message based on the parameters.  This message operates similarly to a SetBearings message but rather than specifying an absolute Z value you specify a Height value, which is relative to the game terrain level.  It will only work on actors that have bearings, such as model actors or doodad actors.

EEB3ECF8.name: Set Facing
EEB3ECF8.hint: Constructs and returns a SetFacing actor message based on the parameters.  This message will set the 2D facing of an actor according to the Facing parameter.  It will only work on actors that have bearings, such as model actors or doodad actors.

DD557FEC.name: Set Height
DD557FEC.hint: Constructs and returns a SetHeight actor message based on the parameters.  This message sets the actor at a height relative to the terrain, rather than specifying an absolute Z axis value.  It will only work on actors that have bearings, such as model actors or doodad actors.

B6218C18.name: Set Opacity
B6218C18.hint: Constructs and returns a SetOpacity actor message based on the parameters.  This message sets an actor's opacity to the Opacity parameter value.  The available range 0 to 1.  The Blend Duration parameter determines how long it should take to blend from the actor's current opacity to the desired opacity.  If the Blend Duration parameter is left at 0, it will change opacity instantly.

2B1990F3.name: Set Physics State
2B1990F3.hint: Constructs and returns a SetPhysicsState actor message based on the parameters.  This message will dictate to the actor how its associated physics should behave.  It will only work on actors with a model.

3049D859.name: Set Position
3049D859.hint: Constructs and returns a SetPosition actor message based on the parameters.  This message will set the 3D position of an actor, determined by the X,Y,Z parameters.

8819B5CE.name: Set Position 2D
8819B5CE.hint: Constructs and returns a SetPosition2D actor message based on the parameters.  This message sets the 2D position of an actor, determined by the X,Y parameters.  Note: Using this message will set the Z position of the actor to the default terrain level.

3C7147B0.name: Set Position 2D H
3C7147B0.hint: Constructs and returns a SetPosition2DH actor message based on the parameters.  This message sets the 2D position of an actor, determined by the X,Y parameters, while preserving the current height value.

7DEB7D4B.name: Set Position From
7DEB7D4B.hint: Constructs and returns a SetPositionFrom actor message based on the parameters.  This message will set the 3D position of an actor to the 3D position of another actor, specified through the Actor parameter.

FABD411F.name: Set Position H
FABD411F.hint: Constructs and returns a SetPositionH actor message based on the parameters.  This message will set the 2D position of an actor to the X,Y parameters, while adjusting its height relative to the terrain determined by the Height parameter.

34B22F9F.name: Set Render To Texture Enabled
34B22F9F.hint: Constructs and returns a SetRenderToTextureEnabled actor message.  This will enable or disable a model's ability to use render to texture.  Only works on actors with models that are set up for render to texture in the model file.

6F1A64F5.name: Set Rotation
6F1A64F5.hint: Constructs and returns a SetRotation actor message based on the parameters.  This message will set the 3D rotation of the actor according to the Forward X,Y,Z parameters and the Up X,Y,Z parameters.

E5EFA0FC.name: Set Rotation From
E5EFA0FC.hint: Constructs and returns a SetRotationFrom actor message based on the parameters.  This message will set the 3D rotation of an actor to the 3D rotation of another actor specified through the Actor parameter.

116E3543.name: Set Scale
116E3543.hint: Constructs and returns a SetScale actor message based on the parameters.  This message sets the X,Y,Z scale of an actor's model, relative to the model's data entry X,Y,Z scale value, to the X,Y,Z parameter values.  This will take place over a number of game time seconds determined by the Blend Duration parameter.  If Blend Duration is left at 0, the change in scale will occur immediately.  Note: This only works on actors with models.

F21F850B.name: Set Scale Absolute
F21F850B.hint: Constructs and returns a SetScaleAbsolute actor message based on the parameters.  This message sets the absolute X,Y,Z scale of an actor's model to the X,Y,Z parameter values.  This will take place over a number of game time seconds determined by the Blend Duration parameter.  If Blend Duration is left at 0, the change in scale will occur immediately.  Note: This only works on actors with models.

1161764D.name: Set Team Color
1161764D.hint: Constructs and returns a SetTeamColor actor message based on the parameters.  The Diffuse R,G,B parameter values determine the color of any diffuse textures on the model, such as the areas that display the color associated with their controlling player.  The Emissive R,G,B parameter values determine the color of any emissive textures on the model, such as the energy blades on the Zealot model.  This will only work on actor's with a model.

56C7DAB3.name: Set Local Tint Color
56C7DAB3.hint: Constructs and returns a SetLocalTintColor actor message based on the parameters.  This will set an actors tint color for only the current player.  This will only work on actor's with a model.

D41CE6AB.name: Set Tint Color
D41CE6AB.hint: Constructs and returns a SetLocalTintColor actor message based on the parameters.  This will set an actors tint color for all players.  This will only work on actor's with a model.

CB1ABC35.name: Set Visibility
CB1ABC35.hint: Constructs and returns a SetVisibility actor message based on the parameters.  This message will set the visibility state for the actor's model on or off, depending on the visibility parameter value.  If set to 0, the model will not show up.  If set to 1, the model will show up.  Other factors (such as if the model is under the fog of war) can affect an actor's visibility -- this message cannot force an actor to be visibile if the game engine is causing it to be invisible.  The reverse is possible, however -- this message can force an actor to be invisible.  In other words, invisibility always wins.

005E9040.name: Set Walk Anim Move Speed
005E9040.hint: Constructs and returns a SetWalkAnimMoveSpeed actor message.  This message alters an actor's relative walking animation speed, 1=normal, less is faster, more is slower.

9A3A1F3F.name: Set Z
9A3A1F3F.hint: Constructs and returns a SetZ actor message based on the parameters.  This message sets the absolute height of the actor, determined by the Z parameter.

DB5A7F79.name: Signal
DB5A7F79.hint: Constructs and returns a Signal actor message based on the parameters.  This message will send a signal with a name determined by the Signal parameter to an actor.  If the actor is set up to respond to a signal by that name it will do so, otherwise it will have no effect.  Note: This is a relatively advanced actor message, as the actor you are sending the signal to must be pre-configured to respond to a signal message with the same name.

7E2859EF.name: Sound Add DSP
7E2859EF.hint: Constructs and returns a SoundAddDSP actor message based on the parameters.  This message will add a reverb effect, chosen by the Effect parameter, to a sound.  This will only work on sound actors.

16D6316F.name: Sound Set Muted
16D6316F.hint: Constructs and returns a SoundSetMuted actor message based on the parameters.  This message will mute or unmute a sound depending on the Muted State parameter: 1 is muted, 0 is unmuted.  It can mute or unmute with or without a fade depending on the Fade parameter: 1 is fade, 0 is do not fade.

674435EE.name: Sound Set Offset
674435EE.hint: Constructs and returns a SoundSetOffset actor message based on the parameters.  This message will offset the sound playback, in milliseconds, by a value equal to the Offset parameter.  This can be used to skip a portion of a sound played by a sound actor.  It will only work on sound actors.

F163BD1A.name: Sound Set Paused
F163BD1A.hint: Constructs and returns a SoundSetPaused actor message based on the parameters.  This message will paused or unpause a sound depending on the Paused State parameter: 1 is paused, 0 is unpaused.  It can pause or unpause with or without fade depending on the Fade parameter: 1 is fade, 0 is do not fade.

603D4494.name: Status Decrement
603D4494.hint: Constructs and returns a StatusDecrement actor message.  This message is used to decrement an existing status variable, specified by the Status Variable parameter, on an actor.  If the status variable count is 0 a StatusOff message tied to that status variable is sent to the actor, which would respond in a pre-determined fashion to no longer having that status.  Note: This is a relatively advanced actor concept, as it requires an actor be setup to respond to a StatusOn or StatusOff message to have any effect.

37F98E03.name: Texture Dump
37F98E03.hint: Constructs and returns a TextureDump actor message.  Prints the current texture list for an actor.  Works on actors with a model.

FAB12C79.name: Texture Dump DB
FAB12C79.hint: Constructs and returns a TextureDumpDB actor message.  This message prints out all of the possible textures that could be applied to the model of an actor to the debug log.  It only works on actors with models.

37CB0A2B.name: Texture Group Apply
37CB0A2B.hint: Constructs and returns a TextureGroupApply message based on the parameters.  This message will change which set of textures are being displayed on an actor.  An example of this is the Vespene Geyser unit, which has a different texture set (or prop) for each tileset.  Note: This is a relatively advanced actor concept, as the textures must be set up in the data in order for a model to display them.

6F9BE10D.name: Texture Group Remove
6F9BE10D.hint: Constructs and returns a TextureGroupRemove actor message based on the parameters.  This message will remove a set of texture props associated with the name given in the Texture Props parameter.  The unit will revert to its default texture, if it is not already using it.

7BE74571.name: Texture Select By ID
7BE74571.hint: Constructs and returns a TextureSelectById actor message.  Selects a texture that is defined in game data.  Works on actors with a model.

50D2D614.name: Texture Select By Match
50D2D614.hint: Constructs and returns a TextureSelectByMatch actor message.  Selects a texture into the specified slot so as to best match the contents of the source slot.  Useful for populating Normal, Specular and Emissive slot components from the diffuse component.  Works on actors with a model.

A6ED7BDA.name: Texture Select By Slot
A6ED7BDA.hint: Constructs and returns a TextureSelectBySlot actor message.  Select a texture into a texture slot based on the specified texture expression.  Works on actors with a model.

03E24F00.name: Texture Video Play (Advanced)
03E24F00.hint: Constructs and returns a TextureVideoPlay actor message.  Plays a video texture in a texture slot with the specified rate and flags.  Works on actors with a model.

E758567E.name: Texture Video Play
E758567E.hint: Constructs and returns a TextureVideoPlay actor message.  Plays a video texture in a texture slot with the specified rate and flags.  Works on actors with a model.

F39DC67E.name: Texture Video Set Frame (Advanced)
F39DC67E.hint: Constructs and returns a TextureVideoSetFrame actor message.  Sets the frame of a video texture that is playing on the specified slot.  Works on actors with a model.

A71B4788.name: Texture Video Set Frame
A71B4788.hint: Constructs and returns a TextureVideoSetFrame actor message.  Sets the frame of a video texture that is playing on the specified slot.  Works on actors with a model.

DB263E75.name: Texture Video Set Paused (Advanced)
DB263E75.hint: Constructs and returns a TextureVideoSetPaused actor message.  Sets the pause state of the video texture in the specified texture slot.  Works on actors with a model.

27C61BAC.name: Texture Video Set Paused
27C61BAC.hint: Constructs and returns a TextureVideoSetPaused actor message.  Sets the pause state of the video texture in the specified texture slot.  Works on actors with a model.

698068EA.name: Texture Video Set Time (Advanced)
698068EA.hint: Constructs and returns a TextureVideoSetTime actor message.  Sets the play position (in seconds) of the video texture in the specified texture slot.  Works on actors with a model.

1E22FEA1.name: Texture Video Set Time
1E22FEA1.hint: Constructs and returns a TextureVideoSetTime actor message.  Sets the play position (in seconds) of the video texture in the specified texture slot.  Works on actors with a model.

7BE4C0B6.name: Texture Video Stop (Advanced)
7BE4C0B6.hint: Constructs and returns a TextureVideoStop actor message.  Stops a video texture in the specified texture slot.  Works on actors with a model.

0A994220.name: Texture Video Stop
0A994220.hint: Constructs and returns a TextureVideoStop actor message.  Stops a video texture in the specified texture slot.  Works on actors with a model.

2921FDBE.name: Texture Video Stop All
2921FDBE.hint: Constructs and returns a TextureVideoStopAll actor message.  Stops all video textures on the actor it is sent to.  Works on actors with a model.

88B927DD.name: Timer Set
88B927DD.hint: Constructs and returns a TimerSet message based on the parameters.  This message will create a timer on the actor that will last for the Duration parameter in game time seconds.  The Timer Name parameter determines the name of the timer. When the timer expires a TimerExpired actor message is sent to the target actor, who would behave in a pre-determined fashion.  Note: This is a relatively advanced actor concept, as it requires an actor to be setup to respond to a TimerExpired actor message to have any effect.

BF585957.name: Timer Kill
BF585957.hint: Constructs and returns a TimerKill message based on the parameters.  This message will remove a timer currently ticking on an actor.  It will not trigger its expiration effect.

09D4CE38.name: Transition
09D4CE38.hint: Constructs and returns a Transition actor message.  Signals a generic transition "in" or "out" over a duration.  Works on rocker site actors.

23BF23BF.name: Kill Actor Scope
23BF23BF.hint: Kills an actor scope along with all of the actors in that scope.  An actor scope is a container for a set of actors.

1D2DCAF0.name: Kill All Particles
1D2DCAF0.hint: This will destroy all of the active particles on the map for all players.  Models that emit particles will still continue to do so, this will just kill the existing particles.

04454841.name: Kill Model
04454841.hint: Tells a model actor type to play its death animation and then destroy itself.  It will only work on model actors, such as those created by the "Attach Model to Unit" action.

06E7C64F.name: Orphan Actor Scope
06E7C64F.hint: Tells an actor scope to orphan itself, meaning that, once all of the actors inside of that scope have died, the scope will kill itself.  Under normal circumstances, this happens automatically.  However, it is theoretically possible for a user (through trigger script) to create actors in a scope where the scope won't automatically die once its actors are dead.

D92843D4.name: Remove Doodads in Region
D92843D4.hint: Instantly removes all doodads of the specified type from a game region.  If the doodad being removed has a footprint, that footprint will still linger, even though the doodad's actor has been destroyed.

D399C353.name: Remove Death Models in Region
D399C353.hint: Destroys all of the unit death models in the specified region and calls Kill All Particles. Be careful using this action because it kills all particles across the whole map, instead of just whithin the region.

FF02E4D3.name: Remove Death Models in Region Immediately
FF02E4D3.hint: Destroys all of the unit death models in the specified region immediately.

B2D4AC17.name: Look At Target From Point With Z Offset
B2D4AC17.hint: Returns an actor that is an invisible look at target actor at the specified point.

7DBB5796.name: Look At Target From Unit Attach Point
7DBB5796.hint: Returns an actor that is an invisible look at target attached to the specified attach point of the specified unit.

0DF623B9.name: Create Look At Target At Point
0DF623B9.hint: Creates an invisible look at target actor at the specified point.  If you set an actor variable to "Last Created Actor" immediately after this action, it will set the variable to the look at target that is created by this action.  You can then use that variable in an action such as "Actor Look At Start".

84C82092.name: Create Look At Target At Unit Attach Point
84C82092.hint: Creates an invisible look at target actor and attaches it to the specified attach point of the specified unit.  If you set an actor variable to "Last Created Actor" immediately after this action, it will set the variable to the look at target that is created by this action.  You can then use that variable in an action such as "Actor Look At Start".

6CC03970.name: Make Actor Look At Actor (Custom)
6CC03970.hint: Makes an actor look at another actor.  The parameters of this action allow you more control over the look at than "Make Actor Look At Actor".

5952C562.name: Make Actor Stop Looking (Custom)
5952C562.hint: Clears the look at target for the specified actor.  The parameters of this action allow you more control over the look at than "Make Actor Stop Looking".

E501C879.name: Make Actor Look At Actor
E501C879.hint: Makes the specified actor look at the specified target, using preset settings defined by the specified look at type.

62439CDE.name: Make Actor Stop Looking
62439CDE.hint: Clears the look at target for the specified actor, using preset settings defined by the specified look at type.

49B6B3DC.name: Make Unit Look At Actor
49B6B3DC.hint: Makes the specified unit look at the specified target, using preset settings defined by the specified look at type.

893DBB6D.name: Make Unit Look At Point
893DBB6D.hint: Makes the specified unit look at the specified point, using preset settings defined by the specified look at type.

752DBBCA.name: Make Unit Look At Unit
752DBBCA.hint: Makes the specified unit look at the specified other unit's attach point, using preset settings defined by the specified look at type.

3D6113BF.name: Make Unit Stop Looking
3D6113BF.hint: Clears the look at target for the specified unit, using preset settings defined by the specified look at type.

01502763.name: Actor From Reference
01502763.hint: Returns an actor that is connected to the specified actor.  The Name parameter can be either an actor ID or an actor reference, but is typically an actor reference.

5AF231D7.name: Actor Scope Get Text
5AF231D7.hint: Returns an actor scope's debug information.

E9B7A1DB.name: Actor From
E9B7A1DB.hint: Returns an actor from the actor reference specified in the Name parameter.

76B3930A.name: Actor From Actor
76B3930A.hint: Returns an actor that is connected to the specified actor.  The Name parameter can be either an actor ID or an actor reference, but is typically an actor reference.

4D71B0AB.name: Actor From Doodad
4D71B0AB.hint: Returns the actor for the specified doodad.

AEBDE1ED.name: Actor From Portrait
AEBDE1ED.hint: Returns the actor for the specified portrait.

4113F63C.name: Actor From Scope
4113F63C.hint: Returns an actor from the specified scope.  The Name parameter can be either an actor ID or an actor reference.

3EC64613.name: Actor From Unit
3EC64613.hint: Returns the actor for the specified unit. This will return the primary actor that is responsible for governing the behavior of a specific unit, chosen through the Unit parameter.

A789E91D.name: Actor Scope From
A789E91D.hint: Returns an actor scope from an actor reference specified in the Name parameter.

C2BD263C.name: Actor Scope From Dialog Item
C2BD263C.hint: Returns a dialog item's actor scope.

9D56144F.name: Texture Slot Name
9D56144F.hint: Query a texture and return the slot name that the texture is assigned to.

70E9151C.name: Actor Set Reference
70E9151C.hint: Store the source actor into an actor reference determined by the Actor Ref Name parameter.

68E7E107.name: Apply Global Texture Group
68E7E107.hint: Applies texture props globally.  If a model's data is configured for texture swapping, and there is a texture available to the model with the global props, then that texture will be used.

E5AF914B.name: Push Texture Group
E5AF914B.hint: Pushes the current texture props, so triggers can modify their values and then restore the original values later.

F25477A9.name: Pop Texture Group
F25477A9.hint: Pop the global texture props and restore the texture props that were beneath them on the texture props stack.

1AECAFA1.name: Make Actor Face Angle
1AECAFA1.hint: Causes an actor to face the specified angle.

4CB1474C.name: Play Movie Texture On Unit Actor
4CB1474C.hint: Play a movie texture on the model of the main actor of the specified unit.  The unit's model must be set up to have a texture slot that matches the slot of the movie to play.

82A56C6E.name: Stop All Video Textures On Unit
82A56C6E.hint: Stops playing all video textures currently playing on the specified unit's actor.  The TV news reports in the Wings Of Liberty campaign are examples of video textures.

B9B9D1BF.name: Show/Hide Doodads In Region
B9B9D1BF.hint: Show or hide all of the doodads of the specified type in a region.

044A964C.name: Actor Add Orient Update
044A964C.hint: Causes StatusSet actor messages to be sent to every on screen actor unit every frame. The status value is based on the facing of the unit.

CF629BC0.name: Player Sends AI Wave
CF629BC0.hint: This event fires when an AI wave is sent by the specified player.

7050204D.name: Last Created Wave
7050204D.hint: Returns the last attack wave created by trigger script.  This will get set after Send Attack Wave is called.

2811FB0A.name: Add Unit To Attack Wave
2811FB0A.hint: Adds a unit to the next attack wave for a player.

D16912F9.name: Add Unit Group To Attack Wave
D16912F9.hint: Adds a unit group to the next attack wave for a player.

D2D4E17D.name: Add Escort Unit To Attack Wave
D2D4E17D.hint: Adds a unit to the next attack wave for a player with orders to escort another unit.

F172A13B.name: Add Escort UnitType To Attack Wave
F172A13B.hint: Adds a unit of the specified unit type to the next attack wave for a player with orders to escort another unit.

17E6D92B.name: Add Attack Wave Waypoint
17E6D92B.hint: Adds a waypoint to the next attack wave for a player.  In Force Transport Mode, the wave units will attempt to load up in transports before approaching this waypoint and will not regroup.  If there are not enough transports available for all of the units, the stranded units will be dropped from the wave.

3A0403D0.name: Send Attack Wave
3A0403D0.hint: Sends an attack wave for a player after the specified number of seconds has elapsed.  If Wait is used, then the script will wait for the wave to be sent before continuing execution.

232935FA.name: Cancel Attack Wave
232935FA.hint: Cancels an attack wave and sends the units back home.

D92EAFA7.name: Set Attack Wave Gather Point
D92EAFA7.hint: Sets the point at which attack wave units will gather before being dispatched.

3955F80B.name: Set Target Player For Attack Waves
3955F80B.hint: Sets a player group to be the target of a player's attack waves.

46F660D9.name: Set Target Unit For Attack Waves
46F660D9.hint: Sets a unit to be the target of a player's attack waves.

A1970AD2.name: Set Target UnitGroup For Attack Waves
A1970AD2.hint: Sets a unit group to be the target of a player's attack waves.

EC3358BD.name: Set Target UnitArea For Attack Waves
EC3358BD.hint: Sets the position of a unit to be the target of a player's attack waves.

12E81501.name: Set Target Point For Attack Waves
12E81501.hint: Sets a point to be the target of a player's attack waves.

C0B9F82E.name: Set Target Merge For Attack Waves
C0B9F82E.hint: Sets a wave to be the target of a player's attack waves.  All of that player's attack waves will merge into the specified wave.

4A81E03B.name: Set Target Patrol For Attack Waves
4A81E03B.hint: Sets the target of a player's attack waves to patrol.

5EB3E17A.name: Set Target Escort For Attack Waves
5EB3E17A.hint: Sets the target of a player's attack waves to escort a unit group.

B2CAB822.name: Set Target Escort For Attack Waves, No Leashing
B2CAB822.hint: Sets the target of a player's attack waves to escort a unit group. The escorts will not break combat and return to their charge should they become seperated.

6FF5F733.name: Set Target Gather Defense For Attack Waves
6FF5F733.hint: Sets the target of a player's attack waves to a town's defensive gather point.

C0C71187.name: Set Target Gather Offense For Attack Waves
C0C71187.hint: Sets the target of a player's attack waves to a town's offensive gather point.

27FDA8F2.name: Set Target Melee For Attack Waves
27FDA8F2.hint: Sets the target of a player's attack waves to attack any enemies of that player.

AE456797.name: Set Target Melee Harass For Attack Waves
AE456797.hint: Sets the target of a player's attack waves to harass any enemies of that player.

AA60F62B.name: Set Target Region For Attack/Defense Waves
AA60F62B.hint: Sets the target of a player's attack (or defense) waves to a region.

253D7FAD.name: Add Attack Wave Unit Types (Liberty)
253D7FAD.hint: Adds a type of unit to the next attack wave for a player; allowing you to specify a different number of units per difficulty level.

897E3B38.name: Add Attack Wave Unit Types (Swarm)
897E3B38.hint: Adds a type of unit to the next attack wave for a player; allowing you to specify a different number of units per difficulty level.

42C5413B.name: Set Attack Wave Keep Alive
42C5413B.hint: Set the next attack wave from a player to stay around even if it has only zero units in it. Only use this if you plan to manually keep track of the wave and add units later.

D59531F5.name: Set Attack Wave Gather Early No Replace
D59531F5.hint: Set the next attack wave from a player to gather immediately and not replace any units that die while gathering.

CD05E06B.name: Remove All Bullies
CD05E06B.hint: Removes the bully flag from all units owned by a player.

A0089822.name: Add New Bully
A0089822.hint: Creates a new unit of the specified unit type at a point that the AI will attempt to rebuild if killed.  This includes the number of times that the AI will rebuild the unit.

E916DC36.name: Set Minimum Bully Count
E916DC36.hint: Sets the minimum number of bullies an AI player should maintain regardless of rebuild counts.

7F2D83FF.name: Set Rebuild Count (Default)
7F2D83FF.hint: Sets the maximum number of units or maximum number of buildings an AI player should rebuild.  This only applies to preplaced units or buildings that do not have an individual rebuild count set.

FAF78B95.name: Set Rebuild Count (Specific)
FAF78B95.hint: Sets the maximum number of a specific unit an AI player should rebuild.  This only applies to preplaced units or buildings that do not have an individual rebuild count set.

A55BF7C8.name: Set Attack Wave Bully Percent
A55BF7C8.hint: Sets the percentage of bullies that are allowed to be used for attack waves for a player.

4714FAB1.name: Set Bully Rebuild Delay
4714FAB1.hint: Sets the delay time before the AI starts trying to replace missing bullies for a player.

5C676F69.name: Limit Bully Rebuild To Nearest Town
5C676F69.hint: When enabled for a player, this makes it so that bullies for that player can only be replaced by unit producing structures in the town those bullies are closest to.

A92A2CD2.name: Limit Bully Wave Gather To Nearest Town
A92A2CD2.hint: When enabled for a player, this makes it so that bullies for that player can only be used in attack waves that are gathering near the town those bullies are closest to.

5FF15420.name: Activate/Deactivate Bullies In Region
5FF15420.hint: If bullies are deactivated for a region, then that player will no longer rebuild bullies that were placed in that region.

D688C655.name: Reset Bully Rebuild Counts In Region
D688C655.hint: Resets the rebuild counts for bullies owned by a specific player in a specific region.

D59E1980.name: AI Time Is Paused
D59E1980.hint: Returns true if the AI time is paused.

8BDC6216.name: Elapsed AI Time
8BDC6216.hint: Returns how much AI time has gone by since the start of the map.

869F0576.name: Wave Of Unit
869F0576.hint: Returns the wave a unit belongs to.

434CFCE2.name: Units Of Wave
434CFCE2.hint: Returns the group of units that belong to a wave.

C6DD8D08.name: Escorts Of Unit
C6DD8D08.hint: Returns a group of all of the units assigned to escort a unit.

A7431889.name: Escorts Of Unit Group
A7431889.hint: Returns a group of all of the units assigned to escort a unit group.

1E3BDBCF.name: Units In Waves With Target
1E3BDBCF.hint: Returns a group of all the units owned by a player in any waves that are targeting the specified wave target.

2D900E1C.name: Unit Is Script Controlled
2D900E1C.hint: Returns true if the unit is being controlled by scripts/triggers instead of by AI.  This function only works for units owned by an AI player.  Script-controlled units are not used by the AI for attack waves.  Units that are issued orders via trigger actions are automatically marked as script-controlled.  You can manually mark a unit as script-controlled using the Enable/Disable Script Control trigger actions.

B4B744A5.name: Unit Is Unavailable For Wave Use
B4B744A5.hint: Returns true if the unit is unusable by waves.

F2F49F9B.name: Unit Is Suicidal
F2F49F9B.hint: Returns true if the unit is flagged as a suicide unit.

7703744B.name: Difficulty Value (Integer)
7703744B.hint: Returns the integer parameter that matches the current difficulty setting.  This is for campaign use (in which all players have the same difficulty setting), so player 1's setting is used.

83DDFCCA.name: Difficulty Value (Real)
83DDFCCA.hint: Returns the real parameter that matches the current difficulty setting.  This is for campaign use (in which all players have the same difficulty setting), so player 1's setting is used.

BC487BC6.name: Difficulty Value (Unit Type)
BC487BC6.hint: Returns the unit type parameter that matches the current difficulty setting.  This is for campaign use (in which all players have the same difficulty setting), so player 1's setting is used.

BD0E4598.name: Difficulty Is (one)
BD0E4598.hint: Returns true if this is the current difficulty setting.  This is for campaign use (in which all players have the same difficulty setting), so player 1's setting is used.

3A3B8C53.name: Difficulty Is (two)
3A3B8C53.hint: Returns true if the current difficulty setting is either of these.  This is for campaign use (in which all players have the same difficulty setting), so player 1's setting is used.

68CB92EB.name: Difficulty High
68CB92EB.hint: Returns true if the current difficulty setting is this or harder.  This is for campaign use (in which all players have the same difficulty setting), so player 1's setting is used.

DD754C85.name: Difficulty Low
DD754C85.hint: Returns true if the current difficulty setting is this or easier.  This is for campaign use (in which all players have the same difficulty setting), so player 1's setting is used.

2445C07B.name: Random Spawn Point
2445C07B.hint: Returns a random point in the given region. Prefers to stay either close or far from enemies units. Also prefers to be within some max distance of enemy buildings. It will also stay away from previously returned random points in the region.

BC622053.name: Pause AI Time
BC622053.hint: Pauses or unpauses the AI time. While paused, the controlling AI will idle. AI owned units will carry out their current actions, and then idle.

43BF892E.name: Start Campaign AI For All Players
43BF892E.hint: The campaign AI must be started for each player that uses AI triggers.
