E2E35DF6.name: Start Campaign AI For Player
E2E35DF6.hint: The campaign AI must be started for each player that uses AI triggers.

6829CA57.name: Global Suicide
6829CA57.hint: Flags all units owned by a player to suicide. Units flagged to suicide will seek out and attack the nearest enemy unit they can find until they are slain, or there is nothing left to attack.

AA8C27B5.name: Enable/Disable Script Control For Unit
AA8C27B5.hint: If script control is enabled for a unit, the AI will not use that unit.  Script-controlled bullies are not replaced unless they die.

DDB3F038.name: Enable/Disable Script Control For Unit Group
DDB3F038.hint: If script control is enabled for a unit, the AI will not use that unit.  Script-controlled bullies are not replaced unless they die.

6D8D747A.name: Enable/Disable Wave Use For Unit Group
6D8D747A.hint: If wave use is disabled for a unit group, the AI will not use that unit in waves.

6ADF6634.name: Enable/Disable Suicide For Unit
6ADF6634.hint: If suicide is enabled for a unit, the AI will immediately seek out and repeatedly attack the nearest enemy until the suiciding unit is destroyed.  Setting a bully to suicide will tag it as missing and cause the AI to rebuild it, since it should not be returning alive.

A8F7E9C5.name: Enable/Disable Suicide For Unit Group
A8F7E9C5.hint: If suicide is enabled for a unit group, the AI will immediately seek out and repeatedly attack the nearest enemy until the suiciding unit group is destroyed. Setting a bully to suicide it will tag it as missing and cause the AI to rebuilt it, since it should not be returning alive.

6A5E7D21.name: Remove Unit From All Waves
6A5E7D21.hint: Removes a unit from any waves it is in.

2DD3364B.name: Remove Unit Group From All Waves
2DD3364B.hint: Removes a group of units from any waves they are in.

858C1FB1.name: Remove Unit From All Waves And Set Home
858C1FB1.hint: Removes a unit from any waves it is in and sets its home point.

663AAFD7.name: Remove Unit Group From All Waves And Set Home
663AAFD7.hint: Removes a group of units from any waves they are in and sets their home point.

A27E3181.name: Init Campaign Towns
A27E3181.hint: Initializes the towns for an AI player.  This happens automatically when you call one of the Start Campaign AI actions.

B65D30F7.name: Init Campaign Harvesting
B65D30F7.hint: Initializes harvesting for an AI player.  This happens automatically when you call one of the Start Campaign AI actions.

1DFB2458.name: Issue AI Order
1DFB2458.hint: Suggests an order to a unit.  If the computer that controls the unit has the ability to execute the order (with respect to its current APM constraint), then it will do so.  The order will eventually be dropped if the computer is unable to execute it for a few seconds after it was issued.  If you need a unit to do something immediately, use Issue Order instead.

011F85FA.name: Start AI Personalities For All Players
011F85FA.hint: Starts AI for all computer players, including personalities defined in the AI module. A personality must have a Source Player set in the AI module to be started by this function. Computer players that are not associated with a personality will use the normal campaign AI. This action replaces Start Campaign AI For All Players (don't use both of them).

D8A21F36.name: Start AI Personality For Player
D8A21F36.hint: Starts an AI personality as configured in the AI module.

A9EA580D.name: Set Default Gather Point For Personality
A9EA580D.hint: Changes the default gather point for an AI player using a personality. The default gather point may also be set directly in the AI module.

57B35053.name: Run All Attack Waves For All Personalities
57B35053.hint: Begins running all attack waves defined for AI personalities within the AI module. A personality must have both a Source Player and Target Players defined to be run using this action.

8CAB163A.name: Run All Attack Waves
8CAB163A.hint: Begins running all attack waves defined for the AI personality within the AI module. This should only be called once per player.

810C9533.name: Run Attack Wave
810C9533.hint: Runs a specific attack wave defined for the AI personality in the AI module.

38742BD8.name: Turn All Attack Waves On/Off
38742BD8.hint: An attack wave which is turned off will still run the "turned off" timing phase, as configured in the AI module.

0000EBDB.name: Turn Attack Wave On/Off
0000EBDB.hint: An attack wave which is turned off will still run the "turned off" timing phase, as configured in the AI module.

898E65C3.name: Stop All Attack Waves For Personality
898E65C3.hint: Any attack waves currently in progress will continue, but no further attack waves will run. After being stopped, attack waves may be run again using Run All Attack Waves or Run Attack Wave.

641CFD0F.name: Attack Wave Is On
641CFD0F.hint: Use the Turn Attack Wave On/Off action to turn attack waves on or off.

4E74D71A.name: Attack Wave Last Created Units
4E74D71A.hint: Attack waves only create units if the Create Units Instantly option is enabled in the AI module.

11CCA676.name: Attack Wave Last Created Wave
11CCA676.hint: Returns the wave data associated with the last attack wave created for a specific wave definition within an AI personality defined in the AI module. To get the last wave for the personality regardless of wave definition, use Last Created Wave for Personality.

D237C756.name: Last Created Wave For Personality
D237C756.hint: Returns the wave data associated with the last attack wave created for an AI personality defined in the AI module. This may correspond to any wave definition. To get the last wave for a specific wave definition, use Attack Wave Last Created Wave.

690585B3.name: Custom Data For Last Attack Wave
690585B3.hint: Returns the custom data associated with the last attack wave started by the given player. Custom data strings for attack waves can be defined in the AI module.

D50EF6A5.name: Get Difficulty Parameter
D50EF6A5.hint: Returns the state of a particular difficulty parameter for a player.

C3EC8366.name: Set Difficulty Parameter
C3EC8366.hint: Enables or disables a particular difficulty parameter for a player.

2489EDDB.name: Is Point In Shrub
2489EDDB.hint: Returns whether a point is in a shrub.

CE113DDF.name: Is Campaign AI
CE113DDF.hint: Returns whether a player is running campaign AI (as opposed to melee AI).

6907D2C0.name: Grab Unit
6907D2C0.hint: Finds a player's lowest priority unit of the specified unit type, closest to the specified location, and claims it for a task, setting the priority of the new task.

701F3006.name: Get State
701F3006.hint: Gets the current value of the specified state index for a player.  The state is a per player integer array that can be useful to AI scripting.

A5F3A30C.name: Get Flag
A5F3A30C.hint: Gets the current value of the specified flag index for a player.  The flag is a per player boolean array that can be useful to AI scripting.

D21221AD.name: Get Coop Flag
D21221AD.hint: Gets the current value of the specified coop flag index for a player.

B2EE2FE1.name: Unit Has AI Option
B2EE2FE1.hint: Returns true if the unit has the specified AI option enabled.

C74452B4.name: Wants To Surrender
C74452B4.hint: Check if this player wants to concede a skirmish game.

897BC1F9.name: AI Pathing Cost Map
897BC1F9.hint: Returns the map pathing cost between two points, ignores all units.

E80D1B4D.name: AI Pathing Cost Unit
E80D1B4D.hint: Returns the pathing cost from a unit.

00000323.name: Start AI
00000323.hint: Starts the AI for a player in either campaign or melee mode, limiting the computer's actions per minute to the specified number.

C26CAC0E.name: Accept Surrender
C26CAC0E.hint: If the computer already wants to surrender then it will quit the game.  If it does not then this does nothing.

5DB8FF7D.name: Init Melee AI
5DB8FF7D.hint: Initializes the melee AI for a specific player.  Calling Start Melee AI For All Players will call this action for each computer player.

0406AF36.name: Set APM
0406AF36.hint: Limits the actions per minute of a computer player.

8676426B.name: Release Unit
8676426B.hint: Releases a unit by setting it back to idle.

59EB7D4A.name: Set State
59EB7D4A.hint: Sets the value of the specified state index for a player.  The state is a per player integer array that can be useful to AI scripting.

8D62B174.name: Set All States
8D62B174.hint: Sets the value of the state indexes for a player.  The state is a per player integer array that can be useful to AI scripting.

8F2500FF.name: Set Flag
8F2500FF.hint: Sets the value of the specified flag index for a player.  The flag is a per player boolean array that can be useful to AI scripting.

B3E923C4.name: Set Coop Flag
B3E923C4.hint: Sets the value of the specified coop flag index for a player.

DB0E6ABB.name: Set Tech Flag State
DB0E6ABB.hint: Sets the state of a flag for a player at the specified index based on whether the number of units of the type specified in the What parameter with the Tech Tree Count Type specified in the State parameter, is greater than or equal to the Count parameter.

613DD983.name: Set Unit Evaluation Custom Index
613DD983.hint: Any values set using "Set Unit Custom Value" with the given index will override the standard unit strength evaluation performed by the AI for that unit.

DC310587.name: Enable/Disable AI Option For Unit
DC310587.hint: Enables or disables an AI option for a unit.

8E970633.name: Set Defense Radii
8E970633.hint: Sets the basic defense call for help radii.  The threat must attack a building or come within MaxThreateningRange to trigger a defense call for help. Defenders that are within BuildingCallForHelpRange of the building or ThreatCallForHelpRange of the threat will respond. (ie the defender must be near the building or near the threat). By default Melee is (p#, 15.0, 10.0, 12.0) and Campaign is (p#, 6.0, 7.0, 9.0)<n/>

9418322D.name: Get Town State
9418322D.hint: Returns the current state of a town for a player.

F2A576A6.name: Get Town Location
F2A576A6.hint: Returns the location of a town for a player.

73D79FC7.name: Get Closest Town
73D79FC7.hint: Returns the index of the town closest to the specified point.

E48E495F.name: Get Next Unused Town Slot
E48E495F.hint: Returns the index of the next unused town slot for a player.

6BA2288F.name: Get Building Count In Town
6BA2288F.hint: Returns the number of buildings of the specified type in the specified town for a player.

054F17DD.name: Is Town Harvesting
054F17DD.hint: Returns whether the given town for a player is harvesting.

88299C13.name: Get Current Harvest Peon Count
88299C13.hint: Returns the number of peons currently harvesting in a town for a player.

00F8536E.name: Get Min Desired Harvest Peon Count
00F8536E.hint: Returns the minimum number of peons the AI wants to have harvesting in a town for a player.

1E835C46.name: Get Max Desired Harvest Peon Count
1E835C46.hint: Returns the maximum number of peons the AI wants to have harvesting in a town for a player.

ED658714.name: Get Mineral Amount Left
ED658714.hint: Returns the total minerals left to be harvested in a town for a player.

4CF8BD14.name: Get Gas Amount Left
4CF8BD14.hint: Returns the total gas left to be harvested in a town for a player.

6BCD444B.name: Get Num Mineral Spots
6BCD444B.hint: Returns number of mineral locations in a town for a player.

3AD70FB4.name: Get Num RawGas Spots
3AD70FB4.hint: Returns number of raw gas locations in a town for a player.  To get harvestable gas, query for the gas harvesting building in the town.

7E2BDC46.name: Get Offense Gather Location
7E2BDC46.hint: Returns the default offensive gather location for a town of a player.

0CE536BB.name: Get Defense Gather Location
0CE536BB.hint: Returns the default defensive gather location for a town of a player.

53D30B3F.name: Expand
53D30B3F.hint: Instructs the AI for a player to expand starting the search at the specified point, and builds the specified building at the new expansion.  Returns the town index for the new town.

64C44D41.name: Get Town Threats
64C44D41.hint: Returns a unit group of all the threats near the given town of a player.

CBDF8A17.name: Declare Next Town
CBDF8A17.hint: Create a new town for player at the specified point.

4DC893FD.name: Declare Town Specific Slot
4DC893FD.hint: Sets the center of a player's town to be at the specified point.

642520EE.name: Set Main Town
642520EE.hint: Sets the specified town to be the main town for a player.

A3F78565.name: Enable Harvesting
A3F78565.hint: Start a new harvest job at a town for a player.

411A8BD2.name: Set Harvest Rate
411A8BD2.hint: Set the harvest rate for a player.

BB9C147B.name: Set Gas Peon Count Override
BB9C147B.hint: By default the AI will harvest gas with three peons per vespene geyser. Use this action to override that behavior with the desired peon count.

CF51BA45.name: Get Scout
CF51BA45.hint: Returns a unit that will be the next scout for a player.  The Previous Unit parameter is optional (pass null to it if it is undesired).  If no Previous Unit is specified, then this will always return a new scout.  If Previous Unit is specified, then this will return that unit, unless there is a better unit type available for scouting, in which case it will return a new unit of that type.

CA5B980A.name: Get Next Scout Location
CA5B980A.hint: Returns the next location needing to be scouted for a player.

DE1A962E.name: Set Num Scouts
DE1A962E.hint: Sets the number of scouts to use for a player.

328F6584.name: Set Scout Times
328F6584.hint: Sets how frequently a player sends a scout to each type of map objective.  The time specified will get set for each objective of that type.  The AI will scout objectives with a smaller time set more often than those with a larger time set.

55F11088.name: Get Default Build Flags
55F11088.hint: Returns the default build flags for a type of building made by a player.

BB7112C9.name: Player Has Resources
BB7112C9.hint: Returns whether a player has at least the specified amounts of Minerals and Gas.

E40B4D3C.name: Tech Count
E40B4D3C.hint: Returns the number of units of the specified unit type that are in progress/made by a player.  Includes units in AI queues.

91DE7A68.name: Known Unit Count
91DE7A68.hint: Returns the number of units of of the specified unit type owned by another player that have been seen by the specified player.

136B709A.name: Build
136B709A.hint: Instructs the AI to build some buildings of the specified type.

C89E24A9.name: Train
C89E24A9.hint: Instructs the AI to train some units of the specified type.

94C71F93.name: Research
94C71F93.hint: Instructs the AI to research the specified upgrade.

CEB6863E.name: Make Always
CEB6863E.hint: Instructs the AI to make the specified unit or building.

1BE799E9.name: Make Once
1BE799E9.hint: Instructs the AI to make the specified unit or building only if the AI has 0 of them built or in queue.

B9F8937C.name: Clear Build Queue
B9F8937C.hint: Clears all build requests currently planned (but not yet started) for a player.

80A883C0.name: Clear Train Queue
80A883C0.hint: Clears all train requests currently planned (but not yet started) for a player.

8B786E6C.name: Clear Research Queue
8B786E6C.hint: Clears all research requests currently planned (but not yet started) for a player.

D6FE8683.name: Clear Stock
D6FE8683.hint: Clears the stock lists of units and buildings to make for a player.

9F4A5938.name: Enable Stock
9F4A5938.hint: Instructs the AI to make all the units and buildings specified by previously executed Set Stock commands for a player.

2D993BDF.name: Set StockEx
2D993BDF.hint: Set stock for a player to make units of the specified unit type.  (More advanced than Set Stock)

0DD50612.name: Set Stock
0DD50612.hint: Set stock for a player to make units of the specified unit type.

700EC30F.name: Set StockOpt
700EC30F.hint: Set stock for a player to make units of the specified unit type using the 'optional' Stock Flag.

C97424F4.name: Set StockUnitNext
C97424F4.hint: Increments the stock count for the specified unit type by one if the Count parameter is set to 0, or the number of those units that are in progress or better is less than the specified Count.  Does nothing if the Ignore If Queued parameter is set to true and the number of queued and in progress units of the specified type is greater than 0.

EF7E05B0.name: Set StockTown
EF7E05B0.hint: Adds Town into the stock for an AI player. When the AI reaches this point in the stock list, it will ensure that every Town it owns has two refineries and a town hall of the specified types. This ensures that AI towns are never without these buildings.

9304C879.name: Set StockExpand
9304C879.hint: Adds an expansion into the stock for an AI player. When the AI reaches this point in the stock list, it will build the specified TownHall type at an expansion point rather than spending money on units or other buildings.

93E5F5FD.name: Set StockAlias
93E5F5FD.hint: Adds a unit into the stock with consideration for the Alias Type parameter. This alias is used for some internal functions. Note: This is an advanced AI concept. In most cases Set Stock is a more efficient choice.

8B505342.name: Set StockFree
8B505342.hint: Adds a unit to the AI player's stock if the Prereq parameter is met.  An example of this would be telling the AI player to add Stalkers to their stock, but only if they have Blink researched.

891D2DCA.name: Default Economy
891D2DCA.hint: Sets stock for a player's economic buildings and units based on the specified parameters.

CBAA7BFC.name: Default Expansion
CBAA7BFC.hint: Attempts to make the specified player expand.  There are certain conditions under which the AI will not expand, such as if the player does not have enough workers.  The Minerals and Gas parameters are thresholds that the player must be under in order to expand (unless the player has too many extra workers).

B9E6CE90.name: Script Get Maker
B9E6CE90.hint: Returns the ID of the unit type that directly makes the specified object for a player.  Same as the default/code version, except this version could potentially be modified to handle custom requirements.

C672F322.name: Script Get Object Type
C672F322.hint: Takes an Object ID and returns 0 if it is a unit, 1 if it is a building, 2 if it is an upgrade, and -1 if it does not fall into any of those categories.  Same as the default/code version, except this version could potentially be modified to handle custom requirements.

7407844C.name: Script Get First Missing Req
7407844C.hint: Returns the first completely missing requirment to make an object for a player.  Same as the default/code version, except this version could potentially be modified to handle custom requirements.

D096667E.name: Script Get First Unfinished Req
D096667E.hint: Returns the first unfinished requirment to make an object for a player.  Same as the default/code version, except this version could potentially be modified to handle custom requirements.

0D425579.name: Script Get Full Make Time
0D425579.hint: Returns the total amount of time required to make the specified object (including the time it would take to tech up to that object's requirements).  Returned value is in sixteenths of a second.  Same as the default/code version, except this version could potentially be modified to handle custom requirements.

1CC9B0A2.name: Default/Code Get Maker
1CC9B0A2.hint: Returns the ID of the unit type that directly makes the specified object for a player.  Same as the script version, except this version cannot be modified to handle custom requirements.

D02CF6A0.name: Default/Code Get Object Type
D02CF6A0.hint: Takes an Object ID and returns 0 if it is a unit, 1 if it is a building, 2 if it is an upgrade, and -1 if it does not fall into any of those categories.  Same as the script version, except this version cannot be modified to handle custom requirements.

6D09502F.name: Default/Code Get First Missing Req
6D09502F.hint: Returns the first completely missing requirment to make an object for a player.  Same as the script version, except this version cannot be modified to handle custom requirements.

03915715.name: Default/Code Get First Unfinished Req
03915715.hint: Returns the first unfinished requirment to make an object for a player.  Same as the script version, except this version cannot be modified to handle custom requirements.

522AA4A2.name: Default/Code Get Full Make Time
522AA4A2.hint: Returns the total amount of time required to make the specified object (including the time it would take to tech up to that object's requirements).  Returned value is in sixteenths of a second.  Same as the script version, except this version cannot be modified to handle custom requirements.

ACA3819C.name: Get Base Name
ACA3819C.hint: Returns the internal string ID of the object specified by the String parameter.

CA3522F4.name: Get BuildAt Name
CA3522F4.hint: Returns the build at name contained in the specified string.

48519E3B.name: Count Object As Already Made
48519E3B.hint: Instructs the AI requirements code to treat the specified Unit for a player as already made for the purpose of meeting prerequisites,

89527ECA.name: Same Command
89527ECA.hint: Tells a unit to do the same action that another is currently doing.  Returns true if the action succeeded.

44C3372B.name: Last Attacker
44C3372B.hint: Returns the unit who last attacked the specified unit.

9B939290.name: Last Attack
9B939290.hint: Returns the time the specified unit was last attacked.

3D360D90.name: Get Wants To Move Status
3D360D90.hint: Returns true if the AI logic wants to move the specified unit.

F9D17330.name: Is Ignored By Wave
F9D17330.hint: Returns true if the specified unit is ignored by the wave it is in (for purposes of regrouping, etc.).

927B2EC7.name: Get Cloaked Attacker
927B2EC7.hint: Returns the position of the last attack from a cloaked unit against a player specified by the Player parameter.

E9CE6B42.name: Get Best Target Point On Group
E9CE6B42.hint: Returns the best location to place an AOE attack on a group of units with the specified parameters.

124D7CB6.name: Find Units
124D7CB6.hint: Returns a group of all of the units of the specified type owned by a player within the specified range of a point up to max count units.

8198A5A9.name: Get Default Combat Priority
8198A5A9.hint: Returns a unit that is the best target for the specified attackers from the list of possible units in the specified enemy unit group. It then also changes the attackers group to only include the limited number of attackers wanting to switch to that target.

80DAD37A.name: Combat Diff Flag Special High Priority
80DAD37A.hint: When enabled, allows the combat AI to target squishy high damage casters before certain other targets.

01EA83D3.name: Combat Diff Flag Splash High Priority
01EA83D3.hint: When enabled, allows the combat AI to target AoE/Splash damage enemies before certain other targets.

C709A5B8.name: Combat Diff Flag Timed Low Priority
C709A5B8.hint: When enabled, allows the combat AI to target limited time units below certain other targets.

737DE073.name: Combat Diff Flag Workers Normal Priority
737DE073.hint: When enabled, allows the combat AI to target workers normally, instead of below most other targets.

BCD227ED.name: Combat Diff Flag Healers
BCD227ED.hint: When enabled, allows the combat AI to target healers before certain other targets.

367F839E.name: Combat Diff Flag Low Health
367F839E.hint: When enabled, allows the combat AI to target low health units before certain other targets.

929F17F7.name: Combat Diff Flag Bonus Damage
929F17F7.hint: When enabled, allows the combat AI to target unit types it would do bonus damage to before certain other targets.

07737A02.name: Combat Diff Flag Injured
07737A02.hint: When enabled, allows the combat AI to target injured units before certain other targets.

08431739.name: Combat Diff Flag Detector
08431739.hint: When enabled, allows the combat AI to target detectors before certain other targets.

301FA66C.name: Combat Diff Flag Siege Range
301FA66C.hint: When enabled, allows the combat AI to target siege range units before certain other targets.

AF001F41.name: Does Unit Have Tactical Disabled
AF001F41.hint: Returns true if the unit has tactical disabled via the special flag.

6B6A38DD.name: Set Ignored By Wave
6B6A38DD.hint: Sets the specified unit to be ignored or unignored by its wave. An ignored unit  does not receive any of the orders issued to a wave it belongs to.

13AC02CC.name: Clear Cloaked Attacker
13AC02CC.hint: Clears the cloaked attack for a player near a point.

FB5C6DA7.name: Tactical AI - Cast
FB5C6DA7.hint: Suggests an order to a unit.  Works the same as Issue AI Order, but with additional parameters.  If the computer that controls the unit has the ability to execute the order (with respect to its current APM constraint), then it will do so.  The order will eventually be dropped if the computer is unable to execute it for a few seconds after it was issued.  If you need a unit to do something immediately, use Issue Order instead.  The Marker parameter is optional, pass in null if you don't want to use it.

B3F00FBD.name: Tactical AI - Flee
B3F00FBD.hint: Tells a unit to flee from another unit at least the specified distance.  The Marker parameter is optional, pass in null if you don't want to use it.

D0A20ECE.name: Set Tactical AI Range
D0A20ECE.hint: Overwrites the Tactical AI Range field for the specified unit's data for the specified player.

35699ADE.name: Set Tactical AI Think
35699ADE.hint: Sets a tactical AI think function for the specified unit for the specified player.

053E17EE.name: Enable/Disable Tactical For Unit
053E17EE.hint: Forces tactical to be disabled for the unit (regardless of other unit properties such as ForceTactical / Computer Controlled). Or re-enables tactical that was previous disabled by this function.

662F6F4F.name: Enable/Disable Tactical For Unit Group
662F6F4F.hint: Forces tactical to be disabled for each unit in the group (regardless of other unit properties such as ForceTactical / Computer Controlled). Or re-enables tactical that was previous disabled by this function.

571DFD8F.name: Transport Set Return
571DFD8F.hint: Set the return location for a player's transports when they are done unloading / idle.

0A90C548.name: Transport Set Panic
0A90C548.hint: Sets the percentage health at which a player's transports should flee.  (Value range from 0 to 1).

ACD579FA.name: Transport Disable AutoPickup
ACD579FA.hint: Disables auto-pickup transport logic for an AI player's transports.

00000264.name: Create Wave Info
00000264.hint: Returns a newly initialized Wave Info object.

F7F93AB0.name: Create Wave Info From Wave
F7F93AB0.hint: Returns a new wave info from the specified wave.

00000263.name: Create Wave
00000263.hint: Create a wave from the specified wave info for a player.  Returns the wave.

D2E12783.name: Wave Unit Count
D2E12783.hint: Returns the number of units in a wave.

5D9D7313.name: Wave State
5D9D7313.hint: Returns the state of a wave.

00000268.name: Wave Target Unit
00000268.hint: Creates a new wave target set to attack a unit.  Returns the wave target.

29EBBD36.name: Wave Target UnitGroup
29EBBD36.hint: Creates a new wave target set to attack a unit group.  Returns the wave target.

00000267.name: Wave Target Unit Point
00000267.hint: Creates a new wave target set to attack the location where a unit currently resides.  Returns the wave target.

444891AA.name: Wave Target Point
444891AA.hint: Creates a new wave target set to attack a point.  Returns the wave target.

00000362.name: Wave Target Player
00000362.hint: Creates a new wave target set to attack a player group.  Returns the wave target.

4A9D2A1A.name: Wave Target Melee
4A9D2A1A.hint: Creates a new wave target set to attack enemies of the specified player.  Returns the wave target.

6E3A8C34.name: Wave Target Melee Harass
6E3A8C34.hint: Creates a new wave target set to harass enemies of the specified player.  Returns the wave target.

225660B8.name: Wave Target Merge
225660B8.hint: Creates a new wave target set to merge with the specified wave.  Returns the wave target.

C9555AF8.name: Wave Target Patrol
C9555AF8.hint: Creates a new wave target set to repeatedly patrol through its waypoint list.  Returns the wave target.

C55EEFBE.name: Wave Target Escort
C55EEFBE.hint: Creates a new wave target set to escort the specified unit group.  Returns the wave target.

C6F10828.name: Wave Target Escort No Leash
C6F10828.hint: Creates a new wave target set to escort the specified unit group.  Returns the wave target.

148F1F3E.name: Wave Target Gather Offense
148F1F3E.hint: Creates a new wave target set to gather at the offensive gather point of the specified town.  Returns the wave target.

B947254E.name: Wave Target Gather Defense
B947254E.hint: Creates a new wave target set to gather at the defensive gather point of the specified town.  Returns the wave target.

3B948B04.name: Wave Target Harass Retreat
3B948B04.hint: Creates a new wave target set to harass and retreat.  Returns the wave target.

09C84766.name: Wave Target Region
09C84766.hint: Creates a new wave target set to defend the specified region.  Returns the wave target.

CA8628B0.name: Wave Get Target
CA8628B0.hint: Returns the wave target for the specified wave.

864A13AD.name: Is Wave In Combat
864A13AD.hint: Returns true if the specified wave is in combat.

631074E7.name: Wave Time In Combat
631074E7.hint: Returns how long the specified wave has been in combat.

F9BAA257.name: Wave Time Since Combat
F9BAA257.hint: Returns how long since the specified wave has been in combat.

BD3A49F3.name: Wave Time Since Ordered
BD3A49F3.hint: Returns how long since the specified wave has been ordered.

012B787C.name: Wave Eval
012B787C.hint: Returns the eval of the specified wave.

29AF608A.name: Wave Eval Ratio
29AF608A.hint: Returns the eval ratio of the specified wave against enemies within the specified range.

86903CA2.name: Eval Ratio
86903CA2.hint: Returns the global eval ratio for a player.

B9BB6748.name: Wave Get
B9BB6748.hint: Returns the wave at the specified index for a player.

80D47188.name: Wave Type
80D47188.hint: Returns the wave type of a wave.

B00BA8E5.name: Get Best Attack Target Point
B00BA8E5.hint: Get the best target point to attack for a player, optionally considering only the specified enemies.

CFA36FEA.name: Wave To String
CFA36FEA.hint: Converts a wave tag to a string.

BBEA4D1B.name: Wave To Text
BBEA4D1B.hint: Converts a wave tag to text.

9FD9132C.name: Wave Add Info
9FD9132C.hint: Add units of the specified type to the specified wave info.

5A29FC42.name: Wave Info Attack
5A29FC42.hint: Instructs a wave to attack with the specified parameters.

00000363.name: Wave Info Suicide
00000363.hint: Instructs a wave to suicide attack with the specified parameters.

00000265.name: Wave Add Unit
00000265.hint: Adds a unit to a wave.

9C13A2D1.name: Wave Add Unit Priority
9C13A2D1.hint: Adds a unit to a wave with a priority.

D29C2D5E.name: Wave Remove Unit
D29C2D5E.hint: Removes a unit from a wave.

F8C91F07.name: Wave Set Type
F8C91F07.hint: Sets the wave type and wave target for a wave.

1921CDD9.name: Wave Target Add Waypoint
1921CDD9.hint: Adds a waypoint to the specified wave target.  In Force Transport Mode, the wave units will attempt to load up in transports before approaching this waypoint and will not regroup.  If there are not enough transports available for all of the units, the stranded units will be dropped from the wave.

E95AC0AF.name: Wave Target Clear Waypoints
E95AC0AF.hint: Clears all waypoints for a wave target.

974C796D.name: Wave Set
974C796D.hint: Associate a wave with an index for a player.

EEC9FC53.name: Wave Merge
EEC9FC53.hint: Merges two waves together.  Waves are specified using a player's wave indexes.

A8AB1B4D.name: Tactical AI Filter - Create Filter
A8AB1B4D.hint: Create an AI filter for use with tactical AI routines.

6E721C10.name: Tactical AI Filter - Create Marker
6E721C10.hint: Create a marker for use with the tactical AI functions.

4B9AE2C2.name: Tactical AI Filter - Run
4B9AE2C2.hint: Use a tactical AI filter to trim a unit group and return a new one.

05CAB88A.name: Tactical AI Filter Alliance
05CAB88A.hint: Sets the specified AI Filter to only include either enemy or allied units.  Use this and the other "Tactical AI Filter" actions to set up an AI Filter, which can then be used in a "Tactical AI Filter - Run" function to filter a unit group.

B2DCD6C2.name: Tactical AI Filter Markers
B2DCD6C2.hint: If a "marker per life" has not been set then a counting marker may be used. A counting marker ensures the indicated range of tactical AI markers exist on a candidate or else the unit will be filtered out. A range of 0 to 1 will prevent more than one unit from casting on the same target at the same time.

C66E506F.name: Tactical AI Filter Remove Self
C66E506F.hint: Sets the specified AI Filter to exclude the specified unit.  Use this and the other "Tactical AI Filter" actions to set up an AI Filter, which can then be used in a "Tactical AI Filter - Run" function to filter a unit group.

D14651C4.name: Tactical AI Filter Range
D14651C4.hint: Sets the specified AI Filter to only include units within the specified range of the specified unit.  Use this and the other "Tactical AI Filter" actions to set up an AI Filter, which can then be used in a "Tactical AI Filter - Run" function to filter a unit group.

7C978DF1.name: Tactical AI Filter Life
7C978DF1.hint: Sets the specified AI Filter to only include units whose life is within the specified range.  Use this and the other "Tactical AI Filter" actions to set up an AI Filter, which can then be used in a "Tactical AI Filter - Run" function to filter a unit group.

226407B8.name: Tactical AI Filter Life Lost
226407B8.hint: Sets the specified AI Filter to only include units whose life lost is within the specified range.  Use this and the other "Tactical AI Filter" actions to set up an AI Filter, which can then be used in a "Tactical AI Filter - Run" function to filter a unit group.

2C3ABB83.name: Tactical AI Filter Life Sort Reference
2C3ABB83.hint: Sets the specified AI Filter to sort units by their current vitality, sorting ones below the threshold value to the end end of the list. Use this and the other "Tactical AI Filter" actions to set up an AI Filter, which can then be used in a "Tactical AI Filter - Run" function to filter a unit group.

D20ABCFC.name: Tactical AI Filter Life Modifier
D20ABCFC.hint: Sets the specified AI Filter to modify the way it calculates life values for units with the specified attribute.  For example, if the attribute was set to Armored, and the Amount set to 100, then the filter would consider Armored units to have 100 more life than they actually have.  This can only be set once per AI Filter, so calling this action multiple times with the same AI Filter will simply override previous calls.  Use this and the other "Tactical AI Filter" actions to set up an AI Filter, which can then be used in a "Tactical AI Filter - Run" function to filter a unit group.

3E80483C.name: Tactical AI Filter Life Per Marker
3E80483C.hint: Sets the specified AI Filter to only include units whose current life is greater than the number of specified markers currently on them times the value specified in the Each parameter.  In this context, markers are an AI system construct used to mark targets of abilities before the ability's effects execute.  Use this and the other "Tactical AI Filter" actions to set up an AI Filter, which can then be used in a "Tactical AI Filter - Run" function to filter a unit group.

408AB1E3.name: Tactical AI Filter Movement Plane
408AB1E3.hint: Sets the specified AI Filter to only include either air or ground units.  Use this and the other "Tactical AI Filter" actions to set up an AI Filter, which can then be used in a "Tactical AI Filter - Run" function to filter a unit group.

0ED83E6C.name: Tactical AI Filter Unit Filter
0ED83E6C.hint: Sets the specified AI Filter to only include units that match the criteria of the specified target filter.  Use this and the other "Tactical AI Filter" actions to set up an AI Filter, which can then be used in a "Tactical AI Filter - Run" function to filter a unit group.

BB3B2A79.name: Tactical AI Filter Shields
BB3B2A79.hint: Sets the specified AI Filter to only include units whose shields is within the specified range.  Use this and the other "Tactical AI Filter" actions to set up an AI Filter, which can then be used in a "Tactical AI Filter - Run" function to filter a unit group.

F5C599A6.name: Tactical AI Filter Energy
F5C599A6.hint: Sets the specified AI Filter to only include units whose energy is within the specified range.  Use this and the other "Tactical AI Filter" actions to set up an AI Filter, which can then be used in a "Tactical AI Filter - Run" function to filter a unit group.

329485DF.name: Beacon Is Auto Cast
329485DF.hint: Is autocast enabled for the specified beacon.

E78465C0.name: Beacon Is Set
E78465C0.hint: Is the specified beacon currently enabled.

E9B4AB04.name: Beacon Get Target Point
E9B4AB04.hint: Gets the target point of the specified beacon.

4C9C60B2.name: Beacon Get Target Unit
4C9C60B2.hint: Gets the target unit of the specified beacon, if there is one.

81D42ACF.name: Beacon Get Num Allies
81D42ACF.hint: Get the number of beacon allies this player has.

AA9CC64B.name: Beacon Get Ally PlayerId
AA9CC64B.hint: Get playerId for the given beacon ally.

90D9D6B1.name: Beacon Num Minerals Requested
90D9D6B1.hint: Get the outstanding minerals requested by this player.

E7A1FD48.name: Beacon Num Vespene Requested
E7A1FD48.hint: Get the outstanding vespene requested by this player.

FF813C01.name: Beacon Clear Target
FF813C01.hint: Clears the target of the specified beacon.

920815B9.name: Beacon Set AutoCast
920815B9.hint: Enables autocast for the specified beacon.

9F8D343B.name: Beacon Set Target Point
9F8D343B.hint: Sets the target for the specified beacon to be the specified point.

1593FCCC.name: Beacon Set Target Unit
1593FCCC.hint: Sets the target for the specified beacon to be the specified unit.

5295B368.name: Beacon Alert
5295B368.hint: Triggers the alert for the specified beacon.

B592FDBF.name: Lane Waypoint Get Closest Lane
B592FDBF.hint: Finds the lane closest to TestPoint  (note this function can be called any time and is not dependent on "Lane Waypoint Calc Closest Data For Lane").

6E450624.name: Lane Waypoint Get Calc Data Closest Waypoint Index
6E450624.hint: Returns the closest waypoint index calculated by the last call to  "Lane Waypoint Calc Closest Data For Lane".

25652AB5.name: Lane Waypoint Get Calc Data Second Waypoint Index
25652AB5.hint: Returns the secondary waypoint index calculated by the last call to  "Lane Waypoint Calc Closest Data For Lane".

372F1C16.name: Lane Waypoint Get Calc Data Closest Point
372F1C16.hint: Returns the closest point along the lane calculated by the last call to  "Lane Waypoint Calc Closest Data For Lane".

935BC487.name: Lane Waypoint Get Calc Data Closest Dist
935BC487.hint: Returns the distance to the closest point along the lane calculated by the last call to  "Lane Waypoint Calc Closest Data For Lane".

129C4A8B.name: Lane Waypoint Clear All
129C4A8B.hint: Clears all AI lane data including, closest calc data.

84571FC9.name: Lane Waypoint Add
84571FC9.hint: Adds a waypoint to the specified lane.

1C4095AE.name: Lane Waypoint Calc Closest Data For Lane
1C4095AE.hint: Calculates a handful of data for the closest point in the given TestLane to point TestPoint. Query the calculated data with the "Lane Waypoint Get Calc Data ___" functions.

6ECCAD6C.name: Play Animation
6ECCAD6C.hint: Plays an animation on an actor with a chosen name (Identifier).  The Identifier is used to clear the animation or otherwise modify it after it starts playing.

5DE3374D.name: Play Animation On Doodads In Region
5DE3374D.hint: Plays an animation with a chosen name (Identifier) on all of the doodads of the specified type in a region.  The Identifier is used to clear the animation or otherwise modify it after it starts playing.

9C8E59A4.name: Kill Doodads In Region
9C8E59A4.hint: Causes all of the doodads in the selected region to play their death animation (if they have one).

FFBC1D46.name: Clear Animation
FFBC1D46.hint: Clears an animation with the chosen name (Identifier) on an actor.

FD9B8C07.name: Clear Animation On Doodads In Region
FD9B8C07.hint: Clears an animation with the chosen name (Identifier) on all doodads of the specified type in the specified region.

DA979564.name: Turn Animation Properties On
DA979564.hint: Enable a special animation property. The unit must be set up to use the specified animation property. An example of an animation property is "Fly" for Terran production buildings. Use the Turn Animation Properties Off action to turn off the property that was turned on by this action.

A91CB770.name: Turn Animation Properties On With Blend In/Out
A91CB770.hint: Enable a special animation property, play the Blend In Animation when the property is turned on, and play the Blend Out Animation when the property is turned off. The unit must be set up to use the specified animation property. An example of an animation property is "Fly" for Terran production buildings. If the unit is not set up to use one of the Blend Animations, then it will ignore it. Use the Turn Animation Properties Off action to turn off the property that was turned on by this action.

62BF86AB.name: Turn Animation Properties Off
62BF86AB.hint: Turn off a special animation property. The unit must have the specified animation properties turned on (which can be done through one of the Turn Animation Properties On actions). An example of an animation property is "Fly" for Terran production buildings.

35920A8D.name: Turn All Animation Properties Off
35920A8D.hint: Clears any set animation properties for the chosen target.  An example of an animation property is "Fly" for Terran production buildings.

27719FBE.name: Query Animation Length By Identifier
27719FBE.hint: Starts a query for the animation length and animation time remaining of the specific animation name for the given actor.  Note that the animation length and remaining time may vary from player to player due to different game states or localities.  This function will query the maximum length and maximum remaining time of all players when there are different values.  Note that you may only do 512 animation length queries maximum in a single game.  Use the "Last Animation Query" function to get a handle to this query which can be used to get the information retrieved after the query is complete.

43A613E5.name: Query Animation Length By Props
43A613E5.hint: Starts a query for the animation length of the specific animation props for the given actor.  Note that the animation length time may vary from player to player due to different game states or localities.  This function will query the maximum length time of all players when there are different values.  Note that you may only do 512 animation length queries maximum in a single game.  Use the "Last Animation Query" function to get a handle to this query which can be used to get the information retrieved after the query is complete.

90A266F3.name: Wait for Animation Length Queries
90A266F3.hint: Waits until all queries sent with "Query Animation Length" functions have been received for all players.

65BF0787.name: Wait for Animation
65BF0787.hint: Waits until an animation is a specified amount of seconds from the offset type.   Note that the animations and animation times may vary from player to player due to different game states or localities so this waits for all players to report that they have reached the specified point.

B07868B5.name: Animation Length
B07868B5.hint: Returns the animation length previously queried.  Pass this function the handle returned by the "Last Animation Query" to get the value, but make sure that you call Wait for Animation Length Queries first to ensure that the animation query is finished.

A7B1D22F.name: Animation Time Remaining
A7B1D22F.hint: Returns the animation time remaining previously queried.  Pass this function the handle returned by the "Last Animation Query" functions to get the value, but make sure that you call Wait for Animation first to ensure that the animation query is finished.  This function is only valid with a handle created by "Query Animation Length By Name".

02FF6712.name: Set Animation Time
02FF6712.hint: Skips ahead in an animation, chosen by the Identifier parameter, to a time chosen by the Time value. If the Scaled parameter is set to Absolute, the time will be set according to the actual length of the animation for the model. If the Scaled parameter is set to Scaled, the time will be set relevent to the animation length determined by the actor controlling the animation.

28E8EEF6.name: Set Animation Time Scale
28E8EEF6.hint: Sets the length of an animation, chosen by the Identifier parameter, to the Scale parameter relevant to the actual length of the animation for the model.

477043D4.name: Set Animation Completion
477043D4.hint: Sets the progress completion percent for an animation.  Does the same thing as "Set Animation Time", but with different parameters.

34DE36C4.name: Set Animation Duration
34DE36C4.hint: Set the amount of seconds to play a specified animation.

153AEC4D.name: Load Model Animation
153AEC4D.hint: Loads a specified animation for a model.  Note: This is a specialized action that generally relates to storymode models.  It allows a model to load an additional set of animations set up for it.  If a model is not set up to have additional animations, this action will not work.

44BDDDF8.name: Load Overriding Model Animation
44BDDDF8.hint: Loads a specified animation for a model, and invalidates any existing duplicate sequences that already exist in the model.  Note: This is a specialized action that generally relates to storymode models.  It allows a model to load an additional set of animations set up for it.  If a model is not set up to have additional animations, this action will not work.

E8A7971D.name: Unload Model Animation
E8A7971D.hint: Loads a specified animation for a model.  Note: This is a specialized action that generally relates to storymode models.  It will remove additional animation sets that have been loaded to the model through triggers.

61E6CFB3.name: Load Animation for Unit Type
61E6CFB3.hint: Loads an animation for a unit.  Note: This is a specialized action that generally relates to storymode models.  It allows a model to load an additional set of animations set up for it.  If a model is not set up to have additional animations, this action will not work.

DF8E92F0.name: Load Overriding Animation for Unit Type
DF8E92F0.hint: Loads an animation for a unit, and invalidates any existing duplicate sequences that already exist.  Note: This is a specialized action that generally relates to storymode models.  It allows a model to load an additional set of animations set up for it.  If a model is not set up to have additional animations, this action will not work.

910C6A86.name: Unload Animation for Unit Type
910C6A86.hint: Unloads an animation for a unit.  Note: This is a specialized action that generally relates to storymode models.  It will remove additional animation sets that have been loaded to the model through triggers.

00000292.name: Open Bank
00000292.hint: Opens a bank with the name specified by the Name parameter, for the chosen Player. If a bank with the specified name does not already exist, one will be created for the chosen player. A bank is an xml file where you can store information for later use, even across maps. It's a good method of saving information to pass between maps in a custom campaign or multiple part custom map. See the "Store Boolean" action for further information.

00000279.name: Last Opened Bank
00000279.hint: Returns the last bank that was opened.

D315D984.name: Reload Bank
D315D984.hint: Reloads the specified bank file, allowing you to access stored values later. If a bank has unsaved changes they will be lost when it reloads.

00000294.name: Save Bank
00000294.hint: Saves the specified bank file, allowing you to access stored values later. If a bank is not saved, any changes made to it will be lost when the mission ends.

7D278C76.name: Preload Bank
7D278C76.hint: Literal values must be used for the bank name and player (no variables or expressions).  The specified bank data will be synchronized for all players when the game first loads.

00000298.name: Store Boolean
00000298.hint: Stores a Boolean value to the specified Bank. The Section and Key parameters determine where the value is stored in the bank file, and must be used to load the value later. You must save a bank after storing a value, otherwise the value will not exist to load later.

00000299.name: Store Integer
00000299.hint: Stores an Integer value to the specified Bank. The Section and Key parameters determine where the value is stored in the bank file, and must be used to load the value later. You must save a bank after storing a value, otherwise the value will not exist to load later.

2CC865FE.name: Store Point
2CC865FE.hint: Stores a Point value to the specified Bank. The Section and Key parameters determine where the value is stored in the bank file, and must be used to load the value later. You must save a bank after storing a value, otherwise the value will not exist to load later.

00000297.name: Store Real
00000297.hint: Stores a Real value to the specified Bank. The Section and Key parameters determine where the value is stored in the bank file, and must be used to load the value later. You must save a bank after storing a value, otherwise the value will not exist to load later.

00000300.name: Store String
00000300.hint: Stores a String value to the specified Bank. The Section and Key parameters determine where the value is stored in the bank file, and must be used to load the value later. You must save a bank after storing a value, otherwise the value will not exist to load later.

949CCAA4.name: Store Text
949CCAA4.hint: Stores a Text value to the specified Bank. The Section and Key parameters determine where the value is stored in the bank file, and must be used to load the value later. You must save a bank after storing a value, otherwise the value will not exist to load later.

00000301.name: Store Unit
00000301.hint: Stores a Unit in the specified Bank. The Section and Key parameters determine where the Unit is stored in the bank file, and must be used to restore the unit later. You must save a bank after storing a value, otherwise the value will not exist to load later. Unit values are recalled with the "Restore Unit" action.

00000304.name: Load Boolean Value
00000304.hint: Returns a Boolean value contained in the chosen Bank at the specified Key of the specified Section.

00000305.name: Load Integer Value
00000305.hint: Returns an Integer value contained in the chosen Bank at the specified Key of the specified Section.

C45A90C0.name: Load Point Value
C45A90C0.hint: Returns a Point value contained in the chosen Bank at the specified Key of the specified Section.

00000303.name: Load Real Value
00000303.hint: Returns a Real value contained in the chosen Bank at the specified Key of the specified Section.

00000306.name: Load String Value
00000306.hint: Returns a String value contained in the chosen Bank at the specified Key of the specified Section.

543F43E3.name: Load Text Value
543F43E3.hint: Returns a Text value contained in the chosen Bank at the specified Key of the specified Section.

00000307.name: Restore Unit
00000307.hint: Restores a unit contained in the chosen Bank at the specified Key of the specified Section. The unit will be created for the specified Player, at the specified Position, facing a specified Angle.

5052436B.name: Last Restored Unit
5052436B.hint: Returns the last unit that was restored from a bank.

8F9FB053.name: Remove Bank Backup
8F9FB053.hint: Removes the backup bank with specific backup id for the associated playerid

4BD87DC7.name: Get Bank Backup Id
4BD87DC7.hint: Retrieve the bank backup id associated with the backup bank

4B1AD9CE.name: Get Bank Backup Latest Id
4B1AD9CE.hint: Retrieve the latest bank backup id associated with the backup bank

488EC470.name: Restore Bank Backup
488EC470.hint: Restores the original bank with the contents from its backup bank with backup id if it exists, for the particular player. The backup bank will always look for your passed in bank name with an appended on "_backup_#" string.

4CD4BA5A.name: Backup Bank
4CD4BA5A.hint: Creates a backup of the passed in bank and saves it into another bank with the same name appended with a "_backup_#" string in a backup directory where your banks are saved. This can only be called from either the MapInit event or Generic event.

00000280.name: Bank Exists
00000280.hint: Returns true if a bank, chosen by the Name parameter, exists for the chosen Player.

6D3A94D4.name: Bank Size As Text
6D3A94D4.hint: Returns the size in bytes of a bank, chosen by the Name parameter, for the chosen Player.

00000281.name: Bank Name
00000281.hint: Returns the name of the chosen bank.

00000288.name: Bank Key Exists
00000288.hint: Returns true if the chosen Bank has an entry at the specified Key of the specified Section.

03D3698A.name: Bank Key Size As Text
03D3698A.hint: Returns the size in bytes of the Key, chosen by Integer position, of the specified Section of the chosen Bank.

00000285.name: Bank Key Name
00000285.hint: Returns the string name of the Key, chosen by Integer position, of the specified Section of the chosen Bank.

00000284.name: Bank Key Count
00000284.hint: Returns the number of keys in the specified Section of the chosen Bank.

82EFE368.name: Bank Player
82EFE368.hint: Returns the player associated with the chosen bank.

00000287.name: Bank Section Exists
00000287.hint: Returns true if the specified Section exists in the chosen Bank.

F1B693ED.name: Bank Section Size As Text
F1B693ED.hint: Returns the size in bytes of the Section in the chosen Bank

00000283.name: Bank Section Name
00000283.hint: Returns the name of the Section, chosen by Integer position, of the chosen Bank.

00000282.name: Bank Section Count
00000282.hint: Returns the number of sections in the chosen Bank.

00000289.name: Bank Value Is Type
00000289.hint: Returns true if the value contained in the chosen Bank at the specified Key of the specified Section is of the chosen Type.

739C27F4.name: Delete Saved Campaign Banks
739C27F4.hint: Deletes all the saved campaign banks specified in GameUIData for the Campaign specified by the campaign index.

7730D3D7.name: Create Bank Section
7730D3D7.hint: Creates a specific Section in the chosen Bank. Existing keys are preserved if the section already exists.

00000293.name: Remove Bank
00000293.hint: Removes the bank from the cache and no longer allows values to be written to it.

00000296.name: Remove Bank Key
00000296.hint: Removes a specific bank Key from a section in the chosen bank.

00000295.name: Remove Bank Section
00000295.hint: Removes a specific Section, and all of its keys, from the chosen Bank.

0C6E8984.name: Verify Bank
0C6E8984.hint: Returns true if the signature option is enabled and the signature matches the data in the bank. The signature is only computed when a bank is loaded at startup.

247BCDF4.name: Pick Each Bank Backup
247BCDF4.hint: Loop through all of the bank backups associated with the original bank, if descending order is false it will traverse the banks from oldest to newest, if descending order is true it will traverse the banks from newest to oldest

3FFA5A93.name: Picked Bank Backup
3FFA5A93.hint: The current bank backup within the current bank backup iteration.

47D6D6BB.name: Remove Behaviors By Category
47D6D6BB.hint: Removes all behaviors that belong to the specified category from the specified unit.

25B39578.name: Remove Behavior (Player)
25B39578.hint: Removes a behavior from the specified unit, setting the casting player to the specified player.

09840835.name: Remove Behavior
09840835.hint: Removes a behavior from a unit.

CB774E72.name: Add Behavior (Player)
CB774E72.hint: Adds a behavior to the specified unit setting the casting player to the specified player.

C47C0524.name: Add Behavior
C47C0524.hint: Adds a behavior to the specified unit setting the casting unit to the specified caster.

2560791C.name: Number Of Behaviors On Unit
2560791C.hint: Returns the number of behaviors on a unit.

00000387.name: Unit Behavior
00000387.hint: Returns the behavior at the specified index on the specified unit.

142FF15A.name: Unit Has Behavior
142FF15A.hint: Returns true if the specified unit has the specified behavior.

ABD41ECF.name: Unit Has Behavior (Enabled)
ABD41ECF.hint: Returns true if the stack count for this behavior is > 0

6C8E411D.name: Unit Behavior Enabled
6C8E411D.hint: Returns true if the specified unit has the specified behavior enabled.

00000386.name: Stack Count Of Behavior On Unit
00000386.hint: Returns the stack count of a behavior on a unit.

222E921E.name: Behavior Has Flag
222E921E.hint: Returns true if the behavior has a specified flag.

00000258.name: Transfer Behavior
00000258.hint: Transfers a behavior from a source unit to a destination unit.

5D218339.name: Set Unit Behavior Duration
5D218339.hint: Sets a behavior duration on a unit.

0A1BADFB.name: Set Unit Behavior Duration Remaining
0A1BADFB.hint: Sets a behavior remaining duration on a unit.

09C6C463.name: Duration Remaining Of Behavior On Unit
09C6C463.hint: Gets a behavior remaining duration on a unit.

576B4EA1.name: Duration Of Behavior On Unit
576B4EA1.hint: Gets a behavior duration on a unit.

83BEEF42.name: Set Unit Behavior Spawn Count
83BEEF42.hint: Modifies the number of spawned units controlled by a behavior. If a behavior is not specified, it will affect all spawned behaviors.

11DBA81B.name: Set Unit Behavior User Data
11DBA81B.hint: Sets a behavior user data on a unit.

F65E1732.name: User Data Of Behavior On Unit
F65E1732.hint: Gets a behavior user data on a unit.

898C5A5D.name: User Data Of Behavior On Unit Exists

00000355.name: Triggering Behavior
00000355.hint: Returns the triggering behavior.  Used in response to "Unit Attribute Change", "Unit Gains Experience", or "Unit Gains Experience Level".

0307583A.name: Unit Behavior Damage Modify Remaining
0307583A.hint: Returns the damage modify remaining for the specified behavior's damage response for the given unit

D507B76C.name: Unit Behavior Damage Modify Limit
D507B76C.hint: Returns the damage modify limit for the specified behavior's damage response for the given unit

958D756B.name: For Each Behavior On Unit
958D756B.hint: Runs the contained actions once for each unit in the unit group.

F0E3F78B.name: Unit Attribute Point
F0E3F78B.hint: Returns the point count of the an attribute behavior on a unit.

3EE18973.name: Set Unit Attribute Point
3EE18973.hint: Sets attribute point on a unit.

652106DC.name: Unit Conjoined Group
652106DC.hint: Returns the conjoined group of a unit given a conjoined behavior

6C135AD4.name: Unit Tracked Group
6C135AD4.hint: Returns the tracked unit group of a unit given a unit tracker behavior

4B4B6564.name: Add Unit To Shared Tracked Unit List
4B4B6564.hint: Adds a behavior to the specified unit setting the casting unit to the specified caster.

72D06237.name: BitMaskSetIndex
72D06237.hint: Sets a flag on the bit mask either on or off depending on the boolean Set On. Returns true if the setting worked.

30D85A7D.name: MakeEmptyBitMask
30D85A7D.hint: Makes a completely zeroed out BitMask

DE45F595.name: BitMaskIsEqual
DE45F595.hint: Compares two bit masks for total equality on all flags.

C29F8A41.name: BitMaskTrueIndex
C29F8A41.hint: Returns true if the index is set to 1 in the bit mask.

CA455926.name: BitMaskFalseIndex
CA455926.hint: Returns true if the index is set to 0 in the bit mask.

385D9069.name: BitMaskCountOnBits
385D9069.hint: Counts all the ones in the bit mask.

D79B5E14.name: BitMaskAndBitMask
D79B5E14.hint: Ands the two BitMasks together placing the result in the Receiving BitMask (LHS = LHS & RHS)

E2D0649C.name: BitMaskOrBitMask
E2D0649C.hint: Ors the two BitMasks together placing the result in the Receiving BitMask (LHS = LHS | RHS)

B6ED82BE.name: BitMaskXorBitMask
B6ED82BE.hint: Xors the two BitMasks together placing the result in the Receiving BitMask (LHS = LHS ^ RHS)

2539ACD3.name: BitMaskInvert
2539ACD3.hint: Applies a negation to all the bits in the BitMask (BitMask = !BitMask)

17A7CF59.name: BitMaskLeftShift
17A7CF59.hint: Left shifts the receiving BitMask by count (receiving << count)

EBA91B3C.name: BitMaskRightShift
EBA91B3C.hint: Right shifts the receiving BitMask by count (receiving >> count)

D16EE5F6.name: ForEachSetBitInBitMask
D16EE5F6.hint: Executes a For Loop using an integer value. This will run the action set included under the For Each Bit In BitMask for every bit in mask.

4DED547D.name: ForEachUnSetBitInBitMask
4DED547D.hint: Executes a For Loop using an integer value. This will run the action set included under the For Each Bit In BitMask for every bit in mask.

A1037B3E.name: Apply Camera Object
A1037B3E.hint: Sets a players camera to a camera object.  If you choose to Include Target, then the specified player's camera will also jump to the target point of the specified camera object.  Otherwise, only the camera object's properties will be applied to the specified player's camera.

00000200.name: Default Game Camera
00000200.hint: Returns the default game camera settings.

DC635AEF.name: Pan Camera
DC635AEF.hint: Pans the camera to the center of a region or point.  If smart panning is enabled, the camera will not pan if it is already looking at the target point.

20A06660.name: Make Camera Look At
20A06660.hint: Adjusts the camera to look at the new target point without changing the camera eye position.

F6460765.name: Camera Target Of Player
F6460765.hint: Returns the current camera target of a player.  Camera targets are tracked for all players in a multiplayer game, but the queried locations will be slightly old due to network latency.

D3A0F4D6.name: Camera Pitch of Player
D3A0F4D6.hint: Returns the current camera pitch of a player.  Camera pitch is tracked for all players in a multiplayer game, but the queried locations will be slightly old due to network latency.

797E4DA3.name: Camera Yaw of Player
797E4DA3.hint: Returns the current camera yaw of a player.  Camera yaw is tracked for all players in a multiplayer game, but the queried locations will be slightly old due to network latency.

041CCAB6.name: Camera Distance of Player
041CCAB6.hint: Returns the current camera distance of a player.  Camera distance is tracked for all players in a multiplayer game, but the queried locations will be slightly old due to network latency.

503F3DE6.name: Save Camera
503F3DE6.hint: Saves the current camera configurations.  You can recall the camera settings using "Restore Camera".

9A0D729F.name: Restore Camera
9A0D729F.hint: Restores the camera to a previously saved configuration.  You can save camera settings using "Save Camera".

0F98C681.name: Set Camera Channel On Portrait
0F98C681.hint: In order to use this, you must first create a portrait through triggers.  You can then use this action to have a camera object on that portrait render to a render-to-texture channel.

8E9C5755.name: Clear Camera Channel On Portrait
8E9C5755.hint: Stops a portrait from rendering to a render-to-texture channel.

00000360.name: Use Model Camera
00000360.hint: Uses the camera setting that is specific to a unit.  This is primarily for model assets which have a built in camera, such as Portraits.

8ED9E26A.name: Set Camera Channel
8ED9E26A.hint: Sets a model camera for the specified unit to be rendered to the specified render-to-texture channel.

A2798799.name: Clear Camera Channel
A2798799.hint: Stops a model camera from using the specified render-to-texture channel.

00000326.name: Lock Camera Input
00000326.hint: Locks the camera in place for a player, causing the player to be unable to move the camera in any way.

F470860B.name: Set Camera Bounds
F470860B.hint: Sets the camera bounds within a region. This will limit the specified Players from moving their camera beyond the specified Bounds. If the Minimap parameter is set to Do, the minimap will also shrink to fit the camera bounds. This is useful for hiding things off map, or having the playable area expand at some point during your map.

F813558C.name: Shake Camera
F813558C.hint: Shakes the camera. If the Duration parameter is set to 0, it will shake the camera until stopped by the "Stop Shaking Camera" action. This action is useful for things such as explosions or earthquakes.

3766D08E.name: Zoom Camera
3766D08E.hint: Zoom the camera in on a location.

B34FAB70.name: Follow Unit Group with Camera
B34FAB70.hint: Follows a unit group with the camera.

350F6D67.name: Unit Group Followed By Camera
350F6D67.hint: Follows a unit group with the camera.

E750A66A.name: Force Follow Unit Group with Camera
E750A66A.hint: Toggles whether the camera is forced to follow the active follow unit group. If it is not forced to follow then it will rely on the player's local follow state.

6892B8B1.name: Make Camera Look At And Follow Unit
6892B8B1.hint: Make the camera target follow a unit, without changing the camera eye position. Use 'No Unit' to stop looking at any unit.

6474C738.name: Make Camera Look At And Follow Actor
6474C738.hint: Make the camera target follow an actor, without changing the camera eye position. Use 'No Actor' to stop looking at any actor.

A5CC6797.name: Lock Camera Mouse Relative Mode On/Off
A5CC6797.hint: When this is turned on, it will make all of a player's mouse movements act as if that player was drag-scrolling (holding down the middle mouse button).  This will hide the mouse cursor.  Use in conjunction with "Turn Camera Mouse Rotation On/Off" to make an FPS-style camera.

4A0C1B53.name: Turn Camera Mouse Rotation On/Off
4A0C1B53.hint: When this is turned on, it will make a player's drag-scroll camera movements rotate the camera in a free look fashion rather than drag the camera.  Use in conjunction with "Lock Camera Mouse Relative Mode On/Off" to make an FPS-style camera.

B7D9F0B0.name: Set Camera Mouse Rotation Speed
B7D9F0B0.hint: Sets the yaw or pitch sensitivity of the camera when camera mouse rotation is turned on.

EA3823E9.name: Turn Camera Height Displacement On/Off
EA3823E9.hint: When this is enabled, and the camera is following a flying unit, the camera will adjust its height to ensure the flying unit stays visible when the camera zooms in.

A964CB90.name: Turn Camera Height Smoothing On/Off
A964CB90.hint: When this is enabled, the camera will transition between terrain height changes smoothly.

6CEA924D.name: Turn Camera Vertical Field Of View On/Off
6CEA924D.hint: By default, the horizontal screen space is preserved between aspect ratios, and the vertical space gets cropped or expanded as necessary.  When vertical field of view is turned on, the vertical screen space will be preserved between aspect ratios, and the horizontal space will get cropped or expanded as necessary.

FEC6DC29.name: Camera Moves

2F74B2A2.name: Camera Move Reason

9755B9B4.name: Apply Camera Property

00000203.name: Set Camera Object Target

40DE9B0A.name: Copy Of Camera Object
40DE9B0A.hint: Returns a copy of a set camera object.

E6AB7041.name: Catalog Entry Is Valid

00000378.hint: Returns the ID of a catalog entry from its index in the catalog.  Use catalog lookup functions to retrieve a data value or other information from the game data.

AD46099F.name: Catalog Field Is Array

855AF166.name: Catalog Field Is Scope

00000383.hint: Returns the value of a field for an entry.  Use catalog lookup functions to retrieve a data value or other information from the game data.  To find the name of a field path, open the data editor and turn on View Raw Data. For example, if you wanted to get the unit for the first index of a train ability, your field path string would be "InfoArray[0].Unit".

13FCF4F1.name: Catalog Field Value Get Flags As Integer
13FCF4F1.hint: Returns the value of a CFlags or CFlagArray field for an entry as an integer so bitwise math can be done on it.  Use catalog lookup functions to retrieve a data value or other information from the game data.  To find the name of a field path, open the data editor and turn on View Raw Data.

For example, if you wanted to get the unit for the first index of a train ability, your field path string would be "InfoArray[0].Unit".

4E004004.name: Catalog Field Value Count
4E004004.hint: Returns the count of the values for a field for an entry.  Returns 0 if the specified field is not an array.  Use catalog lookup functions to retrieve a data value or other information from the game data.  To find the name of a field path, open the data editor and turn on View Raw Data. For example, if you wanted to get the number of active indicies for a train ability, your field path string would be "InfoArray".

DC731674.name: Class Of Ability
DC731674.hint: Returns the ability type of an ability.  This is the non raw data version of an ability's scope.  Use catalog lookup functions to retrieve a data value or other information from the game data.

9A69046F.name: Cost Of Ability
9A69046F.hint: Returns one of the costs of an ability.  Use catalog lookup functions to retrieve a data value or other information from the game data.

B6E64ADB.name: For Each Catalog Entry In Catalog
B6E64ADB.hint: Runs the contained actions once for each entry in the catalog (default entries does not count).

224BC9ED.name: For Each Value In Catalog Field Array
224BC9ED.hint: Runs the contained actions once for each value for a field for an entry.

5FD44C2E.name: For Each Scope Field Value In Catalog Field Scope Array
5FD44C2E.hint: Runs the contained actions once for each value for a field for an entry.

03D7A0F2.name: Catalog Field Value Set
03D7A0F2.hint: Sets the value of a field for an entry.  To find the name of a field path, open the data editor and turn on View Raw Data.  For example, if you wanted to set the unit for the first index of a train ability, your field path string would be "InfoArray[0].Unit".

22AACFEE.name: Catalog Field Value Set As Real
22AACFEE.hint: Sets the value of a field for an entry.  To find the name of a field path, open the data editor and turn on View Raw Data.  For example, if you wanted to set the unit for the first index of a train ability, your field path string would be "InfoArray[0].Unit".

16F885F6.name: Catalog Field Value Modify (Based On Default Value)
16F885F6.hint: Modifies the value of a field for an entry based on the default value instead of the current value.  To find the name of a field path, open the data editor and turn on View Raw Data.  For example, if you wanted to set the unit for the first index of a train ability, your field path string would be "InfoArray[0].Unit".

02E83924.hint: Sets the value of a field for an entry.  To find the name of a field path, open the data editor and turn on View Raw Data.  For example, if you wanted to set the unit for the first index of a train ability, your field path string would be "InfoArray[0].Unit".

804105E9.hint: Sets the value of a field for an entry.  To find the name of a field path, open the data editor and turn on View Raw Data.  For example, if you wanted to set the unit for the first index of a train ability, your field path string would be "InfoArray[0].Unit".

D0BCDC98.hint: Most game functionality will switch to using the replacement value when possible instead of the original value.
