E92E544E.name: Cinematic Mode
E92E544E.hint: Turns on/off cinematic mode for a player(s). Cinematic mode hides the normal gameplay UI.  When cinematic mode is turned on, the state of the gameplay UI is cached, and when cinematic mode is turned off, the state of the gameplay UI is restored from that cache.  Therefore, changing visibility settings of gameplay UI elements while cinematic mode is turned on will have no effect.  This mode will also mute certain sound channels.

4A703103.name: Global Cinematic Setting
4A703103.hint: Turns on/off the aspects of cinematic mode that are not player-specific, such as game speed.  This will also turn on fixed random seed, so random rolls done while in cinematic mode will come out the same every time it is run.  These settings affect all players, so this action should not be used if some players in a game are viewing a cinematic while others are not.  This action is intended to be used in conjunction with the "Cinematic Mode" action.

8FFC90F3.name: Global Cinematic Setting (Fixed Seed On/Off)
8FFC90F3.hint: Turns on/off the aspects of cinematic mode that are not player-specific, such as game speed.  This will also turn on fixed random seed, so random rolls done while in cinematic mode will come out the same every time it is run.  These settings affect all players, so this action should not be used if some players in a game are viewing a cinematic while others are not.  This action is intended to be used in conjunction with the "Cinematic Mode" action.

E3C77ACF.name: Set Cinematic Transition Style
E3C77ACF.hint: Changes the behavior when transitioning to/from cinematic mode.  When set to Story, transmissions will not be stopped automatically.

0B5CB9F5.name: Player In Cinematic Mode
0B5CB9F5.hint: Returns true if the specified player has cinematic mode turned on.

7A4A515F.name: Run Cinematic
7A4A515F.hint: Runs a cinematic defined through the Cinematics window in the editor.  Use "Stop Cinematic" to stop the cinematic.

F9878BEF.name: Stop Cinematic
F9878BEF.hint: Stops any active cinematic that has been run using "Run Cinematic".

D8A9F49F.name: Fade In/Out
D8A9F49F.hint: Fades the screen in or out over a specified amount of time.  If you want to fade in from a Cutscene, use Cutscene fade.

AB32F40C.name: Overlay Image
AB32F40C.hint: Fade in or out a texture overlay over a specified amount of time.

D2ED8E96.name: Select Main Shadow Light
D2ED8E96.hint: Selects a light to be the main shadow-casting light for the current scene.  If Light Name is set to a blank string, this will attempt to select the default shadow light for the current scene.

5589BD13.name: Movie Start Recording
5589BD13.hint: Starts the recording of a movie in the *.ogg format, with the specified name. Only one movie can be recorded at a time. Starting a new recording will stop a movie that is currently being recorded. The file is saved in the "My Documents\Starcraft II\Videos" folder of the user.

734836A8.name: Movie Add SubTitle (String)
734836A8.hint: When recording a movie, this function add a subtitle to the movie event file, it will be used at the specified time stamp when the movie is played back.  If 'timeStamp' is -1, current recording time is used.

D4E8CABF.name: Movie Add SubTitle (Text)
D4E8CABF.hint: When recording a movie, this function add a subtitle to the movie event file, it will be used at the specified time stamp when the movie is played back.  If 'timeStamp' is -1, current recording time is used.

3515E6EC.name: Movie Add Trigger Function
3515E6EC.hint: When recording a movie, this function add a trigger function to the movie event file, it will be called at the specified time stamp when the movie is played back.  If 'timeStamp' is -1, current recording time is used.

8ADA537A.name: Movie Dynamic Subtitles and Duration
8ADA537A.hint: When recording a movie, this function add a subtitle to the movie event file at the current recording time, dynamically pulling the text and duration from a sound entry.

368847BB.name: Movie Function
368847BB.hint: This event is only usable if you play a movie texture on a model, and that movie texture has a .event file with the same name as the movie texture.  The .event file can specify times when the movie should send an event to the trigger system.  Each event in the .event file has a name that must be specified in the Function Name parameter if you want to respond to that event.

FB8BE4F2.name: Create Conversation
FB8BE4F2.hint: Creates a conversation.  Conversations can be used to create interactive character dialogue that allows a player to select from a list of replies.  Conversations can be created purely through triggers, or created in data, and run via triggers. Cinematic mode must be enabled using the Cinematic Mode action to view conversation choices.

00000429.name: Last Created Conversation Reply
00000429.hint: Returns the last created conversation reply.

4EAAEF83.name: Show/Hide Conversation
4EAAEF83.hint: Shows or hides a conversation for a player group.

00000427.name: Conversation Is Visible
00000427.hint: Returns true if the conversation is visible for the specified player.

00000430.name: Conversation Reply Selected
00000430.hint: This event fires when the specified player selects the specified reply from the specified conversation.  Use "Selected Conversation" to get the conversation and "Selected Conversation Reply" to get the reply.

34032A0C.name: Set Conversation Reply Text
34032A0C.hint: Sets the text for a conversation reply.

00000425.name: Remove Conversation Reply
00000425.hint: Removes a reply from a conversation.

B74ED594.name: Remove All Conversation Replies
B74ED594.hint: Removes all replies from a conversation.

7F3583EE.name: Conversation Reply State
7F3583EE.hint: Returns the reply state for the specified conversation reply.

DC33CC5B.name: Conversation Reply Index
DC33CC5B.hint: Returns the index of the specified conversation reply.

27EC1771.name: Conversation Reply Text
27EC1771.hint: Returns the text of the specified conversation reply.

11E3E4E8.name: Mark Conversation Reply As Read/Unread
11E3E4E8.hint: Marks a conversation reply as either read or unread.

A8967217.name: Convert Integer To Conversation State Index
A8967217.hint: Returns the conversation state index for the given conversation state and integer index.

6F9EA069.name: Set Data Conversation State
6F9EA069.hint: Sets a conversation state to an integer.

DAC9B6F4.name: Set Data Conversation Portrait
DAC9B6F4.hint: Sets a portrait to be used for a given character during data-driven conversations.

980B0F3D.name: Set Data Conversation Unit
980B0F3D.hint: Sets a conversation state to a unit.

AE81B9B9.name: Set Data Conversation Camera
AE81B9B9.hint: Sets a camera to be used and a trigger to be run when the specified camera state and character state are reached.

01E8D3AB.name: Run Data Conversation
01E8D3AB.hint: Runs a conversation for the specified player group. If the conversation contains Choices, cinematic mode must be enabled to view them, using the Cinematic Mode action.

1A5B4F15.name: Data Conversation State Changed
1A5B4F15.hint: This event fires when the specified conversation state is changed during a data conversation, or when it is changed through the "Set Data Conversation State" action.  Use "Triggering Conversation State" to get the conversation state.

A1D59D71.name: Triggering Conversation State
A1D59D71.hint: Returns the conversation state in response to Data Conversation State Changed events.

E9BC63EC.name: Mark Data Conversation Choice As Read/Unread
E9BC63EC.hint: Marks a conversation choice as either read or unread.

04D1BB21.name: Mark Data Conversation Choice As Picked/Unpicked
04D1BB21.hint: Marks a conversation choice as either picked or unpicked.

771DB1E0.name: Set Data Conversation Line Picked Count
771DB1E0.hint: Sets the picked count for a conversation line.

1852EE72.name: Set Data Conversation Line Players
1852EE72.hint: Set the conversation line to only play for the given players. This overrides the players associated with the entire conversation, but cannot add players that are not viewing the conversation itself.

CDDDE678.name: Reset Data Conversation Line Players
CDDDE678.hint: Reset the conversation line to play for the default players associated with the entire conversation.

9226CEAC.name: Show/Hide Data Conversation Line For Observers
9226CEAC.hint: When hidden, the line will never be played for observers. When showing, the line will be played as long as it is visible to any player being observed.

A8C803FF.name: Set Data Conversation Listener Gender
A8C803FF.hint: The listener gender will be used to look for alternate text or sound data associated with voice overs.

1BC8CC89.name: Save Data Conversation State Value
1BC8CC89.hint: Saves a specific conversation state value to a bank section.

21AA98D4.name: Load Data Conversation State Value
21AA98D4.hint: Loads a specific conversation state value from a bank section.

D2CACC80.name: Save Data Conversation State Values
D2CACC80.hint: Saves all state values within the given conversation state to a bank section.

C89D042F.name: Load Data Conversation State Values
C89D042F.hint: Loads all state values of the given conversation state from a bank section.

F4A801D6.name: Reset Data Conversation State Values
F4A801D6.hint: Resets all state values of the given conversation state back to zero.

FD5F371E.name: Save Data Conversation Lines And Choices
FD5F371E.hint: Saves the picked states of all choices and lines within the given conversation to a bank section.

492B0420.name: Load Data Conversation Lines And Choices
492B0420.hint: Loads the picked states of all choices and lines for the given conversation from a bank section.

5655BFB2.name: Reset Data Conversation Lines And Choices
5655BFB2.hint: Resets the picked states of all choices and lines for the given conversation back to the default unread state.

79B97088.name: Preload Data Conversation Lines
79B97088.hint: Preloads sound files for all lines available to be run within the given conversation.

DB9FF4B2.name: Preload Data Conversation Lines For Next Map
DB9FF4B2.hint: Preloads sound files for all lines available to be run within the given conversation.

E167919B.name: Simulate Data Conversation
E167919B.hint: Changes all appropriate conversation state as if the given conversation had been run.

3640318E.name: Data Conversation State

0D536382.name: Data Conversation State Count
0D536382.hint: Returns the number of individual state values within a state definition.

03FCA0F4.name: Data Conversation State Name

8E8800DE.name: Data Conversation State Custom Value

D629F083.name: Data Conversation State Movie

23C055F5.name: Data Conversation State Model
23C055F5.hint: Returns a model associated with the given conversation state. The info name corresponds with the 'Info Name' field defined in the state.

7AECAA34.name: Data Conversation State Text
7AECAA34.hint: Returns display text associated with the given conversation state. The text name corresponds with the 'Info Name' field defined in the state.

0671F90F.name: Data Conversation State Text Tag Edge
0671F90F.hint: Returns the text tag edge associated with the given conversation state.

7F3B8C11.name: Data Conversation State Upgrade
7F3B8C11.hint: Returns an upgrade associated with the given conversation state. The info name corresponds with the 'Info Name' field defined in the state.

BC670F99.name: Data Conversation State Ability Command
BC670F99.hint: Returns an ability command associated with the given conversation state. The info name corresponds with the 'Info Name' field defined in the state.

A6CB6DE1.name: Data Conversation State Attachment Point
A6CB6DE1.hint: Returns the attachment point associated with the given conversation state.

995D0B63.name: Data Conversation Can Be Run
995D0B63.hint: Returns true if the conversation has any active lines or choices to be run using the current state.

2D87461D.name: Data Conversation Choice Count

2762F358.name: Data Conversation Choice Name

16145DBD.name: Data Conversation Choice Picked

30B91587.name: Data Conversation Choice Picked Count

72E4CB68.name: Data Conversation Choice State

F32154E6.name: Data Conversation Lines With Tag

1CB17B1A.name: Data Conversation Sound
1CB17B1A.hint: Returns the sound associated with the given conversation line. If conditions are checked and fail, no line will be returned.

4F73B77F.name: Data Conversation Speaker

0B9E950C.name: Active Data Conversation Camera

7C65EA1E.name: Active Data Conversation Line

B93884B7.name: Active Data Conversation Sound
B93884B7.hint: Returns the sound associated with the active line in the running data conversation

09743718.name: Last Data Conversation Was Skipped

92F6A711.name: Convert Color To String

14FA3995.name: Convert Bearings To String

3572C7A4.name: Convert XY To String
3572C7A4.hint: Converts the X and Y parameters into a string with the format "X,Y".

47E87DB9.name: Convert 3D Vector To String
47E87DB9.hint: Converts the X, Y, and Z parameters into a string with the format "X,Y,Z".

B941EEFE.name: Convert 3D Rotation To String
B941EEFE.hint: Converts and combines the Forward X,Y,Z parameters, and the Up X,Y,Z parameters, into a string with the format "<Forward Vector>,<Up Vector>".

B843D120.name: Convert String To Actor Message
B843D120.hint: Converts a string value to an actor message.

DF489D52.name: Convert Font Style To String
DF489D52.hint: Converts a font style value to a string value.

F37A4EA9.name: Convert String To UI Layout Frame Name
F37A4EA9.hint: Converts a string value to a relative UI layout frame name.

F21A4305.name: Set Global Cutscene Filter
F21A4305.hint: Sets the filter for all cutscenes (removing any previous filters).  Any nodes with a non-empty filter property that does not match this value will be filtered out of your cutscene.  Newly created cutscenes will use this filter.

4AF94EF5.name: Set Cutscene Filter
4AF94EF5.hint: Sets the filter for a cutscene (removing any previous filters).  Any nodes with a non-empty filter property that does not match this value will be filtered out of your cutscene.

8F7789A0.name: Add Global Cutscene Filter
8F7789A0.hint: Adds a new filter for all cutscenes.  Any nodes with a non-empty filter property that does not match any filter value will be filtered out of your cutscene.  Newly created cutscenes will use this filter.

2B0BC614.name: Add Cutscene Filter
2B0BC614.hint: Adds a new filter for a cutscene.  Any nodes with a non-empty filter property that does not match any filter value will be filtered out of your cutscene.

306DF22B.name: Remove Global Cutscene Filter
306DF22B.hint: Removes the filter for all cutscenes.  Any nodes with a non-empty filter property that does not match this value will be filtered out of your cutscene.

271877CA.name: Remove Cutscene Filter
271877CA.hint: Removes the filter for a cutscene.  Any nodes with a non-empty filter property that does not match this value will be filtered out of your cutscene.

37449FDB.name: Clear Cutscene Filter
37449FDB.hint: Removes all filters on the given cutscene.

9FEEA352.name: Create Cutscene
9FEEA352.hint: Cutscenes are built using the Cutscene Editor and saved to .SC2Cutscene files.  They can describe a complicated cinematic or a simple conversation.  WARNING: The Sound action Play Sound Scene File also accepts .SC2Cutscene files, but old-style scene files are not compatible with this action.

5958C7E2.name: Create Cutscene at Position
5958C7E2.hint: Cutscenes are built using the Cutscene Editor and saved to .SC2Cutscene files.  They can describe a complicated cinematic or a simple conversation.  This action allows you to play a cutscene at a specific position and facing.  If you want the defaults, use Create Cutscene.<n/><n/>WARNING: The Sound action Play Sound Scene File also accepts .SC2Cutscene files, but old-style scene files are not compatible with this action.

78D16252.name: Go To Next Cutscene Bookmark
78D16252.hint: Sets the time of the specified cutscene to the next bookmark from the current time

2C194B61.name: Cutscene EndScene Fired
2C194B61.hint: When the cutscene ends this event is triggered, this event is fired so that triggers may respond to it.

E734B4C9.name: Create Cutscene
E734B4C9.hint: Cutscenes are built using the Cutscene Editor and saved to .SC2Cutscene files.  They can describe a complicated cinematic or a simple conversation.  WARNING: The Sound action Play Sound Scene File also accepts .SC2Cutscene files, but old-style scene files are not compatible with this action.

D3945DFC.name: Last Created Cutscene
D3945DFC.hint: Returns the last cutscene created via a "Create Cutscene" action.  Cutscenes are destroyed when they stop via a trigger or the end of the scene.  At that point, the Cutscene ID is invalid.

C560675A.name: Play Cutscene
C560675A.hint: Tells the specified Cutscene to begin playback from the current time.  Cutscenes begin at time 0, but triggers may pause or change the current time.  Use the return from "Last Created Cutscene" to get a Cutscene ID.

255071AA.name: Pause Cutscene
255071AA.hint: Tells the specified Cutscene to pause playback.

C575C576.name: Stop Cutscene
C575C576.hint: Tells the specified Cutscene to stop playback.  Stopping a cutscene destroys it.

9372FA34.name: Set Cutscene Time
9372FA34.hint: Sets the time of the specified cutscene.  Time is measured in milliseconds.  This does not Pause or Play the cutscene -- it simply changes the current time.

0E8BB6F9.name: Go To Cutscene Bookmark
0E8BB6F9.hint: Sets the time of the specified cutscene to the specified bookmark.  If the bookmark is not found, there is no change.  This does not play or pause the cutscene.

3E451023.name: Show/Hide Cutscene
3E451023.hint: Shows or hides a cutscene.  When hidden, the cutscene will continue to advance and fire events, but it will not be visible nor will it play any sounds.

66D7B3DE.name: Play Cutscene Range Over Time
66D7B3DE.hint: Tells the specified Cutscene to play from one bookmark to another over a specified amount of time.  Playback is scaled in order to match the given duration.

D27035F2.name: Cutscene Fade
D27035F2.hint: Cutscene Fading allows you to manipulate the same fade system that Cutscenes use.  For example, a cutscene can Fade Out the scene, then you can fade back in with this trigger.  This is separate from Cinematic Fade, which only fades the game world.

E6F8D690.name: Dialog Item Cutscene
E6F8D690.hint: Converts a Dialog Item of type Cutscene into a Cutscene that can be manipulated

22F7DAC6.name: Cutscene Bookmark Fired
22F7DAC6.hint: When a bookmark is passed in a cutscene, this event is fired so that triggers may respond to it.

798AC00C.name: Triggering Cutscene
798AC00C.hint: Returns the triggering cutscene.  Use in conjunction with "Cutscene Bookmark Fired".

5669CBC2.name: Triggering Cutscene Bookmark
5669CBC2.hint: Returns the triggering cutscene bookmark name.  Use in conjunction with "Cutscene Bookmark Fired".

0CDF60FB.name: Wait For Cutscene To End
0CDF60FB.hint: Pauses a trigger until the specified cutscene has completed.

DA95549D.hint: If set to true, the text that appears within the dialog item will animate as if being written out a single character at a time.

29F59B61.name: Set Dialog Item Text Writeout Duration
29F59B61.hint: This controls the time it takes for the text to animate if "Set Dialog Item Text Writeout" is set to true.

E786CA75.name: Set Dialog Item Tooltip
E786CA75.hint: Sets the text that appears when mousing over a dialog item.

D9E07DD4.name: Dialog Item Color
D9E07DD4.hint: Returns the color of a dialog item.

59DBCD9D.name: Dialog Item Style
59DBCD9D.hint: Returns the string value of a dialog item's font style.

58D4683D.name: Dialog Item Tooltip
58D4683D.hint: Returns the tooltip text of a dialog item.

D5F9189A.name: Set Dialog Item Image
D5F9189A.hint: Sets the image to display on a dialog item.

8BE6BD8F.name: Set Dialog Item Hover Image
8BE6BD8F.hint: Sets the hover image to display on a dialog item.

2B97DDF4.name: Set Dialog Item Image Type
2B97DDF4.hint: Sets how an image is applied to a dialog item.

B20C9535.name: Set Dialog Item Blend Mode
B20C9535.hint: Sets the blend mode for a dialog item.

C55E1E32.name: Set Dialog Item Tiled
C55E1E32.hint: This is for images that are using the border image type.  If tiled is set to true, the sides of the image will be repeated to fill the desired height/width.  Otherwise they will be stretched.

D1667A7B.name: Set Dialog Background
D1667A7B.hint: Sets the background image of a dialog.

61F6BBB3.name: Dialog Item Image
61F6BBB3.hint: Returns the image of an image dialog item.

B08314FE.name: Dialog Item Image Type
B08314FE.hint: Returns the image type setting for an image dialog item.

C609209E.name: Fade Dialog Item Transparency
C609209E.hint: Changes the transparency of a dialog item over time.

670FD57D.name: Set Dialog Item Flash
670FD57D.hint: Sets a flash animation file to play for the specified dialog item.

EF6279C8.name: Set Dialog Item Cutscene
EF6279C8.hint: Sets a cutscene for the specified dialog item.

4D9F304A.name: Dialog Item Invoke As Text
4D9F304A.hint: Calls a method invoke on a loaded flash dialog item.  The flash dialog item must have a flash file loaded which has the specified method name in it.  The parameters for the invoked method are optional.

0A7AD7B4.name: Dialog Item Invoke As String
0A7AD7B4.hint: Calls a method invoke on a loaded flash dialog item.  The flash dialog item must have a flash file loaded which has the specified method name in it.  The parameters for the invoked method are optional.

4F8CE2E5.name: Dialog Item Send Animation Event
4F8CE2E5.hint: Sends an animation event to a dialog item.  Animations are defined in the layout of a dialog item.  All animations that are listening to this event on this dialog item will trigger their defined action.

D94F6F9C.name: Dialog Item Set Animation Speed
D94F6F9C.hint: Sets the speed of an animation on a dialog item.  Animations are defined in the layout of a dialog item.

EE08EB84.name: Dialog Item Set Animation Time
EE08EB84.hint: Sets the time of an animation on a dialog item.  All end rules (Loop, Ping Pong, etc.) are obeyed.  Animations are defined in the layout of a dialog item.

82EDF7A9.name: Dialog Item Advance Animation
82EDF7A9.hint: Advances an animation by the specified amount of time.  All end rules (Loop, Ping Pong, etc.) are obeyed.  Negative values are allowed.  Animations are defined in the layout of a dialog item.

342F1C36.name: Dialog Item Force Transition
342F1C36.hint: Currently supported for Dialog Items of type Portrait

C849642E.name: Dialog Item Request Focus
C849642E.hint: Currently supported for Dialog Items of type EditBox

EB0FFD57.name: Set Dialog Item Achievement
EB0FFD57.hint: Sets an achievement for the specified dialog item.

62157B3C.name: Set Dialog Item Render Priority
62157B3C.hint: Sets the render priority for the specified dialog item, which controls the z order that dialog items are rendered.   The default render priority is 512.  Setting a render priority lower than this means this dialog item should render below other dialog items within the same dialog.  Setting a render priority higher than this means the dialog item should render above other dialog items within the same dialog.

8B9F65D1.name: Set Dialog Item Click On Down
8B9F65D1.hint: Set a Trigger Dialog Item to execute its click behavior on mouse down instead of mouse up.  While mouse up is the default behavior and used for most buttons in the game, mouse down can be preferred for controls that need a more responsive feel.

4A7EACA2.name: Set Dialog Item Toggled
4A7EACA2.hint: Set a Trigger Dialog Item to be in the Toggled state.  This is currently supported on Buttons.

5C428316.name: Set Dialog Item Movie
5C428316.hint: Sets a Dialog Item to play the specified Movie.  Passing in an empty or invalid movie will cause the currently playing movie to stop.

E997B568.name: Set Dialog Item Desaturated
E997B568.hint: Set a Trigger Dialog Item to render with all of its native coloring stripped off and instead being tinted to the Desaturation Color.  By default this color is white.

66FCC01F.name: Set Dialog Item Desaturation Color
66FCC01F.hint: Sets the color a dialog item will be tinted if it is flagged as desaturated.

2DB2EF35.name: Set Dialog Item Custom Tooltip
2DB2EF35.hint: Sets a Dialog Item's Custom Tooltip

F934E0BA.name: Set Dialog Item Animation
F934E0BA.hint: Sets a Dialog Item's Animation.  Currently supported for Portraits.

C43E87D1.name: Set Dialog Item Border Visible
C43E87D1.hint: Set a Trigger Dialog Item to Show its Border or not.  Currently supported by Portraits.

E8355707.name: Set Dialog Item Border Image
E8355707.hint: Sets the border image to display on a dialog item. Currently supported by Portraits

30122AF8.name: Set Dialog Item Background Visible
30122AF8.hint: Set a Trigger Dialog Item to Show its Background or not.  Currently supported by Portraits.

71ADAE5C.name: Set Dialog Item Use Transition
71ADAE5C.hint: Set a Trigger Dialog Item to Use its Transition or not.  Currently supported by Portraits.

ADEDDAE8.name: Set Dialog Item Muted
ADEDDAE8.hint: Set a Trigger Dialog Item as Muted or not.  Currently supported by Portraits and Movies

F98F19F2.name: Set Dialog Item Paused
F98F19F2.hint: Set a Trigger Dialog Item as Paused or not.  Currently supported by Portraits.

E48A04F2.name: Set Dialog Item Accept Mouse
E48A04F2.hint: Set a Trigger Dialog Item to Accept the Mouse target or not.  Items that don't accept the mouse target won't receive clicks or show tooltips.  By default most items already accept the mouse target, but Labels and Images do not.

53D6FB68.name: Set Dialog Item Tint Color
53D6FB68.hint: Sets the tint color for a dialog item. Currently supported for Portraits.

5FEFE214.name: Set Dialog Item Team Color
5FEFE214.hint: Sets the team color for a dialog item.

E2ACE3F2.name: Set Dialog Item Transition Model
E2ACE3F2.hint: Sets a Dialog Item's Transition Model

C9C49ED4.name: Set Dialog Item Force Visible
C9C49ED4.hint: Set a Trigger Dialog Item to be Forced Visible.  This is currently supported on Portraits.

B4E65256.name: Set Dialog Item Render Type
B4E65256.hint: Controls in which pass the specified Dialog Item is rendered.  Items rendered in the HDR pass will be rendered before those in the LDR pass and will also be affected by post processing screen effects.

D5C6C608.name: Set Dialog Item Unit Link
D5C6C608.hint: Sets a Dialog Item's Unit Link.  Currently supported for type Unit Model

4405C582.name: Set Dialog Item Team Color Index
4405C582.hint: Sets the team color index for a dialog item. Currently supported for type Unit Model

2CA88AC8.name: Set Dialog Item Animation Duration
2CA88AC8.hint: This controls the time it takes for the dialog item to animate.  Supported for Dialog Items of type Image

62FBB9DC.name: Set Dialog Item Animation Time
62FBB9DC.hint: This controls the current animation time for the dialog item.  Supported for Dialog Items of type Image

0EDF1F98.name: Set Dialog Item Actor
0EDF1F98.hint: This sets the actor for the dialog item.  Supported for Dialog Items of type Portrait

AE9EFE82.name: Set Dialog Item Behavior
AE9EFE82.hint: This sets the behavior for the dialog item.  Supported for Dialog Items of type Unit Status Duration Bar

405648E4.name: Set Dialog Item Hotkey
405648E4.hint: Sets the hotkey for a dialog item. Currently supported for all dialog item types.

DD656F90.name: Set Dialog Item Allowed Mouse Buttons
DD656F90.hint: Sets the mouse buttons used to interact with a dialog item. Currently supported for all dialog item types.

3561BA91.name: Set Dialog Item Alpha Mask
3561BA91.hint: Sets the alpha mask that can be used to mask out any pixels in the specified texture with an alpha value. Currently supported for all dialog item types.

FB8E3369.name: Set Dialog Item Animation Index
FB8E3369.hint: This controls the current animation index for the dialog item.  Supported for Dialog Items of type Image

1AD2DE50.name: Set Dialog Item Handle
1AD2DE50.hint: This sets the unique handle for the dialog item.  Supported for Dialog Items of type Frame.  Only used internally.

473C4DC6.name: Set Dialog Item Border Color
473C4DC6.hint: Sets the border color for a dialog item.

0BE35026.name: Set Dialog Item Fill Color
0BE35026.hint: Sets the fill color for a dialog item.

9E3E4BF5.name: Set Dialog Item Submenu
9E3E4BF5.hint: Sets the submenu for a dialog item. Only used by Command Panel dialog items.

AE4C1D89.name: Set Dialog Item Unit Group
AE4C1D89.hint: Sets the unit group for a dialog item. Only used by Command Panel dialog items.

137A8328.name: Set Dialog Item PlayerId
137A8328.hint: Sets the target playerId for a dialog item. Only used by Hero Cutscene dialog items.

A3EAF56D.name: Set Dialog Item Score Value Link
A3EAF56D.hint: Sets a Dialog Item's Score Value Link.  Currently supported for type ScoreValueFrame

7AED3102.name: Set Dialog Item State Index
7AED3102.hint: Sets a Dialog Item's State Index.  Currently supported for type Image.

48E1B45F.name: Show/Hide Screen Button
48E1B45F.hint: Shows or hides a screen button, chosen through the ScreenButtonID parameter.  A hidden screen button cannot be seen or used.

0531A785.name: Flash Screen Button
0531A785.hint: Causes a screen button to change between two colors at the specified interval.

C1174045.name: Stop Flashing Screen Button
C1174045.hint: Causes a screen button to stop flashing.

D3FB8606.name: Set Screen Button Border Image
D3FB8606.hint: Sets the border image for a screen button.

E5CABD27.name: Set Screen Button Flashing Border Image
E5CABD27.hint: Sets the border image for a screen button for when it is flashing.

F5A3C98A.name: Screen Button Dialog
F5A3C98A.hint: Returns the dialog the specified screen button belongs to.

64C8AB22.name: Screen Button
64C8AB22.hint: Returns the dialog item that is the specified screen button.

BACFFC3C.name: Display Screen Image
BACFFC3C.hint: Creates a screen image, with an identifier chosen by the ScreenImageID parameter, at the specified anchor, with the specified size and offset.

162B8A0B.name: Show/Hide Screen Image
162B8A0B.hint: Shows or hides a screen image.  Use "Display Screen Image" to create screen images.

BF411FAA.name: Pulse Screen Image
BF411FAA.hint: Causes a screen image to change between two transperency values at the specified interval.

8F6C2A63.name: Stop Pulsing Screen Image
8F6C2A63.hint: Causes a screen image to stop pulsing.

3B76ECAD.name: Screen Image Dialog
3B76ECAD.hint: Returns the dialog the specified screen button image to.  Use "Display Screen Image" to create screen images.

078BA666.name: Screen Image Dialog Item
078BA666.hint: Returns the dialog item that is the specified screen image.  Use "Display Screen Image" to create screen images.

C199FB04.name: Display Screen Label
C199FB04.hint: Creates a screen image, with an identifier chosen by the ScreenImageID parameter, at the specified anchor, with the specified size and offset.

EF294846.name: Show/Hide Screen Label
EF294846.hint: Shows or hides a screen label.  Use "Display Screen label" to create screen labels.

39E83804.name: Screen Label Dialog
39E83804.hint: Returns the dialog the specified screen label to.  Use "Display Screen Label" to create screen labels.

A5883B0C.name: Screen Label Dialog Item
A5883B0C.hint: Returns the dialog item that is the specified screen label.  Use "Display Screen Label" to create screen labels.

EC54A169.name: Effect History Count
EC54A169.hint: Returns the number of entries in the specified Effect History.  Use Effect History Of Unit to get an Effect History.

F00486D5.name: Effect History Of Unit
F00486D5.hint: Returns an Effect History object that can be used to inspect the history of effects for a unit.  In order for a unit to register effects to its history, the unit must specify an Effect History Limit value, and any effects you want to track must specify a Caster History value.  The Caster History value specifies the category under which you want to track the effect.  You can use Effect History Entry Type to query the category for an Effect History entry.  A max count of 0 (the default) will get all available entries.

E120F0A6.name: Effect History Entry Ability
E120F0A6.hint: Returns the ability that originated the effect that was logged in the Effect History at the specified Index.  If the effect came from a weapon rather than an ability, this will return No Game Link.

A83C6E46.name: Effect History Entry Amount As Integer

4F485352.name: Effect History Entry Effect
4F485352.hint: If the Effect parameter is set to Root, this will return the effect that was at the root of the effect tree for the effect that was logged in the Effect History at the specified Index.  If the Effect parameter is set to Current, then this will return the effect that was logged in the Effect History at the specified Index.

476AD761.name: Effect History Entry Time
476AD761.hint: Returns the game time (in seconds) when the effect that was logged in the Effect History at the specified Index occurred.

62465F0F.name: Effect History Entry Type
62465F0F.hint: Returns the type of effect that was logged in the Effect History at the specified Index.  The type for the effect is set in the effect data in the Caster History field.

977A86F1.name: Effect History Entry Weapon
977A86F1.hint: Returns the weapon that originated the effect that was logged in the Effect History at the specified Index.  If the effect came from an ability rather than a weapon, this will return No Game Link.

BB08B228.name: Set Lighting
BB08B228.hint: Changes the lighting on the map.

874086C1.name: Set Lighting For Player
874086C1.hint: Changes the lighting on the map for the requested player.

CC7E793A.name: Set Time Of Day (Hours, Minutes, Seconds)

8A768239.name: Set Time of Day Lighting
8A768239.hint: Sets the lighting used by the time of day.

476B4429.name: Set Time of Day Lighting For Player
476B4429.hint: Sets the lighting used by the time of day for a specific player.

46F3910A.name: Set Day Length
46F3910A.hint: Sets the amount of game time it will take to cycle through 24 hours of time of day.

00000393.name: Pause/Unpause Time Of Day
00000393.hint: Pauses or unpauses the time of day cycle.

00000394.name: Current Time Of Day
00000394.hint: Returns the current game time of day.

C70C770F.name: Current Time Of Day (Seconds)
C70C770F.hint: Returns the current game time of day.

AAAF9344.name: Current Day/Night State
AAAF9344.hint: Returns the current game time of day.

21C1E117.name: Day Length
21C1E117.hint: Returns the current day length in game seconds.

00000396.name: Time Of Day Is Paused
00000396.hint: Returns true if the game time of day cycle is paused.

59DA6647.name: Enable/Disable Fog
59DA6647.hint: Turns environmental fog on or off.

A51F12F9.name: Enable/Disable Fog At Ultra
A51F12F9.hint: When true, fog is not displayed on ultra graphics settings where volume fog is enabled.

0C83D19F.name: Set Fog Density
0C83D19F.hint: Sets the density of environmental fog.  A higher value means thicker fog.

9D5EB505.name: Set Fog Color
9D5EB505.hint: Sets the color of environmental fog.

B3D5BF65.name: Set Fog Falloff
B3D5BF65.hint: Sets the falloff for environmental fog.  Falloff determines how far from the fog start height the environmental fog will extend.

10393B26.name: Set Fog Start Height
10393B26.hint: Sets the start height for environmental fog.  Anything below this height will be completely obscured by environmental fog.

488858A4.name: Set Fog Density Over Time
488858A4.hint: Sets the density of environmental fog.  A higher value means thicker fog.

A6028A5D.name: Set Fog Color Over Time
A6028A5D.hint: Sets the color of environmental fog.

B30D9FA1.name: Set Fog Falloff Over Time
B30D9FA1.hint: Sets the falloff for environmental fog.  Falloff determines how far from the fog start height the environmental fog will extend.

A76B4CEF.name: Set Fog Start Height Over Time
A76B4CEF.hint: Sets the start height for environmental fog.  Anything below this height will be completely obscured by environmental fog.

73DA313C.name: Set Background Model
73DA313C.hint: Set or change the skybox on a map.

F5C63A46.name: Show/Hide Environment
F5C63A46.hint: Shows or hides graphics associated with the game environment.  This includes terrain, doodads, and water.

34643F2E.name: Height At Point
34643F2E.hint: Returns the height at a point.

7F47CC53.name: Terrain Texture At Point
7F47CC53.hint: Returns the dominant terrain texture at a point.

5CD16E7E.name: Cliff Level Of Point (Integer)
5CD16E7E.hint: Returns what cliff level a point is on.

D88DB594.name: Cliff Level Of Point (Real)
D88DB594.hint: Returns what cliff level a point is on.

2AD78D79.name: Terrain Has Custom Attribute
2AD78D79.hint: Returns true if the custom attribute exists at the given terrain point. Custom attributes may be painted in the Terrain module.

0E7067FD.name: Show/Hide Terrain
0E7067FD.hint: Show or hide a region of terrain.  Useful for areas of terrain that are entirely covered by a doodad.

56D51508.name: Set Water State
56D51508.hint: Changes the water state on a map.  This causes a water template to shift between its different pre-determined settings.

E0519041.name: Pause/Unpause Water Transition
E0519041.hint: The Set Water State trigger can be used to transition between two separate water states over a duration. This trigger will pause and resume that transition.

E9307270.name: Set Creep Speed
E9307270.hint: Sets the speed of creep.  Growth determines how rapidly creep will expand from its origin point.  Decay determines how rapidly creep will receed if there are no creep generators nearby.  Blend determines how rapidly the creep will visually appear, and is seperate from the functional purposes of creep.

752159DD.name: Modify Creep
752159DD.hint: Add or remove creep around a point.  This creep can be normal creep that will receed without a nearby generator, or permanent creep which will remain until removed with a trigger.

00000249.name: Creep Is Present
00000249.hint: Returns true if creep is present at a specified point.

00000248.name: Creep Adjacent
00000248.hint: Returns the number of creep tiles adjacent to a point.

2E7FB833.name: Power Level
2E7FB833.hint: Returns the power level provided to a player at the specified point.

DB32F733.name: Power Is Provided By
DB32F733.hint: Returns true if power is provided to a point by a specific unit.  Note: The Minimum Power parameter should not be set past 1, unless you have custom units that provide more than a single power level.

98FD66D2.name: Validate Player Can Create Effect At Point

537BC3B4.name: Validate Player Can Create Effect On Unit

DDC0D455.name: Validate Unit Can Create Effect At Point

614EA577.name: Validate Unit Can Create Effect On Unit

AB4663C2.name: Create Effect At Point (From Player)
AB4663C2.hint: Runs an effect, targeting the specified point.  This effect will not have a caster unit.

EF15E7E2.name: Create Effect On Unit (From Player)
EF15E7E2.hint: Runs an effect, targeting the specified unit.  This effect will not have a caster unit.

6263AB61.name: Create Effect At Point (From Unit)
6263AB61.hint: Runs an effect, targeting the specified point, as if it was cast by the specified Caster unit.

73C0339B.name: Create Effect On Unit (From Unit)
73C0339B.hint: Runs an effect, targeting the specified unit, as if it was cast by the specified Caster unit.

CC9F56A7.name: Damage Unit (From Unit)
CC9F56A7.hint: Deals damage targeting the specified victim, as if it was dealt by the specified attacker unit.

AF40BDE1.name: Player Can Create Effect At Point
AF40BDE1.hint: Returns true if the specified player can execute the specified effect at the specified point.

326F770A.name: Player Can Create Effect On Unit
326F770A.hint: Returns true if the specified player can execute the specified effect on the specified unit.

28CBC59D.name: Unit Can Create Effect At Point
28CBC59D.hint: Returns true if the specified unit can execute the specified effect at the specified point.

5EC4874D.name: Unit Can Create Effect On Unit
5EC4874D.hint: Returns true if the specified unit can execute the specified effect on the specified target unit.

43E44B87.name: Destroy Effects
43E44B87.hint: Removes up to a specified amount of effects within a specified radius of a point.  This includes effects created by the game as well as effects created via "Create Effect" trigger actions.

9FFA06A7.name: Effect Used
9FFA06A7.hint: This event fires when the specified effect is used by the specified player.

CD37B8E0.name: Effect Used From Scope
CD37B8E0.hint: This event fires when an effect from the specifed scope is used by the specified player.

BE0F6AB0.name: Pathing Add No Fly Zone
BE0F6AB0.hint: Adds a new no fly zone. Inner Radius is a hard limit, no units are allowed inside. Outer radius is a softer radius and units try to avoid at that radius.

3A2B888E.name: Pathing Remove No Fly Zones In Region
3A2B888E.hint: Removes all no fly zones that have a center point in the specified region.

E8D281F2.name: Set Charge Remaining
E8D281F2.hint: Set charge remaining count for the specified item.

D9E5A4D3.name: Charge Count
D9E5A4D3.hint: Returns the current/max charges for the item.

0F5B8AA6.name: Game Play Time
0F5B8AA6.hint: Returns the elapsed play time for a player in game time seconds.

00000120.name: Map Initialization
00000120.hint: This event fires when a map starts running.

C5D97C07.name: Save Game Started
C5D97C07.hint: This event fires just before a game is saved.

F488C43D.name: Save Game Finished
F488C43D.hint: This event fires just after a game is saved.

7718C008.name: Load Game Finished
7718C008.hint: This event fires just after a game is finished loading.

22FD81D4.name: Game Set Quit On Quit Button
22FD81D4.hint: Used to turn on and off the behavior of the game automatically quitting when the quit button is pressed.  Only usable by official blizzard maps.

62180C0B.name: Set Global Time Scale
62180C0B.hint: Sets the global time scale that affects the time scale of all units.

5A832F2D.name: Mission Time
5A832F2D.hint: Returns the elapsed Mission Time in seconds

58C4A428.name: Set Minimum Game Speed
58C4A428.hint: Sets the minimum game speed.  If necessary, the current game speed will be adjusted to be at least as fast as the new minimum game speed.

86A15A1D.name: Lock Game Speed
86A15A1D.hint: Lock the game speed, rendering it unable to be changed.

6E8F94CA.name: Global Time Scale
6E8F94CA.hint: Returns the global time scale that affects the time scale of all units.

A7CB1C4B.name: Game Speed Is Locked
A7CB1C4B.hint: Returns true if the game speed is locked and cannot be changed.

9AC9D531.name: Attribute Game Value
9AC9D531.hint: Returns a game-level attribute value which was configured in the lobby before starting the game.

1C7F6A3E.name: Attribute Player Value
1C7F6A3E.hint: Returns a player-specific attribute value which was configured in the lobby before starting the game.

2F695638.name: Players On Team
2F695638.hint: Returns players on a given team, as determined by the game lobby before the game started.

0F6BD400.name: Turn Fixed Random Seed On/Off
0F6BD400.hint: Enables or disables fixed random seed.  When fixed random seed is enabled, the pattern of random numbers generated will be consistent every time the map runs.  This action is primarily used to ensure that cinematic sequences involving units that have abilities with lots of randomness play out the same way each time.

D265EBCA.name: Random Seed Is Locked
D265EBCA.hint: Returns true if fixed random seed is enabled.

1C57B355.name: Create Saved Game
1C57B355.hint: Creates a saved game.  This action has the side effect of suspending the current trigger until the next game loop.

97BA2D33.name: Set Tradeshow Game Time Remaining
97BA2D33.hint: Only for use in Blizzard tradeshows.

F2E7D3C7.name: Tradeshow Game Time Remaining
F2E7D3C7.hint: Only for use in Blizzard tradeshows.

C54E0080.name: Tradeshow Game Time Remaining Is Paused
C54E0080.hint: Only for use in Blizzard tradeshows.

F7D7DC36.name: Map Name
F7D7DC36.hint: Returns the name of the map currently being played.

514AEF40.name: Map Path
514AEF40.hint: Returns the path of the map currently being played.

4AB3CB9A.name: Map Description
4AB3CB9A.hint: Returns the description text of the map currently being played.

21FDF59F.name: Map Texture Set
21FDF59F.hint: Returns the terrain texture set of the map currently being played.

40844EC3.name: Game Is Test
40844EC3.hint: Returns true if the game is running in the specified test mode.

F1585010.name: Game Is Examinable
F1585010.hint: Returns true if the game is running in examinable mode. The game will only be examinable if requested via the command line.

2577A272.name: Game Get Test Config Type
2577A272.hint: Returns the game test config type. This will only be non-zero if it is requested via the command line and the game is examinable.<n/>

02F692F1.name: Game Is Online
02F692F1.hint: Returns true if the game is running online through Battle.net.

ABE9862E.name: Game Is Debug Option Set
ABE9862E.hint: Returns true if the specified debug option is true for a given player.  Only works in debug builds of the game.

EBD818C4.name: Game Is Matchmade
EBD818C4.hint: Returns true if the game was started from queueing in the matchmaker on Battle.net.

E32EC8BE.name: Game Is Competitive
E32EC8BE.hint: Returns true if the game was started from a Competitive queue on Battle.net.

701D2C53.name: Game Is Practice
701D2C53.hint: Returns true if the game was started from the Practice queue on Battle.net.

4DC37831.name: Game Is Cooperative
4DC37831.hint: Returns true if the game was started from the Cooperative queue on Battle.net.

9DB6F7DA.name: Game Allows Duplicate Heroes
9DB6F7DA.hint: Returns true if the game allows duplicate heroes

00000121.name: Chat Message
00000121.hint: This event fires when the specified chat message is typed by the specified player.  If exact match is selected, then the string the player enters must be identical to the specified string for the event to fire.  If partial match is selected, then the event will fire if the player enters the specified string plus any number of additional characters after it.  Use the "Chat String" function to refer to the message being entered.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the player that typed the message.

EBF1B8BE.name: Cheat Used
EBF1B8BE.hint: This event fires when the specified player uses the specified cheat.  Use "Cheat Type Used" to get the cheat that was used.

00000122.name: Chat String
00000122.hint: Returns a chat message entered by a player. Only works in conjunction with the "Chat Message" Event. Use the "Word Of String" function to identify individual words within the string.

B658B97F.name: Cheat Type Used
B658B97F.hint: Returns the cheat a player used.  Only usable in response to a Cheat Used event.

3CE0B2FC.name: Cheats Enabled
3CE0B2FC.hint: Returns true if cheats are enabled for the specified category.

733FE4D0.name: GameSetNextCampaignIndex
733FE4D0.hint: Sets the campaign Index for the specified player for the next map. Only supported in single player offline games.

00000198.name: End Game For Player
00000198.hint: Finishes the game in Victory, Defeat, or Tie for the specified player. This action can also choose to hide or show the victory dialog for the chosen player. As of version 2.0, the Show Score parameter is obsolete and has no effect.

428A4625.name: Restart Game
428A4625.hint: Restarts the current level for all the players in the specified player group. Only supported in single player offline games.

B06831BB.name: Kick From Game
B06831BB.hint: Kicks every player in the specified player group from the game

00000336.name: Set Next Map
00000336.hint: Sets the next map to be run after current map finishes. Only supported in single player offline games. Use Online Map To Map Load for multiplayer map to map loading.

8D1CFF2D.name: Set Transition Map
8D1CFF2D.hint: Sets the transition map for transition saves. Only supported in single player offline games.

B609FCF9.name: Set Next Mission Difficulty
B609FCF9.hint: Sets the difficulty for the specified player for the next map. Only supported in single player offline games.

23AAB834.name: Game Is Transitioned
23AAB834.hint: Returns true if the game is transistioned.  A game is transitioned if it has started as a result of a previous map (IE: Was not simply loaded from a lobby). Only supported in single player offline games.

3102861D.name: Award Achievement
3102861D.hint: This feature only works on Blizzard-signed maps.

ACB49AEE.name: Set Achievement Term Quantity
ACB49AEE.hint: This feature only works on Blizzard-signed maps.

A7E74DB9.name: Add To Achievement Term Quantity
A7E74DB9.hint: This feature only works on Blizzard-signed maps.

C96DB672.name: Erase Achievement
C96DB672.hint: This feature only works on Blizzard-signed maps.

E76B043D.name: Get Achievement Percent Text
E76B043D.hint: This feature only works on Blizzard-signed maps.

8874BA0C.name: Set Achievement Panel Category
8874BA0C.hint: This feature only works on Blizzard-signed maps.

58A706F7.name: Remove Charge Regen Time For Game (Deprecated)
58A706F7.hint: Clears the amount of time it takes to regenerate the specified global charge link.

D89521D2.name: Add Charge Remaining Regen Time For Game
D89521D2.hint: Adds to the amount of time remaining to regenerate the specified global charge link.

2A102654.name: Add Charge Full Regen Time For Game
2A102654.hint: Adds to the amount of time to regenerate the specified global charge link.

477085FF.name: Add Charge Used For Game
477085FF.hint: Consumes the specified number of charges for the specified global charge link.

E80E31D9.name: Remove Charge Used For Game
E80E31D9.hint: Clears the number of used charges for the specified global charge link.

26A716B4.name: Charge Regen Remaining For Game
26A716B4.hint: Returns the charge regen time for the specified global charge link.

B9A3D515.name: Charge Regen Full For Game
B9A3D515.hint: Returns the charge regen time for the specified global charge link.  If Adjustment Only is true, it will only return the "bonus" amount added to (or subtracted from) the full regen time.

3743B764.name: Game Charge Used
3743B764.hint: Returns the number of charges used for the specified global charge link.

38D102EB.name: Pause/Unpause All Charges For Game
38D102EB.hint: Pauses or unpauses regen for all charges in the game.

38867CC5.name: Add Cooldown For Game
38867CC5.hint: Adds time to the specified global cooldown link.

57266FCE.name: Remove Cooldown For Game
57266FCE.hint: Clears the specified global cooldown link.

65093B8D.name: Game Cooldown
65093B8D.hint: Returns the cooldown time for the specified global cooldown link.

344B7296.name: Pause/Unpause All Cooldowns For Game
344B7296.hint: Pauses or unpauses all cooldowns in the game.

9AD89405.name: Preload Asset
9AD89405.hint: Preloads an asset file.  The file must be explicitly identified (it won't work if you plug in a variable to that parameter).  Preloading will force an asset or data entry to be loaded into memory before the map starts, rather than be loaded on demand as the map runs.

E6D9AAFA.name: Preload Image
E6D9AAFA.hint: Preloads an image file.  The file must be explicitly identified (it won't work if you plug in a variable to that parameter).  Preloading will force an asset or data entry to be loaded into memory before the map starts, rather than be loaded on demand as the map runs.

D7E01477.name: Preload Layout
D7E01477.hint: Preloads a layout file.  The file must be explicitly identified (it won't work if you plug in a variable to that parameter).  Preloading will force an asset or data entry to be loaded into memory before the map starts, rather than be loaded on demand as the map runs.

35BCE4EA.name: Preload Model
35BCE4EA.hint: Preloads a model file.  The file must be explicitly identified (it won't work if you plug in a variable to that parameter).  Preloading will force an asset or data entry to be loaded into memory before the map starts, rather than be loaded on demand as the map runs.

C31395AC.name: Preload Model Object
C31395AC.hint: Preloads a model data entry and its associated assets.  The model must be explicitly identified (it won't work if you plug in a variable to that parameter).  Preloading will force an asset or data entry to be loaded into memory before the map starts, rather than be loaded on demand as the map runs.

C6E357F0.name: Preload Movie
C6E357F0.hint: Preloads a movie.  The file must be explicitly identified (it won't work if you plug in a variable to that parameter).  Preloading will force an asset or data entry to be loaded into memory before the map starts, rather than be loaded on demand as the map runs.

1EBE8CFF.name: Preload Object
1EBE8CFF.hint: Preloads a data entry and its associated assets.  The object must be explicitly identified (it won't work if you plug in a variable to that parameter).  Preloading will force an asset or data entry to be loaded into memory before the map starts, rather than be loaded on demand as the map runs.

E6E57D64.name: Preload Scene
E6E57D64.hint: Preloads a scene file.  The file must be explicitly identified (it won't work if you plug in a variable to that parameter).  Preloading will force an asset or data entry to be loaded into memory before the map starts, rather than be loaded on demand as the map runs.

DEDE37F9.name: Preload Script
DEDE37F9.hint: Preloads a script file.  The file must be explicitly identified (it won't work if you plug in a variable to that parameter).  Preloading will force an asset or data entry to be loaded into memory before the map starts, rather than be loaded on demand as the map runs.

304C4EB6.name: Preload Sound
304C4EB6.hint: Preloads a sound file.  The file must be explicitly identified (it won't work if you plug in a variable to that parameter).  Preloading will force an asset or data entry to be loaded into memory before the map starts, rather than be loaded on demand as the map runs.

1FDDB65E.name: Preload Sound Object
1FDDB65E.hint: Preloads a sound data entry and its associated assets.  The sound must be explicitly identified (it won't work if you plug in a variable to that parameter).  Preloading will force an asset or data entry to be loaded into memory before the map starts, rather than be loaded on demand as the map runs.

F2B3CCE5.name: Preload Soundtrack
F2B3CCE5.hint: Preloads a soundtrack.  The soundtrack must be explicitly identified (it won't work if you plug in a variable to that parameter).  Preloading will force an asset or data entry to be loaded into memory before the map starts, rather than be loaded on demand as the map runs.

569DAE66.name: Preload Unit
569DAE66.hint: Preloads a unit and its associated assets.  The unit must be explicitly identified (it won't work if you plug in a variable to that parameter).  Preloading will force an asset or data entry to be loaded into memory before the map starts, rather than be loaded on demand as the map runs.

79225E96.name: Online Map To Map Load
79225E96.hint: Executes an online map to map load. Ends the game for all observers and players that have not already won, tied, lost or left the game, then transitions them together into another map published by the same author. The destination map is chosen by a map slot. Map slots must be set using the managed published dialog. Ensure that the source and destination maps have the same set of user controlled players to prevent map transition failures. Default variants and game settings will be used to create the destination map. Only supported for online games.

7B581C02.name: Text Message to Game User
7B581C02.hint: Displays a text message in the specified area of the screen.

7B72A8FE.name: Clear Text Messages for Game User
7B72A8FE.hint: Clears all text messages currently displayed on the screen.

B08F1A3A.name: Name of Game User
B08F1A3A.hint: Returns the name of the Game User.

AA8BBBBA.name: Handle of Game User
AA8BBBBA.hint: Returns the handle of the Game User. A handle is a guaranteed unique string representation of the game user.  It can be useful for debugging or lookup but isn't ever appropriate to display to the players in the game.

8603728B.name: Triggering Game User
8603728B.hint: Returns the triggering Game User as an integer.

00000136.name: Set Variable
00000136.hint: Sets a variable to the specified value.

5BDC6A34.name: Set Variable (Param)
5BDC6A34.hint: Sets a variable to the specified value.

A0F31305.name: Modify Variable (Integer)
A0F31305.hint: Directly modify an integer variable through arithmetic.

DB01ECDC.name: Modify Variable (Real)
DB01ECDC.hint: Directly modify a real variable through arithmetic.

00000242.name: Wait
00000242.hint: Pauses a trigger for a specified amount of time.  Real time is normal time.  Game time can pass faster or slower depending on the game speed.  AI time passes at the same rate as game time, but can be paused or unpaused while real time and game time are still running.  It is useful to pause the AI time while a player is watching a cinematic, so timed attack waves will wait until the player is finished with the cinematic before resuming their countdowns.

E89F1335.name: Wait For Condition
E89F1335.hint: Pauses a trigger until the specified condition is met.  Real time is normal time.  Game time can pass faster or slower depending on the game speed.  AI time passes at the same rate as game time, but can be paused or unpaused while real time and game time are still running.  It is useful to pause the AI time while a player is watching a cinematic, so timed attack waves will wait until the player is finished with the cinematic before resuming their countdowns.

01DD8AFF.name: Wait For Condition With Maximum Duration
01DD8AFF.hint: Pauses a trigger until the specified condition is met. The pause will last no longer than Max Duration seconds. Real time is normal time.  Game time can pass faster or slower depending on the game speed.  AI time passes at the same rate as game time, but can be paused or unpaused while real time and game time are still running.  It is useful to pause the AI time while a player is watching a cinematic, so timed attack waves will wait until the player is finished with the cinematic before resuming their countdowns.

D34AEEAF.name: Wait For Timer
D34AEEAF.hint: Pauses a trigger until the chosen Timer has reached a certain point.  This point is set by using the Time parameter, and the WaitType parameter.

E914D77C.name: Critical Section
E914D77C.hint: Only one "Critical Section" action set associated with the chosen Lock parameter will ever execute at the same time.  Note: The Lock parameter requires a boolean variable.  Simply specifying true or false will not work.  This is useful for avoiding race conditions when you have parallel processes that can modify the same variables.

00000137.name: If Then Else
00000137.hint: Executes an If Then Else statement.  If the specified conditions are met, the action set set under Then will run.  If the conditions are not met, the action set placed under Else will run.

C0083258.name: If Then Else-If
C0083258.hint: Executes an If Then Else statement with multiple cases.

BB1891ED.name: If Then
BB1891ED.hint: Executes an If Then statement.  If the specified conditions are met the specified action set will run.  If the conditions are not met, nothing will happen.

91C49196.name: Switch
91C49196.hint: Switch statements check a specified condition, and perform a single action set based on the result. For example: If you wanted to apply a behavior to any unit that enters a certain region, but you want to apply a different behavior depending on the type of unit that enters the region, you could set up a Switch statement in your trigger based on the "Unit Type "of the "Triggering Unit". Individual cases could then be added to the switch statement for different Unit Types, each case with its own unique action set. The Default action set would fire if the result from the Switch statement did not match any of the cases.

3A1227AB.name: Switch Case
3A1227AB.hint: Switch Cases are only found inside of a Switch statement. If the Value parameter matches the value returned by the parent Switch statement the action set will be run, otherwise nothing will happen.

00000349.name: Repeat
00000349.hint: Repeats an action set a specified number of times.

CEDAB9C3.name: Repeat Forever
CEDAB9C3.hint: Repeats an action set forever (or until the loop is broken with a "Break" or "Skip Remaining Actions" action.

119A6AF8.name: For Each Real
119A6AF8.hint: Executes a for loop using a real value.  This will run the action set included in the For Loop a number of times determined by the Start, End, and Increment parameters, increasing the integer variable by the Increment parameter each time. For example: If you set up a For Loop to start at 1, end at 10, increment by 1, and made a single "Chat Message" action inside of the For Loop that converted the <Variable> integer parameter into text, it would count from 1 to 10 in the chat message area.

2947E9A0.name: For Each Real Deprecated
2947E9A0.hint: Executes a for loop using a real value.  This will run the action set included in the For Loop a number of times determined by the Start, End, and Increment parameters, increasing the integer variable by the Increment parameter each time. For example: If you set up a For Loop to start at 1, end at 10, increment by 1, and made a single "Chat Message" action inside of the For Loop that converted the <Variable> integer parameter into text, it would count from 1 to 10 in the chat message area.

5693DC73.name: For Each Integer Deprecated
5693DC73.hint: Executes a For Loop using an integer value. This will run the action set included in the For Loop a number of times determined by the Start, End, and Increment parameters, increasing the integer variable by the Increment parameter each time. For example: If you set up a For Loop to start at 1, end at 10, increment by 1, and made a single "Chat Message" action inside of the For Loop that converted the <Variable> integer parameter into text, it would count from 1 to 10 in the chat message area.

9DE705AA.name: Pick Each Integer
9DE705AA.hint: Picks each integer between the Start and End parameters, and performs the specified actions.  Uses the "Picked Integer" function to refer to the iterator in the action set.

A00A7B2F.name: Pick Each Integer Deprecated
A00A7B2F.hint: Picks each integer between the Start and End parameters, and performs the specified actions.  Uses the "Picked Integer" function to refer to the iterator in the action set.

D02F7ACF.name: Picked Integer
D02F7ACF.hint: Returns the picked integer.  This function is only for use with the "Pick Each Integer" action. It will do nothing when used outside of a pick each integer loop.

A66EFCA4.name: Picked Integer Deprecated
A66EFCA4.hint: Returns the picked integer.  This function is only for use with the "Pick Each Integer" action. It will do nothing when used outside of a pick each integer loop.

8B429DFA.name: Do - While
8B429DFA.hint: Executes a While Loop.  If the specified conditions are met, the action set will be run, and the conditions will be checked again.  This will continue until the conditions are not met.  If the conditions are not met the first time they are checked, nothing will happen and they will not be checked again.

00000139.name: Skip Remaining Actions
00000139.hint: Skips the remaining actions in the trigger.

00000097.name: Return
00000097.hint: Returns the specified value.  Note: Custom functions require you to set a return value using this action.  If a custom function does not return a value 100% of the time, it will not compile.  If this action is run in a trigger, it is equivalent to using "Skip Remaining Actions".

7B4A4D9D.name: Break
7B4A4D9D.hint: Terminate a loop or scope early.

268BBACB.name: Continue
268BBACB.hint: Jump back to the top of a loop or scope early.

00000123.name: Custom Script
00000123.hint: Runs a custom galaxy script.  Note: For advanced users who have familiarity with the galaxy scripting language.

75796BFD.name: Action Group
75796BFD.hint: Groups together multiple actions for organizational purposes only.

503B2E7F.name: Create Leaderboard
503B2E7F.hint: Creates a leaderboard with a specified amount of rows and columns.  Use "Last Created Leaderboard" to get the leaderboard created by this action.

00000447.name: Last Created Leaderboard
00000447.hint: Returns the last leaderboard created via a "Create Leaderboard" action.

00000450.name: Set Leaderboard Name
00000450.hint: Sets the name of a leaderboard.

49934F8F.name: Anchor Leaderboard
49934F8F.hint: The leaderboard will be automatically positioned relative to the screen using the given anchor and offset.

DDBABF2E.name: Move Leaderboard
DDBABF2E.hint: Moves the leaderboard to the specified screen position. The X coordinate corresponds to the right side of the leaderboard.

DBE4CE29.name: Reset Leaderboard Position
DBE4CE29.hint: Moves the leaderboard to the default position along the right edge of the screen.

42E3909E.name: Show/Hide Leaderboard
42E3909E.hint: Shows or hides a leaderboard for a player group.

00000449.name: Show/Hide All Leaderboards
00000449.hint: Shows or hides all leaderboards for a player group.

00000448.name: Destroy Leaderboard
00000448.hint: Destroys a leaderboard, removing it from the game.

00000457.name: Set Leaderboard Item Text
00000457.hint: Sets the text of a leaderboard item.

00000458.name: Set Leaderboard Item Text Color
00000458.hint: Sets the item text color on a leaderboard to the specified color.

00000462.name: Set Leaderboard Item Sort Order
00000462.hint: Sets the leaderboard item sort order to the order specified.

00000460.name: Set Leaderboard Item Icon
00000460.hint: Sets an icon for a leaderboard item.

00000459.name: Set Leaderboard Item Background Color
00000459.hint: Sets the background color of text on a leaderboard.

23BAB430.name: Set Leaderboard Item Font Size
23BAB430.hint: Sets the font size of text in a location on a leaderboard.

00000461.name: Set Leaderboard Item Alignment
00000461.hint: Sets the alignment of text in a location on a leaderboard.

00000463.name: Set Leaderboard Sort Column
00000463.hint: Sets the leaderboard sorting column and sorting order.

00000455.name: Set Leaderboard Groups
00000455.hint: Sets the number of groups in a leaderboard.

00000456.name: Set Leaderboard Group For Row
00000456.hint: Sets a row to be part of the specified group.

00000454.name: Set Leaderboard Column Width
00000454.hint: Sets the width of a leaderboard column.

00000453.name: Set Leaderboard Rows
00000453.hint: Sets the number of rows in a leaderboard.

00000452.name: Set Leaderboard Columns
00000452.hint: Sets the number of columns in a leaderboard.

00000451.name: Enable/Disable Leaderboard State
00000451.hint: Enable/Disable a state for the specified leaderboard.

788C4F28.name: Show/Hide Leaderboard Minimize Button
788C4F28.hint: Hides the minimize button on a leaderboard for a player group.

11C2C9DE.name: Set Leaderboard Minimize Button Color
11C2C9DE.hint: Sets the minimize button color on a leaderboard.

4D70595C.name: Turn Leaderboard Minimize Button On/Off
4D70595C.hint: Turns the minimize button on/off for player group.

00000465.name: Add Player To Leaderboard
00000465.hint: Adds a new row to the specified leaderboard, and associates the specified player with that row.  Use "Set Leaderboard Player Column" to set the column where player names will appear.

5D44BC5F.name: Remove Player From Leaderboard
5D44BC5F.hint: Removes a player from a leaderboard.

00000464.name: Set Leaderboard Player Column
00000464.hint: Sets the column that player names will appear in for the specified leaderboard.  Use "Add Player To Leaderboard" to add players to the leaderboard.

F79DB963.name: Show/Hide Leaderboard Item Progress Bar
F79DB963.hint: Shows or hides the display of a progress bar within a leaderboard item.  Use the "Set Leaderboard Item Progress Value" action to adjust the progress bar's displayed progress.

734C8F91.name: Set Leaderboard Item Progress Range
734C8F91.hint: Adjusts the range of values for a progress bar within a leaderboard item.  The minimum value corresponds to an empty progress bar, and the maximum value corresponds to a full progress bar.  The default range is 0 to 100.

58C31300.name: Set Leaderboard Item Progress Value
58C31300.hint: Sets the current value of a progress bar within a leaderboard item.  Use the "Set Leaderboard Item Progress Range" action to set the item's range.

0A37E6F9.name: Set Leaderboard Item Progress Color
0A37E6F9.hint: Sets the color for a progress bar within a leaderboard item.  If colors are set for multiple step values, the color will vary as the progress value increases, dividing each step equally across the full progress range.

EB9B0F45.name: Last Created Loot Unit
EB9B0F45.hint: Returns the last loot unit/item created via the "Drop Loot At Unit" or "Drop Loot At Point" actions.  This function ignores units created by other triggers.

83133F60.name: Last Created Loot Units
83133F60.hint: Returns the last group of units/items created via the "Drop Loot At Unit" or "Drop Loot At Point" actions. This function ignores units created by other triggers.

E1934B90.name: Create Random Item Loot At Point

00000132.name: And
00000132.hint: Returns true if all of the conditions listed under the "And" condition return true.  By default, lists of conditions without an "And" condition or an "Or" condition must all return true in order for the condition to evaluate to true (they are treated as if they were under an "And" condition).  Therefore, this condition is only necessary if it is nested within another condition such as a "Not" condition or an "Or" condition.

00000133.name: Or
00000133.hint: Returns true if any of the conditions listed under the "Or" condition return true.  By default, lists of conditions without an "And" condition or an "Or" condition must all return true in order for the condition to evaluate to true (they are treated as if they were under an "And" condition).

B7A7F631.name: Not
B7A7F631.hint: Returns true if all the conditions listed under it evaluate to false.  If multiple conditions are listed under the "Not" condition, those conditions will first be evaluated as if they were under an "Or" condition, and then the "Not" condition will invert the result.

1A5B44D4.name: Within Bounds
1A5B44D4.hint: Returns true if the Value parameter is in between the Min and Max parameters, or if the Value parameter is equal to either the Min or the Max parameter.

B835AED0.name: Text Has Been Set
B835AED0.hint: Returns true if the Text parameter is not null.

00000135.name: And Or
00000135.hint: Returns the result of two Boolean comparisons.  If the Operator is set to And, both comparisons must be met to pass the conditions.  If the Operator is set to Or, the condition will pass if either comparison is met.

00000134.name: And Or Multiple
00000134.hint: Returns the result of all of the specified Boolean comparison cases.  If the Operator is set to And, all comparisons must be met to pass the conditions.  If the Operator is set to Or, the condition will pass if any comparison is met.

C879D158.name: Not
C879D158.hint: Returns the inverse of the boolean value.

0154BFCA.name: Absolute Value (Integer)
0154BFCA.hint: Returns the value of the integer without regard to the sign of the integer.

67AF3393.name: Absolute Value (Real)
67AF3393.hint: Returns the value of the real without regard to the sign of the real.

00000128.name: Arithmetic (Integer)
00000128.hint: Returns the addition, subtraction, multiplication or division of the specified integer values.

7D16A215.name: Bitwise Arithmetic (Integer)
7D16A215.hint: Returns the bitwise operator of the specified integer values.

00000129.name: Arithmetic (Real)
00000129.hint: Returns the addition, subtraction, multiplication or division of the specified real values.

00000126.name: Arithmetic Multiple (Integer)
00000126.hint: Returns the addition, subtraction, multiplication or division of the specified integer values in multiple instances.

D3C80FAD.name: Bitwise Arithmetic Multiple (Integer)
D3C80FAD.hint: Returns the bitwise operation of the specified integer values in multiple instances.

00000127.name: Arithmetic Multiple (Real)
00000127.hint: Returns the addition, subtraction, multiplication or division of the specified real values in multiple instances.

5C9C427F.name: Ceiling (Integer)
5C9C427F.hint: Returns the smallest value that is not less than the argument.

CA42A5D8.name: Ceiling (Real)
CA42A5D8.hint: Returns the smallest value that is not less than the argument.

32F302DF.name: Clamp (Real)
32F302DF.hint: Adjust the value to make sure it stays within the provided bounds.

B90251D8.name: Cycle
B90251D8.hint: Increments an integer variable by 1, but keeps it within a given range.  If this increment causes the variable to exceed the Max value, the variable is reset to the Min value.

C156C116.name: Floor (Integer)
C156C116.hint: Returns the largest value less than or equal to the specified number.

6BF56043.name: Floor (Real)
6BF56043.hint: Returns the largest value less than or equal to the specified number.

B12493DA.name: Log2 (Integer)
B12493DA.hint: Returns the log base 2 of a number.

3692F869.name: Log2 (Real)
3692F869.hint: Returns the log base 2 of a number.

16259F45.name: Log (Real)
16259F45.hint: Returns the log of a number.

EEDB2448.name: Modulo (Integer)
EEDB2448.hint: Uses integer values. Returns the remainder after the dividend has been divided by the divisor.

00000014.name: Modulo (Real)
00000014.hint: Uses real values. Returns the remainder after the dividend has been divided by the divisor.

75A93FA3.name: Power (Integer)
75A93FA3.hint: Returns a value raised to a given power or exponent.

00000013.name: Power (Real)
00000013.hint: Returns a value raised to a given power or exponent.

6A0BD10C.name: Round (Integer)
6A0BD10C.hint: Returns the value rounded to zero decimal places.

1333F1DA.name: Round (Real)
1333F1DA.hint: Returns the value rounded to zero decimal places.

3FC99EFC.name: Pow2 (Integer)
3FC99EFC.hint: Returns 2 to the power of a value.

F4E34D15.name: Pow2 (Real)
F4E34D15.hint: Returns 2 to the power of a value.

7CF39D61.name: Square Root (Integer)
7CF39D61.hint: Returns the square root of a number.

00000012.name: Square Root (Real)
00000012.hint: Returns the square root of a number.

3D9AC30F.name: Trunc (Integer)
3D9AC30F.hint: Strips off the fractional portion of a real.

81617BA8.name: Trunc (Real)
81617BA8.hint: Strips off the fractional portion of a real.

7AE49F4E.name: Minimum (Integer)
7AE49F4E.hint: Returns the lowest of the two integer values specified.

CC8AC2DC.name: Minimum (Real)
CC8AC2DC.hint: Returns the lowest of the two real values specified.

D7C3FBC2.name: Maximum (Integer)
D7C3FBC2.hint: Returns the highest of the two integer values specified.

8CD87612.name: Maximum (Real)
8CD87612.hint: Returns the highest of the two real values specified.

00000195.name: Random Integer
00000195.hint: Returns a random integer between the specified values (inclusive).

00000196.name: Random Real
00000196.hint: Returns a random real between the specified values (inclusive).

2D29A1C5.name: Random Percent
2D29A1C5.hint: Returns a random percentage between 0 and 100 (inclusive).

D1C924E4.name: Random Angle
D1C924E4.hint: Returns a random angle between 0 and 360 (inclusive).

00000015.name: Sine
00000015.hint: Returns the sine of an angle.  The angle should be specified in degrees.

00000016.name: Cosine
00000016.hint: Returns the cosine of an angle.  The angle should be specified in degrees.

00000017.name: Tangent
00000017.hint: Returns the tangent of an angle.  The angle should be specified in degrees.

00000018.name: Arcsine
00000018.hint: Returns the arcsine of a number.  Allowed range is -1 to 1.  The returned value is given in degrees.

00000019.name: Arccosine
00000019.hint: Returns the arccosine of a number.  Allowed range is -1 to 1.  The returned value is given in degrees.

00000021.name: Arctangent From Deltas
00000021.hint: Returns the arctangent of a set of X and Y deltas.  The returned value is given in degrees.

00000020.name: Arctangent From Value
00000020.hint: Returns the arctangent of a number.  The returned value is given in degrees.

00000143.name: Set Starting Resources For All Players
00000143.hint: Sets the default starting resources for all players, which is 50 minerals.

00000145.name: Set Starting Units For All Players
00000145.hint: Creates the primary structure and starting workers for all players

00000150.name: Start Melee AI For All Players
00000150.hint: Enables the melee AI for computer players.

00000148.name: Set Default Melee Options For All Players
00000148.hint: Enables victory, defeat and reveal for all players

00000147.name: Player Melee Option
00000147.hint: Returns whether or not a specified melee option is enabled for a player.

00000146.name: Enable/Disable Melee Option For Player
00000146.hint: Enables or disables a melee option for the specified player.

00000142.name: Set Starting Resources For Player
00000142.hint: Sets the starting resources for the specified player and race. The default starting resources is 50 minerals.

00000144.name: Set Starting Units For Player
00000144.hint: Creates the starting units and structures for the specified player and race.

1D6F1270.name: Create Objective
1D6F1270.hint: Creates an objective.  Objectives appear in the upper left corner of the UI, and are can be used to create goals for players to accomplish.

0CFF1A69.name: Create Objective For Players
0CFF1A69.hint: Creates an objective.  Objectives appear in the upper left corner of the UI, and are can be used to create goals for players to accomplish.

19BA63F9.name: Show/Hide Objective
19BA63F9.hint: Sets the state of an objective to either hidden or active.

00000440.name: Set Objective State
00000440.hint: Sets the state of an objective.

AABFD861.name: Objective Is Visible
AABFD861.hint: Returns true if the objective is visible for the specified player.

E44DBA40.name: Objective State
E44DBA40.hint: Returns the state of an objective.

471E57AD.name: Set Objective Priority
471E57AD.hint: Determines which order objectives will display in.  Larger priorities will appear higher in the list.  The default priority for an objective is -1.

00000436.name: Set Objective Description
00000436.hint: Sets the description of an objective.

0CB4FA5D.name: Set Objective Players
0CB4FA5D.hint: Makes the specified objective visible to the specified player group and only the specified player group.  If the objective was previously visible to a player that is outside this group, it will now become hidden for that player.

00000435.name: Set Objective Text
00000435.hint: Sets the text of an objective.

E0D9530C.name: Set Objective Type
E0D9530C.hint: Sets the type for an objective.

5A412508.name: Move Objective to Beginning
5A412508.hint: Places the objective at the start of the list, causing it to display above all other objectives.

4A60BD83.name: Objective Text
4A60BD83.hint: Returns the text of an objective.

9A4C5A17.name: Objective Description
9A4C5A17.hint: Returns the description text of an objective.

2FA5DA72.name: Objective Players
2FA5DA72.hint: Returns the player group that has been set for the objective.
