B5337352.name: Objective Primary
B5337352.hint: Returns true if the objective is a primary objective.

0A043554.name: Destroy All Objectives
0A043554.hint: Destroys all objectives for a player group.

C360B251.name: Order Targeting Item
C360B251.hint: Returns an order targeting an item.  This is primarily for use in "Issue Order" and "Issue Order To Unit Group" actions.

43F16BA5.name: Order Targeting Point
43F16BA5.hint: Returns an order targeting a point.  This is primarily for use in "Issue Order" and "Issue Order To Unit Group" actions.

C837E5F8.name: Revive Order Targeting Point
C837E5F8.hint: Returns an order targeting a point and will revive a specific unit. This is primarily for use in "Issue Order To Unit Group" actions.

0537DF83.name: Order Targeting Relative Points
0537DF83.hint: Returns an order targeting relative points near a given point.  This is primarily for use in "Issue Order To Unit Group" actions.

F6F9120D.name: Order Targeting Unit
F6F9120D.hint: Returns an order targeting a unit.  This is primarily for use in "Issue Order" and "Issue Order To Unit Group" actions.

984B8065.name: Order Targeting Unit Group
984B8065.hint: Returns an order targeting a unit group.  This is primarily for use in "Issue Order" and "Issue Order To Unit Group" actions.

1E7DE62A.name: Order Targeting Valid Unit In Group
1E7DE62A.hint: Returns an order targeting a unit group.  This is primarily for use in "Issue Order" and "Issue Order To Unit Group" actions.

59BA1DDF.name: Order With No Target
59BA1DDF.hint: Returns an order with no target.  This is primarily for use in "Issue Order" and "Issue Order To Unit Group" actions. Use this action in conjunction with the Order Set Target Passenger action to unload a specific unit from a transport.

9D7786E5.name: Revive Order With No Target
9D7786E5.hint: Returns an order with no target that will revive a specific unit. This is primarily for use in "Issue Order To Unit Group" actions.

8F55F540.name: Change Autocast Mode
8F55F540.hint: Returns an order to change the autocast mode for an ability command.  This is primarily for use in "Issue Order" and "Issue Order To Unit Group" actions.

00000334.name: Player For Order
00000334.hint: Returns the player number that the order is issued for.

E4A06F0A.name: Ability Command For Order
E4A06F0A.hint: Returns the ability command for the order.

00000348.name: Flag Is Enabled For Order
00000348.hint: Returns true if the specified flag is enabled.

14D0FF13.name: Target Item For Order
14D0FF13.hint: Returns the target for the order if the target is an item.

00000071.name: Target Point For Order
00000071.hint: Returns the target for the order if the target is a point.

CF8D6291.name: Target Position For Order
CF8D6291.hint: Returns the position of the target for an order, regardless of what type of target it is.

47BB7BFF.name: Target Type For Order
47BB7BFF.hint: Returns the target type for the specified order.

00000073.name: Target Unit For Order
00000073.hint: Returns the target for the order if the target is a unit.

29AFAB1F.name: Order Is Valid
29AFAB1F.hint: Returns true if the order is valid for the specified unit.

F4325823.name: Order Set Flag
F4325823.hint: Returns true if the specified flag is enabled.

B413B15B.name: Ability Command
B413B15B.hint: Constructs an ability command from an ability and an index.  An ability command is the combination of an ability and an index for a command within that ability.  Command indexes are 0 based.

5EE599E7.name: Ability Of Ability Command
5EE599E7.hint: Returns the ability being used for an ability command.  An ability command is the combination of an ability and an index for a command within that ability.

9D886DAF.name: Index Of Ability Command
9D886DAF.hint: Returns the index value of an ability command.  An ability command is the combination of an ability and an index for a command within that ability.

5B5E9C2E.name: Action Type For Ability Command
5B5E9C2E.hint: Returns the action type of an ability command.  An ability command is the combination of an ability and an index for a command within that ability.

A51B0998.name: Player Ping
A51B0998.hint: This event fires when the specified player pings the minimap.

3AF81856.name: Player Ping Unit
3AF81856.hint: Returns the unit pinged by a player.

E85E42E0.name: Player Ping Unit Type
E85E42E0.hint: Returns the unit type of the unit/snapshot pinged by a player.

054275DF.name: Player Ping Unit ControlPlayer
054275DF.hint: Returns the controlling player of the unit/snapshot by a player.

BB8134D2.name: Player Ping Unit UpkeepPlayer
BB8134D2.hint: Returns the upkeep player of the unit/snapshot pinged by a player.

035EAAEF.name: Player Ping Unit Position
035EAAEF.hint: Returns the position of the unit/snapshot pinged by a player.

8B98D4F9.name: Player Ping Unit Is Under Construction
8B98D4F9.hint: Returns whether or not the unit or snapshot pinged in a Player Ping event is under construction.

47CE984E.name: Player Ping Location
47CE984E.hint: Returns the location pinged by a player.

25B67D5F.name: Player Ping Is From Minimap
25B67D5F.hint: Returns whether the player ping originated from clicking the Minimap or not.

6471FA62.name: Player Ping Option
6471FA62.hint: Returns an index into the specific ping option chosen in the ping panel.

A03A4CC4.name: Show/Hide Player Pings
A03A4CC4.hint: Shows or Hides player created pings for the specified players.  If hidden, the specified players will no longer see the default pings created by pinging the minimap.  Pings created via triggers will still be shown.

00000199.name: Ping Minimap
00000199.hint: Pings the minimap using a standard ping model.  This ping cannot be modified after it is created.  Use a "Create Ping" action to create a more customizable ping that can be modified after creation.

747352A6.name: Ping Minimap Possible Enemy Start Locations
747352A6.hint: Pings the minimap at each possible enemy spawn location of the local player.  This ping cannot be modified after it is created.  Use a "Create Ping" action to create a more customizable ping that can be modified after creation.

1A51D70F.name: Create Ping (Deprecated)
1A51D70F.hint: Creates a minimap ping using the facing angle of a point.  Use "Last Created Ping" to refer to the created ping.

4F553268.name: Create Ping With Point Facing
4F553268.hint: Creates a minimap ping using the facing angle of a point.  Use "Last Created Ping" to refer to the created ping.

61BEDAD5.name: Create Ping From Data
61BEDAD5.hint: Creates a minimap ping using the facing angle of a point.  Use "Last Created Ping" to refer to the created ping.

F09DDBE5.name: Create Ping Facing Angle
F09DDBE5.hint: Creates a minimap ping facing a specified angle.  Use "Last Created Ping" to refer to the created ping.

14E7EDA5.name: Show/Hide Ping
14E7EDA5.hint: Shows or hides a minimap ping.

6A7E59D3.name: Last Created Ping
6A7E59D3.hint: Returns the last minimap ping created via a "Create Ping" action.

F47E52DA.name: Ping Is Visible
F47E52DA.hint: Returns true if the ping is visible.

1D8FF628.name: Move Ping
1D8FF628.hint: Moves the ping to a new location.

F713CAF4.name: Make Ping Face Angle
F713CAF4.hint: Instantly rotates the ping to face a specific angle, given in degrees.

137A7BD8.name: Attach Ping To Unit
137A7BD8.hint: Sets the ping location on the mini map to the position of the specified unit.

24AF481F.name: Position Of Ping
24AF481F.hint: Returns the position of the specified ping.

495914FD.name: Facing Angle Of Ping
495914FD.hint: Returns the current facing angle of the specified ping.

348B2771.name: Ping Unit
348B2771.hint: Returns the unit that is being pinged.

160D3874.name: Set Ping Scale
160D3874.hint: Sets the size of the ping.

B1CFA480.name: Set Ping Depth
B1CFA480.hint: Sets the depth of the ping compared to other pings.  Lower numbers will be render before higher numbers

01BF32CA.name: Set Ping Tooltip
01BF32CA.hint: Sets a ping's tooltip, which is displayed when a user points at the ping with the mouse.

FBDAE819.name: Set Ping Duration
FBDAE819.hint: Sets the duration of the ping, in game-time seconds.

3B7925CF.name: Set Ping Model
3B7925CF.hint: Sets the model of the ping.

C245D884.name: Set Ping Players
C245D884.hint: Sets which player groups get to see the ping.

63083C14.name: Set Ping Use Unit Team Color
63083C14.hint: Sets whether or not the ping should use the team color of the attached unit.

80A31841.name: Set Ping Use Unit Visibility
80A31841.hint: Sets whether or not the ping should use the visibility of the attached unit. (for example pings wont show up on enemy units under the fog of war)

838182D6.name: Set Ping Observer Display
838182D6.hint: When true ping will display for observers regardless of whether they are viewing the game through everyone vision, or player vision.

FDD9B85C.name: Set Ping Use Player Vision
FDD9B85C.hint: Sets whether or not the ping should use the vision of the local player at the point it exists when determining if it's visible or not.  This allows pings that aren't attached to units to easily be hidden when beneath the fog of war.

780A3562.name: Ping Scale
780A3562.hint: Returns the ping size as a real value.

E22343C7.name: Ping Depth
E22343C7.hint: Returns the ping depth as a real value.

77B0CBF3.name: Ping Tooltip
77B0CBF3.hint: Returns the tooltip text for a ping.

FFE4A881.name: Duration of Ping
FFE4A881.hint: Returns the ping duration as a real value.

027124D8.name: Ping Players
027124D8.hint: Returns the player group that sees the ping.

943DF2F7.name: Modify Player Property (Integer)
943DF2F7.hint: Modifies player properties such as resources as an integer.

4CA291C4.name: Modify Player Property (Real)
4CA291C4.hint: Modifies player properties such as supplies limit as a real.

00000051.name: Player Property (Integer)
00000051.hint: Returns the value of the specified player property as an integer.

7EFD6723.name: Modify Player Score (Integer)
7EFD6723.hint: Modifies player score such as units killed.

15003AC6.name: Modify Player Score (Real)
15003AC6.hint: Modifies player properties such as resources.

E2FCA970.name: Player Score Value (Integer)
E2FCA970.hint: Returns a statistic for the specified player as an integer.

80445C7C.name: Player Score Value (Real)
80445C7C.hint: Returns a statistic for the specified player as a real.

00000407.name: Turn Player Flag On/Off
00000407.hint: Enables or disables the specified flag for the player.

00000413.name: Player Flag Check
00000413.hint: Returns true if the specified flag is enabled.

34577ED6.name: Player License Check
34577ED6.hint: Returns true if the player has the specified license.

CA19F820.name: Player Access Check
CA19F820.hint: Returns true if the player has purchased the specified entity.

B611A2DA.name: Name Of Player
B611A2DA.hint: Returns the name of the player.

A5AB8322.name: Handle Of Player
A5AB8322.hint: Returns a unique Battle.net identifier for the player that will persist between name changes.

00000155.name: Race Of Player
00000155.hint: Returns the race of the player.

A364EF52.name: Hero Of Player
A364EF52.hint: Returns the hero of the player.

785FE78A.name: Skin Of Player
785FE78A.hint: Returns the skin of the player.

0C9C0762.name: Mount Of Player
0C9C0762.hint: Returns the mount of the player.

D7A349CF.name: Spray Of Player
D7A349CF.hint: Returns the chosen spray at the specified index for the player.

0700F547.name: Artifact Of Player
0700F547.hint: Returns the chosen artifact at the specified index for the player.

4988B6E2.name: Artifact Rank Of Player
4988B6E2.hint: Returns the rank of the chosen artifact at the specified index for the player.

2A6F4A29.name: Commander Of Player
2A6F4A29.hint: Returns the commander of the player.

53B9899B.name: Commander Level Of Player
53B9899B.hint: Returns the commander level of the player.

46B736B4.name: Commander Mastery Level Of Player
46B736B4.hint: Returns the commander mastery level of the player.

2FF15B58.name: Commander Mastery Talent Rank Of Player
2FF15B58.hint: Returns the rank of the chosen mastery talent at the specified index for the player.

853E3ADE.name: Commander Selected Prestige Of Player
853E3ADE.hint: Returns the selected commander prestige of the player.

EC9BA2B1.name: Brutal Plus Difficulty of Player
EC9BA2B1.hint: Returns the Brutal Plus difficulty level for the current player.

E972F9AC.name: Retry Mutation Index of Player
E972F9AC.hint: Returns the mutation index for retrying the previous random mutation game for a player. (Mutation Number shold be [0-3])

43A0D2F6.name: Allied Commander Enemy Wave Type
43A0D2F6.hint: Returns the Allied Commanders wave type for retrying a coop game for a player. Returns 0 for non-retry games.

00000151.name: Start Location Of Player
00000151.hint: Returns the point value of the start location for the player.

A7BB52AE.name: Controller Of Player
A7BB52AE.hint: Returns the controller of the specified player.  This function can return as Computer, User, None, or Neutral.

F1E1DAE1.name: Status Of Player
F1E1DAE1.hint: Returns the status of the player.

69EDDFF6.name: Set Player Color
69EDDFF6.hint: Sets the player color for the player.

65D2F111.name: Set Player Hero
65D2F111.hint: Sets the hero of the specified player.

D3BCC3BA.name: Set Player Skin
D3BCC3BA.hint: Sets the hero of the specified player.

8CF1C041.name: Set Player Console Skin
8CF1C041.hint: Sets the console skin of the specified player.

A3E34362.name: Apply Player Skin
A3E34362.hint: Sets the skin of the specified player.

6C2CD9DE.name: Apply Player Skin (Replacing Existing Unit)
6C2CD9DE.hint: Sets the skin of the specified player.This also replace the model of existed units.

0ECBD142.name: Set Player Mount
0ECBD142.hint: Sets the mount of the specified player.

E55A662D.name: Set Player Spray
E55A662D.hint: Sets the mount of the specified player.

2BE2A3C9.name: Set Player Commander
2BE2A3C9.hint: Sets the commander of the specified player.

D87D559C.name: Set Player Commander Level
D87D559C.hint: Sets the commander level of the specified player.

BF5965EB.name: Set Player Commander Mastery Level
BF5965EB.hint: Sets the commander mastery level of the specified player.

93A62F0C.name: Set Player Death Timer
93A62F0C.hint: Sets the death timer for the specified player.

AED628D3.name: Set Player Bounds
AED628D3.hint: This does not affect pathing. Passing in a null region will reset to the global playable bounds. The provided region will be clamped within the global playable bounds.

9BE5E091.name: Add Player Talent
9BE5E091.hint: Adds the specified Talent to the Player. Validators and triggers can then test whether the player has the talent.

B7D4E5C6.name: Remove Player Talent
B7D4E5C6.hint: Remove the specified Talent from the Player.

22A8F646.name: Add Player Response
22A8F646.hint: Adds the specified player response to the Player. Player response is player based unit damage/death response.

6914EAD1.name: Remove Player Response
6914EAD1.hint: Remove the specified Response from the Player.

093C2762.name: Clear Player Response
093C2762.hint: Remove the specified Response from the Player.

60A98A5A.name: Player Color
60A98A5A.hint: Returns the player color of the player.

BDF27E57.name: Override Player Option
BDF27E57.hint: Setting the value to "No Value" will clear the override and return the value to whatever the player had selected previously. If an override value is set, option UI will be disabled for the player. Overrides are removed when leaving a game.

45C60DAF.name: Player Hotkey Profile
45C60DAF.hint: Currently this only provides their initial hotkey profile when the game starts.

B83E0A67.name: Player Property Changed
B83E0A67.hint: This event fires when the specified property for the specified player changes.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the player.  Use "Triggering Player Property" to get the property that changed.

057E2485.name: Player Joins Game
057E2485.hint: This event fires when a player joins  the game.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the player.

54B13468.name: Player Leaves Game
54B13468.hint: This event fires when a player leaves the game with the specified victory type.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the player.

00000053.name: Triggering Player
00000053.hint: Returns the triggering player as an integer.

A57F57DA.name: Triggering Player Property
A57F57DA.hint: Returns the triggering player property in response to "Player Property Changed" events.

686859EE.name: Triggering Player Property Change (Integer)
686859EE.hint: Returns the triggering player property amount changed in response to "Player Property Changed" events.

040F0304.name: Triggering Player Property Change (Real)
040F0304.hint: Returns the triggering player property amount changed in response to "Player Property Changed" events.

2AB8173B.name: Player Add Label
2AB8173B.hint: Model aspects can be controlled based on which labels a player has.

9FD7FFFF.name: Player Remove Label
9FD7FFFF.hint: Removes the specified label from the player.

7DB0C9D2.name: Player Remove All Labels
7DB0C9D2.hint: Removes all labels from the specified player.

EE06C602.name: Player Has Label
EE06C602.hint: Returns true if the player has the specified label.

275E6E7C.name: Player Add Reward
275E6E7C.hint: Adds the selected reward to the player.  Note: You cannot add a reward with a license associated.

CE6AFC94.name: Player Changes Alliances
CE6AFC94.hint: This event fires when a player changes alliances.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the player.

C29FFDCD.name: Set Alliance
C29FFDCD.hint: Sets alliance settings between two players.  This action will determined how two players treat each other, such as whether or not their units fight.  Pushable means that one player's units are allowed to push another player's units out of the way if they are trying to path through them.

C6A9716F.name: Set Alliance (One-Way)
C6A9716F.hint: Sets the alliance settings of one player towards another player, but not vice-versa.  This action will determine how the Source Player treats the Target Player, such as whether or not the Source Player's units fight the Target Player's units.  Pushable means that the Target Player's units are allowed to push the Source Player's units out of the way if they are trying to path through them.

00000239.name: Set Alliance Aspect
00000239.hint: Sets the alliance aspect of one player towards another player, but not vice-versa.  This action will turn enable or disable the chosen Alliance Aspect, such as shared vision or hostility, for the Source Player towards the Target Player.  Pushable means that the Target Player's units are allowed to push the Source Player's units out of the way if they are trying to path through them.

089982FF.name: Set Alliance For Player Group
089982FF.hint: Changes alliance settings for all players in the player group.  Each player applies the requested alliance setting to every other player in the player group.  Pushable means that one player's units are allowed to push another player's units out of the way if they are trying to path through them.

8A8CD531.name: Set Alliance Between Two Player Groups
8A8CD531.hint: Changes alliance settings for all players in the player group.  Each player applies the requested alliance setting to every other player in the player group.  Pushable means that one player's units are allowed to push another player's units out of the way if they are trying to path through them.

E4C1C421.name: Set Alliance Aspect For Player Group
E4C1C421.hint: Changes alliance aspect settings for all players in the player group.  Each player applies the requested alliance aspect setting to every other player in the player group.

00000240.name: Alliance Aspect
00000240.hint: Returns true of the source player is treating the target player with the specified alliance aspect.  To check if two players are mutually treating each other with a given alliance aspect, use this function again with the players in reverse order.

CA3AB9A9.name: Get Relationship Between Players
CA3AB9A9.hint: Returns true of the source player is treating the target player as ally, enemy, or neutral.  Use the Mutual options to check if two players treat each other as mutual allies, enemies, or neutrals.

CACCC2D8.name: Set Player Difficulty Level
CACCC2D8.hint: Sets the difficulty level for the specified player.

2DFE4998.name: Difficulty Level For Player
2DFE4998.hint: Returns the difficulty level for the specified player.

2B28BF2F.name: Difficulty Level Is Enabled
2B28BF2F.hint: Returns true if the difficulty level is enabled.

643F49E4.name: Name Of Difficulty Level
643F49E4.hint: Returns the name of the difficulty level.

52FE5912.name: APM Of Difficulty Level
52FE5912.hint: Returns the actions per minute for the difficulty level specified.

CDFB6082.name: Add Charge Regen Time For Player (Deprecated)
CDFB6082.hint: Adds to the amount of time it takes to regenerate the specified player charge link.

AF67EB9F.name: Remove Charge Regen Time For Player (Deprecated)
AF67EB9F.hint: Clears the amount of time it takes to regenerate the specified player charge link.

E8E2A8ED.name: Add Charge Remaining Regen Time For Player
E8E2A8ED.hint: Adds to the amount of time remaining to regenerate the specified player charge link.

C2C6163D.name: Add Charge Full Regen Time For Player
C2C6163D.hint: Adds to the full amount of time it takes to regenerate the specified player charge link.

1D502AEE.name: Add Charge Used For Player
1D502AEE.hint: Consumes the specified number of charges for the specified player charge link.

3D9A3C0C.name: Remove Charge Used For Player
3D9A3C0C.hint: Clears the number of used charges for the specified player charge link.

5F8A9E51.name: Charge Regen Remaining For Player
5F8A9E51.hint: Returns the charge regen time for the specified player charge link.

694FE99D.name: Charge Regen Full For Player
694FE99D.hint: Returns the charge regen time for the specified player charge link.  If Adjustment Only is true, it will only return the "bonus" amount added to (or subtracted from) the full regen time.

8AFB7F8B.name: Player Charge Used
8AFB7F8B.hint: Returns the number of charges used for the specified player charge link.

12E0F820.name: Pause/Unpause All Charges For Player
12E0F820.hint: Pauses or unpauses regen for all charges for the specified player.

95EAE029.name: Add Cooldown For Player
95EAE029.hint: Adds time to the specified player cooldown link.

E3741424.name: Remove Cooldown For Player
E3741424.hint: Clears the specified player cooldown link.

1AA9CCBB.name: Player Cooldown
1AA9CCBB.hint: Returns the cooldown time for the specified player cooldown link.

14B399BD.name: Pause/Unpause All Cooldowns For Player
14B399BD.hint: Pauses or unpauses all cooldowns for the specified player.

00000192.name: All Players
00000192.hint: Returns a player group containing all players.

F463A414.name: Active Players
F463A414.hint: Returns a player group containing all active players.

B90786F4.name: Allies/Enemies Of Player
B90786F4.hint: Returns all players that are considered allies or enemies, determined by the Alliance parameter, of the specified player.

1B53B94F.name: Allies/Enemies Of Player (Count Inactive And Self)
1B53B94F.hint: Returns all players that are considered allies or enemies, determined by the Alliance parameter, of the specified player. (Count inactive players, and the player itself would be count as a ally)

00000057.name: Convert Player To Player Group
00000057.hint: Returns a player group containing the specified player.  This allows you to call a specific player as a player group parameter in triggers.

15C2C248.name: Add Player To Player Group
15C2C248.hint: Adds a player to a player group.

BA6A2F7E.name: Add Player Group To Player Group
BA6A2F7E.hint: Adds the players in one player group to another player group.

A8D356D7.name: Remove Player From Player Group
A8D356D7.hint: Removes a player from the specified player group.

565D7F83.name: Remove Player Group From Player Group
565D7F83.hint: Removes all the players in one player group from another player group.

00000059.name: Remove All Players From Player Group
00000059.hint: Clears a player group so it no longer has any players in it.

00000061.name: Number Of Players In Player Group
00000061.hint: Returns the number of players in a player group.

00000062.name: Player In Player Group
00000062.hint: Returns true if the specified player is in the specified player group.

00000215.name: Player From Player Group
00000215.hint: Returns the player stored at the specified Index of the specified player group.  For example: If you have players 4, 5, and 6 in a player group Index 1 would be Player 4, and this function would return 4.

00000214.name: Copy Of Player Group
00000214.hint: Returns the copy of a player group.

9E6A3A6C.name: Union Of Player Groups
9E6A3A6C.hint: Returns the copy of a player group.

0DE37AD9.name: Intersection Of Player Groups
0DE37AD9.hint: Returns the copy of a player group.

B525B112.name: For Each Player In Player Group
B525B112.hint: Executes a For Loop using an integer value.  This will run the action set included under the For Each Player In Player Group action for every player in the specified player group.  For example: If you put a "Set Player Color" action that changed the color for Player <Integer variable>, under a For Each Player In Player Group action with the Player Group parameter set to All Players, it would change the color for all players.

36876ACF.name: For Each Player In Player Group Deprecated
36876ACF.hint: Executes a For Loop using an integer value.  This will run the action set included under the For Each Player In Player Group action for every player in the specified player group.  For example: If you put a "Set Player Color" action that changed the color for Player <Integer variable>, under a For Each Player In Player Group action with the Player Group parameter set to All Players, it would change the color for all players.

5084725D.name: Pick Each Player In Player Group
5084725D.hint: Picks each player in the specified Player Group and runs the associated action set.  The "Picked Player" function must be used to reference the iterating value inside of the loop.

0155FBC1.name: Pick Each Player In Player Group Deprecated
0155FBC1.hint: Picks each player in the specified Player Group and runs the associated action set.  The "Picked Player" function must be used to reference the iterating value inside of the loop.

8570CA61.name: Picked Player
8570CA61.hint: Returns an integer value equal to the iterating value inside of a "Pick Each Player In Player Group" action.  This function will return 0 if used outisde of a pick each player in group loop.

36ABE390.name: Picked Player Deprecated
36ABE390.hint: Returns an integer value equal to the iterating value inside of a "Pick Each Player In Player Group" action.  This function will return 0 if used outisde of a pick each player in group loop.

EF949A7D.name: OBSOLETE - Point Facing Angle
EF949A7D.hint: This is an obsolete version of this function and will no longer show up in the function list.  This should be replaced with the newer version to avoid issues.

B097202E.name: Point From XYZ
B097202E.hint: Returns a 3D location as a point.  This allows you to specify any 3D location on the map as a viable value for a point parameter.

00000022.name: Point From XY
00000022.hint: Returns a 2D location as a point.  This allows you to specify any location on the map grid as a viable value for a point parameter.

1EA7F07C.name: Point From Name
1EA7F07C.hint: Returns a pre-placed point with the given name.

DBF8E9E3.name: Move Point
DBF8E9E3.hint: Moves a point to the specified position.

6FAF46B4.name: Make Point Face Angle
6FAF46B4.hint: Changes the facing of a point.

51E3F39C.name: Set Point Height
51E3F39C.hint: Changes the height of a point, relative to the terrain.

00000024.name: X Of Point
00000024.hint: Returns the X coordinate of the specified point as a real value.

00000025.name: Y Of Point
00000025.hint: Returns the Y coordinate of the specified point as a real value.

DB4E6196.name: Facing Angle Of Point
DB4E6196.hint: Returns the facing angle of the specified point as a real value, in degrees.

6E03EE18.name: Height Of Point
6E03EE18.hint: Returns the height of the specified point, relative to the terrain, as a real value.  To place a point with a non-zero height in the Terrain Editor, use the Three Dimensional point type.

00000026.name: Angle Between Points
00000026.hint: Returns the angle from point 1 to point 2 as a real value, in degrees.

00000027.name: Distance Between Points
00000027.hint: Returns the distance between two points as a real value.

F4291BF5.name: Distance Squared Between Points
F4291BF5.hint: Returns the squared distance between two points as a real value.

00000036.name: Point Is In Region
00000036.hint: Returns true if the specified point is located within the specified region.

C53369A7.name: Point Facing Angle
C53369A7.hint: Returns a point with the position of the specified point, and the facing of the specified angle.

EF33C610.name: Point With Z Offset
EF33C610.hint: Returns a point with the X and Y position of the specified point, and Z position of the specified Z.

00000023.name: Point With Offset
00000023.hint: Returns a point offset by given horizontal and vertical distances.

00000241.name: Point With Polar Offset
00000241.hint: Returns a point offset by a distance toward an angle, specified in degrees.

E62D9C8C.name: Point Offset Towards Point
E62D9C8C.hint: Returns a point offset by a specified distance toward a target point.

3424196B.name: Random Point Between Points
3424196B.hint: Returns a random point along the line segment connecting the specified points.

E1B8DD31.name: Reflected Point
E1B8DD31.hint: Returns the point that an object would bounce to if it was travelling from the source point and hit a wall with the specified normal angle at the target point.

53C179FB.name: Interpolated Point
53C179FB.hint: Returns a point along the line defined by the two given points. The position along the line is determined by the given fraction. 0.0 means the source point, 1.0 means the target point, and 0.5 means half-way between the two. Values outside the 0.0 to 1.0 range result in valid extrapolations along the line beyond the given points.

44B227B6.name: Mid-Point
44B227B6.hint: Returns the point half-way between the two given points.

8E92E713.name: Point Is Passable
8E92E713.hint: Returns true if the specified point is pathable to ground units.

6FC6704E.name: Points Connected By Pathing
6FC6704E.hint: Returns true if the specified points are connected by ground pathing.

5A91C75B.name: Pathing Cost Between Points
5A91C75B.hint: Returns the ground pathing cost between two points as an integer.

F0C49951.name: Pathing Type At Point
F0C49951.hint: Returns the type of pathing at the specific point. Ground pathing allows all units, Building pathing means a building has blocked pathing, Cliff pathing means the terrain cliffs are blocking pathing, and Unpathable means that units can never move through the point.

B8AD02AA.name: Cinematic Portrait
B8AD02AA.hint: Returns the cinematic portrait at the specified position.

8F6FB1B4.name: Dialog Item Portrait
8F6FB1B4.hint: Converts a Dialog Item of type Portrait into a Portrait that can be used to send transmissions etc.

C97BEF46.name: Create Portrait
C97BEF46.hint: Creates a portrait on the screen.

7720F36F.name: Show/Hide Portrait
7720F36F.hint: Shows or hides the specified portrait for the specified player group.

FE63D1E9.name: Portrait Is Visible
FE63D1E9.hint: Returns true if the specified portrait is visible for the specified player.

3F7D22D8.name: Play Portrait Animation
3F7D22D8.hint: Tells a portrait to play an animation.

A291ADB0.name: Set Portrait Camera
A291ADB0.hint: Sets the portrait camera using string values.

FDA30AFB.name: Set Portrait Border Texture
FDA30AFB.hint: Sets the border texture for a portrait.

A98541DB.name: Set Portrait Light
A98541DB.hint: Sets the light for a portrait.

67E3C41A.name: Set Portrait Model
67E3C41A.hint: Sets the model for a portrait.

63DDB7B9.name: Set Portrait Model And Play Animation
63DDB7B9.hint: Sets the model for a portrait and plays an animation on it.

DAA86C93.name: Set Portrait Position
DAA86C93.hint: Sets a portrait's position on the screen.

DBD462D9.name: Set Portrait Size
DBD462D9.hint: Sets the size of a portrait.

3091096C.name: Set Portrait Mouse Target
3091096C.hint: Sets whether the portrait is a valid mouse target or not.  If the portrait is not a valid mouse target, mouse clicks will go through the portrait.

42998B50.name: Set Portrait Render Type
42998B50.hint: Sets the render type of the portrait to determine during which pass of the UI it should be rendered.

177118DA.name: Pause/Unpause Portrait
177118DA.hint: Pauses or unpauses the animation in the specified portrait.

07F97D03.name: Set Portrait Tint Color
07F97D03.hint: Set the tint color of the specified portrait.

A12163AE.name: Set Portrait Team Color
A12163AE.hint: Set the team color of the specified portrait.

28A2358F.name: Set Portrait Actor
28A2358F.hint: Set the actor of the specified portrait.

91DBED38.name: Turn Portrait Border On/Off
91DBED38.hint: Turns a portrait's border on or off.

497ABB01.name: Turn Portrait Background On/Off
497ABB01.hint: Turns a portrait's background on or off.

7CB54CDD.name: Turn Portrait Fullscreen On/Off
7CB54CDD.hint: Turns a portrait's fullscreen on or off.

A70BA1A1.name: Turn Portrait Offscreen On/Off
A70BA1A1.hint: Sets whether or not the specified portrait is rendered offscreen.

C15B101F.name: Turn Portrait Transition On/Off
C15B101F.hint: Turns a portrait's transition to on or off.

28A3BFEE.name: Force Portrait Transition On/Off
28A3BFEE.hint: Forces the transition model of the portrait to on or off.  Forcing it on will cause it to render until it is no longer forced on.  If the instant parameter is set to false, the transition will play it's birth (on) or death (off) animation.

A5822235.name: Clear Portrait Animation
A5822235.hint: Clears an animation on a portrait.

A5C74E7D.name: Wait For Portrait To Load
A5C74E7D.hint: Waits until the specified portrait is finished loading.  This may be necessary before some operations may be applied to the portrait.

0936F71D.name: Region From Name
0936F71D.hint: Returns a pre-placed region with the given name.

9AD8B4CA.name: Set Playable Map Area
9AD8B4CA.hint: Sets the playable map area, which is the area within which units are generally confined.  The edges of the specified region will be rounded to the nearest even-numbered cell edge.  Camera bounds will be automatically adjusted to accomodate the new playable map area.  Use the "Set Camera Bounds" action to change the camera bounds.

00000030.name: Convert Circle To Region
00000030.hint: Returns a circular region from a center point and a radius.

00000029.name: Convert Rectangle To Region
00000029.hint: Returns a rectangular region from 4 bound values.

00000032.name: Add Circle To Region
00000032.hint: Adds a circle to a region.

00000031.name: Add Rectangle To Region
00000031.hint: Adds a rectangle to a region.

00000033.name: Add Region To Region
00000033.hint: Adds a region to another region.

307ED312.name: Random Point In Region
307ED312.hint: Returns a random point in the specified region.  For regions with multiple shapes, this is not guaranteed to work.

00000039.name: Center Of Region
00000039.hint: Returns the center point of a region.

51FCDFC1.name: Unit Attached To Region
51FCDFC1.hint: Returns a unit attached to a region.

1E29721A.name: Attach Region To Unit
1E29721A.hint: Attaches a region to a unit.

00000034.name: Move Region
00000034.hint: Moves a region to a point.

8C52DBB5.name: Width Of Region
8C52DBB5.hint: Returns the width of the specified region.

DEBF6EB9.name: Height Of Region
DEBF6EB9.hint: Returns the height of the specified region.

00000037.name: Bottom-Left Of Region Bounds
00000037.hint: Returns the minimum bounds of a region. For a rectangle region, this is the bottom-left corner of the rectangle. In the general case, this is a point comprising the left-most X coordinate and the bottom-most Y coordinate of the region.

00000038.name: Top-Right Of Region Bounds
00000038.hint: Returns the maximum bounds of a region. For a rectangle region, this is the top-right corner of the rectangle. In the general case, this is a point comprising the right-most X coordinate and the top-most Y coordinate of the region.

1DE4F900.name: Subgroup Index
1DE4F900.hint: Returns the active subgroup index for the specified player's unit selection.

09E9455C.name: Selected Subgroup Units
09E9455C.hint: Returns the selected units subgroup for the specified player.

00000175.name: Select/Deselect Unit
00000175.hint: Selects or deselects a unit for a player.

32DD830D.name: Select Next Subgroup
32DD830D.hint: Selects the next subgroup for a player.

3512302B.name: Select Previous Subgroup
3512302B.hint: Selects the previous subgroup for a player.

00000178.name: Select/Deselect Unit Group
00000178.hint: Selects or deselects a unit group for a player.

00000176.name: Clear Unit Selection
00000176.hint: Clears all unit selections for a player.

00000177.name: Unit Is Selected
00000177.hint: Returns true if the specified unit is selected by the specified player.

A66AE70B.name: Unit Type Is Selected
A66AE70B.hint: Returns true if at least one unit of the specified unit type is selected by the player.

00000179.name: Selected Units
00000179.hint: Returns the selected units for the specified player.

00000222.name: Unit Is Selected
00000222.hint: This event fires when a unit is selected.  Use "Triggering Unit" to refer to the unit being selected or deselected.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the player that selected the unit.

9A0A8B06.name: Store Unit Selection
9A0A8B06.hint: Stores which units a given player has selected.  Use the "Restore Unit Selection" action to restore this selection.

862673FA.name: Restore Unit Selection
862673FA.hint: Restores the last stored unit selection for a given player.  Use the "Store Unit Selection" action to store a unit selection.

47EA2E7C.name: Flash Unit Selection
47EA2E7C.hint: Flashes a ring around a unit for given period of time.

C47F05C7.name: Copy Unit Control Groups
C47F05C7.hint: Copy all control group states on a unit to another unit.

AB3BC844.name: Add Unit To Control Group
AB3BC844.hint: Adds a unit to a control group for a player.

067344D2.name: Add Unit Group To Control Group
067344D2.hint: Adds a unit group to a control group for a player.

8F5E4BCA.name: Remove Unit From Control Group
8F5E4BCA.hint: Removes a unit from a control group for a player.

A848A5CD.name: Remove Unit Group From Control Group
A848A5CD.hint: Removes a unit group from a control group for a player.

164B2FD7.name: Clear Control Group
164B2FD7.hint: Removes all units from a control group for a player.

00000275.name: Unit Is Clicked
00000275.hint: This event fires when a unit is clicked by a player.  Use "Triggering Unit" to refer to the unit being clicked.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the player.

00000272.name: Unit Is Highlighted
00000272.hint: This event fires when a unit is highlighted or unhighlighted by a player.  Use "Triggering Unit" to refer to the unit being highlighted/unhighlighted.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the player.

BEB5B53A.name: Play Sound Scene File (Deprecated)
BEB5B53A.hint: WARNING: THIS IS AN OLD FUNCTION AND ONLY REMAINS FOR BACKWARDS COMPATIBILITY WITH WINGS OF LIBERTY CUTSCENES.  DO NOT USE THIS FOR NEW CUTSCENES.  Plays a sound with the specified scene file for the specified player group.  Scene files can be set up using the Previewer module.

4A5C98F6.name: Play Sound Scene  (Deprecated)
4A5C98F6.hint: Plays a sound for the specified players, and plays the specified animation on the specified units.  The animation on the units will be sync'd up with the sound.

8457B54F.name: Play Sound  (Deprecated)
8457B54F.hint: Plays a sound for the specified player group.  Use the "Last Played Sound" function to refer to this sound.

2E34DB85.name: Play Sound On Unit (Deprecated)
2E34DB85.hint: Plays a sound at a unit for the specified player group.  Use the "Last Played Sound" function to refer to this sound.

BBBDE723.name: Play Sound At Point (Deprecated)
BBBDE723.hint: Plays a sound at a point for the specified player group.  Use the "Last Played Sound" function to refer to this sound.

63857CE2.name: Play Sound On Unit
63857CE2.hint: Plays a sound at a unit for the specified player group.  Use the "Last Played Sound" function to refer to this sound.

37EFFD14.name: Play Sound At Point
37EFFD14.hint: Plays a sound at a point for the specified player group.  Use the "Last Played Sound" function to refer to this sound.

651D9322.name: Play Sound
651D9322.hint: Plays a sound for the specified player group.  Use the "Last Played Sound" function to refer to this sound.

C9ADFB21.name: Last Played Sound
C9ADFB21.hint: Returns the last sound played via a "Play Sound" action.

5CF85ABA.name: Skip To Sound Offset
5CF85ABA.hint: Skip to a specific time within a sound.

00000185.name: Move Sound
00000185.hint: Moves a sound to the specified location.

00000408.name: Wait For Sound
00000408.hint: Waits for a sound is a certain amount of seconds from the offset type.

1DDE5BDA.name: Stop All Trigger Sounds
1DDE5BDA.hint: Stops all sounds explicitly played through triggers.

1882D01B.name: Set Sound Listener Gender
1882D01B.hint: The listener gender will be used to look for alternate sound data associated with voice overs.

29BBB8F3.name: Sound Asset Index
29BBB8F3.hint: Returns the sound asset index for a Sound Link.  Sound Links are used to refer to specific sounds.  Sound links are comprised of a sound ID (to identify the sound data entry) and an asset index (to identify the asset within that data entry).

577C6232.name: Sound ID
577C6232.hint: Returns the sound ID for a given Sound Link.  Sound Links are used to refer to specific sounds.  Sound links are comprised of a sound ID (to identify the sound data entry) and an asset index (to identify the asset within that data entry).

D5671C0B.name: Sound Link
D5671C0B.hint: Returns a Sound Link for a given sound ID and asset index.  Sound Links are used to refer to specific sounds.  Sound links are comprised of a sound ID (to identify the sound data entry) and an asset index (to identify the asset within that data entry).

5AF17B44.name: Sound Subtitle Text
5AF17B44.hint: Returns Subtitle text for the given Sound Link.

C0749AB9.name: Sound Duration
C0749AB9.hint: Returns the duration of the sound.

1FC7FE9B.name: Mark Sound For Duration Preload
1FC7FE9B.hint: The duration for the given sound will be preloaded during the loading screen.  Any sounds that are explicitly referenced in triggers will automatically be preloaded.  The Info parameter must specify a direct sound value, not a variable or function call.  Sound lengths marked for duration preload are network-sync'd, allowing them to be safely used for multiplayer.

845B0678.name: Query Sound Duration
845B0678.hint: Send a network query for the duration of a sound.  This will allow the sound duration to be accessed even if the sound duration has not been preloaded.  Use "Wait For Sound Durations" to ensure that all results are received before attempting to access the duration value.

12E16952.name: Wait For Sound Durations
12E16952.hint: Waits until all queries sent with "Query Sound Duration" have been received for all players.

9D67F076.name: Play Soundtrack
9D67F076.hint: Plays a soundtrack for the specified player group.  If the Make Default parameter is set to Do, then the default soundtrack will be set to this soundtrack.  If this soundtrack is not continuous, it will repeat from the beginning when it ends, after the delay time.

5A41C578.name: Pause Soundtrack
5A41C578.hint: Pauses a soundtrack for the specified player group.

29E51225.name: Stop Soundtrack (Current)
29E51225.hint: Stops a soundtrack for the specified player group. Queued soundtracks are not affected.

BF972A93.name: Stop Soundtrack (Current & Queued)
BF972A93.hint: Stops the current & queued soundtrack for the specified player group.

76E5F423.name: Wait For Soundtrack
76E5F423.hint: Waits for soundtrack playback to end.

678683E1.name: Set Default Soundtrack
678683E1.hint: Sets the default soundtrack.  The default soundtrack will play when there are no other soundtracks being played.

12FCBA7A.name: Enable/Disable Soundtrack Continuous
12FCBA7A.hint: Sets a soundtrack to play once or play continuously.

AF1FAF75.name: Set Soundtrack Delay
AF1FAF75.hint: Sets the amount of time between when one soundtrack finishes and another one begins.

7FD4FA0E.name: Enable/Disable Soundtrack Shuffle
7FD4FA0E.hint: Enables or disables cue and/or index shuffling for a soundtrack.  Index shuffling corresponds to the asset array in the sound data.  Cue shuffling corresponds to the array of sounds in each soundtrack data.

F0DF33AB.name: Mute/Unmute Sound Channel
F0DF33AB.hint: Mutes or unmutes a sound channel for the specified player group.

43EB1F65.name: Pause Sound Channel
43EB1F65.hint: Pauses all sounds in a sound channel for the specified player group.

38415B68.name: Stop Sound Channel
38415B68.hint: Stops all sounds in a sound channel for the specified players.

3434F38C.name: Set Sound Channel Volume
3434F38C.hint: Sets a specified sound channel to a volume for the specified player group.

3B8D5BC4.name: Set All Sound Channel Volumes
3B8D5BC4.hint: Sets the volume for all sound channels for the specified player group.

54739F28.name: Set Sound Factors
54739F28.hint: Sets sound factors for distance, doppler, and rolloff.

F7BB6A26.name: Set Sound Reverb For Players
F7BB6A26.hint: Sets sound reverb for specific players

ABB68C4F.name: Play Sound Scene
ABB68C4F.hint: Plays a sound for the specified players, and plays the specified animation on the specified units.  The animation on the units will be sync'd up with the sound.

724BBE1B.name: Create Stat Event
724BBE1B.hint: Blizzard only.  Creates a new stat event with the given name.  You can then add data to that state event before sending it to Battle.net.

32BA9E2D.name: Add String Data to Stat Event
32BA9E2D.hint: Blizzard only.  Adds the Key-Value pair to the Stat Event.

A0A2962F.name: Add Integer Data to Stat Event
A0A2962F.hint: Blizzard only.  Adds the Key-Value pair to the Stat Event.

EC2BD155.name: Add Real Data to Stat Event
EC2BD155.hint: Blizzard only.  Adds the Key-Value pair to the Stat Event.

365A883E.name: Send Stat Event
365A883E.hint: Blizzard only.  Sends the Stat Event to Battle.net.  The Stat Event is destroyed.

D2B30562.name: Last Created Stat Event
D2B30562.hint: Returns the last created Stat Event.

33244FA8.name: Planet Panel Planet Selected
33244FA8.hint: This event fires when a player clicks on a planet on the planet panel.  Use "Clicked Planet" to get the planet that was clicked.

4625F7F7.name: Planet Panel Launched
4625F7F7.hint: This event fires when the specified player opens the planet panel.

A04EAC0E.name: Planet Panel Canceled
A04EAC0E.hint: This event fires when the specified player closes the planet panel.

46EF10F9.name: Planet Panel Pressed Replay Button
46EF10F9.hint: This event fires when the specified player presses the replay button on the planet panel.

5DD72CF3.name: Planet Panel Birth Complete
5DD72CF3.hint: This event fires when the planet panel finishes playing its birth animation.

5738F570.name: Planet Panel Death Complete
5738F570.hint: This event fires when the planet panel finishes playing its death animation.

4FA1D0CD.name: Clicked Planet
4FA1D0CD.hint: Returns the planet that triggered "Planet Panel Mission Selected".

4F98822C.name: Selected Planet
4F98822C.hint: Returns the planet the specified player has selected.

0DFB367A.name: Selected Mission Difficulty
0DFB367A.hint: Returns the desired difficulty at which the player wanted to play the mission.

9148F568.name: Planet Panel Contact Button State
9148F568.hint: Returns the current state of the contact button on the planet panel.

6BA3777F.name: Set Planet Panel Contact Button State
6BA3777F.hint: Sets the state of the contact button on the planet panel for the specified players.

03E8CE6D.name: Set Planet Panel Background Image
03E8CE6D.hint: Sets the background image for the planet panel for the specified players.

D3D9E2FF.name: Enable/Disable Planet Panel Close Button
D3D9E2FF.hint: Enables or disables the close button on the planet panel for the specified players.

A7380A9D.name: Set Planet Panel Close Button Text
A7380A9D.hint: Sets the text that is displayed on the close button on the planet panel for the specified players.

30B2D029.name: Set Planet Panel Close Button Shortcut
30B2D029.hint: Sets the hotkey for the close button on the planet panel for the specified players.

801DDCC7.name: Set Planet Panel Close Button Tooltip
801DDCC7.hint: Sets the tooltip text for the close button on the planet panel for the specified players.

151FE05D.name: Enable/Disable Planet Panel Dismiss Button
151FE05D.hint: Enables or disables the dismiss button on the planet panel for the specified players.

76D6BC75.name: Set Selected Planet
76D6BC75.hint: Selects the specified planet on the planet panel for the specified players.

1BDD412A.name: Clear Selected Planet
1BDD412A.hint: Clears the planet selection on the planet panel for the specified players.

B4A6A5B4.name: Destroy All Planets
B4A6A5B4.hint: Removes all planets from the planet panel for the specified players.

A4514899.name: Destroy Planet
A4514899.hint: Removes the specified planet from the planet panel.

BDA978A3.name: Create Planet
BDA978A3.hint: Creates a new planet on the planet panel for the specified players.  Use "Last Created Planet" to refer to the planet that was created.

59E2C6BA.name: Last Created Planet
59E2C6BA.hint: Returns the last planet created with "Create Planet".

B9237D66.name: Set Planet Name
B9237D66.hint: Sets the name fo the specified planet.

7FA89636.name: Set Planet State
7FA89636.hint: Sets the visibility state of the specified planet.

E4236D69.name: Set Planet Model
E4236D69.hint: Sets the model for the specified planet.

4D14B15E.name: Set Planet Background Model
4D14B15E.hint: Sets the background model for the specified planet.

C9A82E1C.name: Set Planet Players
C9A82E1C.hint: Sets the player group that the specified planet will display for.

EFCAAF54.name: Set Planet Description

0555A44E.name: Set Campaign Progress Campaign Finished
0555A44E.hint: Flags the campaign as finished or unfinished for the specified campaign for the specified player.

EA5470DA.name: Delete Campaign Save
EA5470DA.hint: Will delete the save file specified by the SaveName field in Campaign Data in GameUI Data for the current campaign

4F034A95.name: Enable Campaign Saves
4F034A95.hint: If campaign saves are enabled, all saves made will be copied into the file specified by the SaveName field in Campaign Data in GameUI Data for the current campaign

A88BEB03.name: Campaign Mode
A88BEB03.hint: Turns campaign mode on or off for a player group.  This will only work for Blizzard maps.

10C7E0AB.name: Story Create Planet Panel
10C7E0AB.hint: Pre-Create the Planet Panel so it's ready for use in Story Mode.  This will only work for Blizzard maps.

B88E5C2B.name: Story Mode
B88E5C2B.hint: Turns story mode on or off for a player group. This will only work for Blizzard maps.

0FF645BE.name: Player In Story Mode
0FF645BE.hint: Returns true if the specified player is in story mode.  Use the "Story Mode" action to turn story mode on and off for a player.

BD076980.name: Story Set Change
BD076980.hint: Prepares the graphics engine for a set change.

00000130.name: Combine Strings Multiple
00000130.hint: Combines multiple strings together.  Very useful when returning multiple string variables.

5A89F099.name: Combine Text Multiple
5A89F099.hint: Combines multiple text entries together. Useful for combining text variables.

00000010.name: String Equal
00000010.hint: Returns true if the two strings are the same.

D1588D5B.name: String Compare
D1588D5B.hint: Returns 0 if the two strings are the same. Positive value means first character that doesn't match is greater in String1. Negative means it's greater in String2.

00000007.name: String Length
00000007.hint: Returns the number of characters within a string.

A078FB65.name: Word Of String
A078FB65.hint: Returns the indexed word from a string.  Words are considered to be separated by whitespace.  Returns "No String" if the requested index is beyond the number of words in the given string.

00000009.name: Substring
00000009.hint: Pulls a substring by character start to end count.

4E152EAE.name: Position Of Substring
4E152EAE.hint: Searches for a substring within a string and returns the numerical position of the substring within the string.

00000011.name: String Containment
00000011.hint: Checks if a string can be found within another string and returns true if present and false if not present.

A6A76E21.name: String With Indexed Replacement
A6A76E21.hint: Replaces all characters that exist between two other characters in the string.

1ECBD20E.name: String With Search Replacement
1ECBD20E.hint: Replaces one or more occcurrences of a substring inside a string.

E9C385D5.name: Text With Search Replacement
E9C385D5.hint: Replaces one or more occcurrences of a substring inside text.

312E45EA.name: Convert Time To Text
312E45EA.hint: Convert a time value, in seconds, to text using one of various formats

00000008.name: Convert String Case
00000008.hint: Converts a string to upper case or lower case.

A0732ED7.name: Convert Text Case
A0732ED7.hint: Converts text to upper case or lower case.

BC53F705.name: Convert Game Text
BC53F705.hint: Look up the game string value for the specified string path.

AF39D31D.name: Convert Game Hotkey
AF39D31D.hint: Look up the game hotkey value for the specified string path.

3BB0CA58.name: Convert Game Asset
3BB0CA58.hint: Look up the game asset value for the specified string path.

C41602B8.name: Text With Color
C41602B8.hint: Encloses the text with a color formatting tag so it will use the given color.

A7AC2BC1.name: Set Text Expression Token
A7AC2BC1.hint: Assigns a text value to an arbitrary token for use in a text expression. Use the 'Main' preset value as the token to set the expression text itself. Use the function 'Text Expression' to evaluate the final text with all token values in place.

4A5FC206.name: Text Expression
4A5FC206.hint: Evalutes the given text expression with all token values in place. Token values may be set using 'Set Text Expression Token'.

3426739F.name: Get Selected Hero Talent Tree Column

EF99264E.name: Set Talents Enabled
EF99264E.hint: If the Talent system is disabled the talent selection UI will not be available.

E92CD46E.name: Set Talent Tree Selection Panel Dismiss Allowed
E92CD46E.hint: This prevents the player from being able to close the Talent Tree Selection Panel

F161CEC9.name: Triggering Upgrade
F161CEC9.hint: When 'Player Upgrade Changed' occurs, 'Triggering Upgrade' can be used to find out the the upgrade that changed.

81F49744.name: Trigger Upgrade Level Delta
81F49744.hint: When 'Player Upgrade Changed' occurs, 'Triggering Upgrade' can be used to find out the how many levels the upgrade get changed.

1F2B8F70.name: Player Upgrade Changed
1F2B8F70.hint: This event fires when the specified upgrade for the specified player change levels.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the player.  Use "Triggering Upgrade" to get the upgrade that changed. Use "Trigger Upgrade Level Delta" to get the upgrade that changed.

00000253.name: Behavior Count For Player
00000253.hint: Returns the count for the specified behavior that the specified player's units have.

00000252.name: Ability Count For Player
00000252.hint: Returns the count of the specified ability that the specified player's unit have.

00000254.name: Unit Count For Player
00000254.hint: Returns the number of units, of a specific unit type determined by the Unit parameter, owned by the chosen player.  The Count Type will determine what state the units must be in to be considered for this function.

0800076A.name: Unit Alias Count For Player
0800076A.hint: Returns the number of unit aliases, of a specific unit alias determined by the Unit parameter, owned by the chosen player.  The Count Type will determine what state the units must be in to be considered for this function.

00000255.name: Upgrade Count For Player
00000255.hint: Returns the count of the specified upgrade for the specified player.

00000260.name: Tech Tree Behavior Count For Unit
00000260.hint: Returns the count of the specified behavior for the specified unit.

00000261.name: Tech Tree Unit Count For Unit
00000261.hint: Returns the count of the specified type of unit at the specified unit.  This is useful for detecting how many units are in another unit's queue.

00000262.name: Tech Tree Upgrade Count For Unit
00000262.hint: Returns the count of the specified upgrade for the specified unit.

1FABC98B.name: Specific Requirements Are Enabled For Player
1FABC98B.hint: Returns true if a player has a specific tech tree requirement enabled.

FF56BC56.name: Enable/Disable SpecificTech Tree Requirements
FF56BC56.hint: Enables or disables a specific tech requirement for the specified player.

00000171.name: Allow/Disallow Behavior For Player
00000171.hint: Allows or disallows a behavior to be used by the specified player.  This is only useful if tech restrictions have been enabled using "Enable/Disable Tech Tree Restrictions".  If the behavior has a tech requirement, the requirement must still be met for the player to use the behavior.

0F7C3248.name: Allow/Disallow Ability For Player
0F7C3248.hint: Allows or disallows an ability to be used by the specified player.  This is only useful if tech restrictions have been enabled using "Enable/Disable Tech Tree Restrictions".  If the ability has a tech requirement, the requirement must still be met for the player to use the ability.

51A273F5.name: Allow/Disallow Unit For Player
51A273F5.hint: Allows or disallows a unit to be used by the specified player.  This is only useful if tech restrictions have been enabled using "Enable/Disable Tech Tree Restrictions".  If the unit has a tech requirement, the requirement must still be met for the player to use the unit.

0B0A4FBE.name: Allow/Disallow Upgrade For Player
0B0A4FBE.hint: Allows or disallows an upgrade to be used by the specified player.  This is only useful if tech restrictions have been enabled using "Enable/Disable Tech Tree Restrictions".  If the upgrade has a tech requirement, the requirement must still be met for the player to use the upgrade.

69CE5404.name: Ability Is Allowed For Player
69CE5404.hint: Returns true if an ability is allowed for the specified player.  Use "Allow/Disallow Ability For Player" to modify this.

00000173.name: Behavior Is Allowed For Player
00000173.hint: Returns true if a behavior is allowed for the specified player.  Use "Allow/Disallow Behavior For Player" to modify this.

DC0FD1CA.name: Unit Is Allowed For Player
DC0FD1CA.hint: Returns true if a unit is allowed for the specified player.  Use "Allow/Disallow Unit For Player" to modify this.

B0AF7420.name: Upgrade Is Allowed For Player
B0AF7420.hint: Returns true if an upgrade is allowed for the specified player.  Use "Allow/Disallow Upgrade For Player" to modify this.

00000158.name: Add Upgrade Level For Player
00000158.hint: Gives a player the specified number of levels of an upgrade.

9F8EF8FB.name: Set Upgrade Level For Player
9F8EF8FB.hint: Gives a player an upgrade to the level specified.

5FA21D64.name: Set Production Cap For Player
5FA21D64.hint: Use -1 to remove the cap of the production.

00000227.name: Enable/Disable Tech Tree Requirements
00000227.hint: Enables or disables all tech requirements for the specified player.

8D939E46.name: Requirements Are Enabled For Player
8D939E46.hint: Returns true if a player has tech tree requirements enabled.

12A2BFA8.name: Enable/Disable Tech Tree Restrictions
12A2BFA8.hint: Enables or disables all tech restrictions for the specified player.  When tech restrictions are enabled, then all ability commands that are flagged as Restricted or Suppressed will not show up on unit command cards in game.  Use "Allow/Disallow Ability For Player", "Allow/Disallow Behavior For Player", "Allow/Disallow Unit For Player", and "Allow/Disallow Upgrade For Player" to enable Restricted or Suppressed commands.  If a command is Restricted, then the ability, behavior, unit, or upgrade that is tied to it must be directly allowed.  If a command is Suppressed, however, then it may be enabled when something else is allowed.  For example, if the train Banshee command is Restricted, and the build Factory and build Starport commands are Suppressed, allowing the Banshee will also allow the Factory and Starport, because you cannot train a Banshee without first constructing those buildings.

0640F776.name: Restrictions Are Enabled For Player
0640F776.hint: Returns true if a player has tech tree restrictions enabled.

593FBAF8.name: Create Text Tag
593FBAF8.hint: Creates a text tag.  Use "Show/Hide Text Tag" to show the text tag. When Fog Of War enforcement is enabled, visibility is determined using the Black Mask by default. Use "Set Visibility Type Of Text Tag" to change this to full Fog Of War visibility, if desired.

00000477.name: Last Created Text Tag
00000477.hint: Returns the last text tag created using the "Create Text Tag" action.

00000482.name: Show/Hide Text Tag
00000482.hint: Shows or hides the specified text tag.

BE8E5192.name: Text Tag Is Visible
BE8E5192.hint: Returns true if the text tag is shown for a player.

00000483.name: Pause/Unpause Text Tag
00000483.hint: Pauses or unpauses any actions sent to the text tag.

00000480.name: Attach Text Tag To Unit
00000480.hint: Attaches a text tag to a unit at a certain height.

0B8B44C9.name: Attach Text Tag To Unit Attach Point
0B8B44C9.hint: Attaches a text tag to one of the unit's attachment points, this can also include an offset.

00000479.name: Set Position Of Text Tag
00000479.hint: Sets the position of the text tag from a point specified.

00000481.name: Set Velocity Of Text Tag
00000481.hint: Sets the speed at which a text tag will move at a particular angle per second.

4502CA5D.name: Set Text Of Text Tag
4502CA5D.hint: Sets or changes the text of a text tag that has already been created.

00000485.name: Set Time Of Text Tag
00000485.hint: Sets the duration for the text tag to appear.

118AFBB7.name: Set Alignment Of Text Tag
118AFBB7.hint: Sets the horizontal and vertical position of a text tag over its origin.  This also sets the text alignment within the tag.

F8AC8C36.name: Set Text Alignment Of Text Tag
F8AC8C36.hint: Sets the alignment of text within the text tag, without changing the tag position.  Note that any alignment set using "Set Alignment Of Text Tag" will override this action.

64ABC678.name: Set Background Border Size Of Text Tag
64ABC678.hint: Sets the size of the background of the text tag.

B7865A0A.name: Set Background Image Of Text Tag
B7865A0A.hint: Sets the image used as the background for the text tag.

3E74ECD1.name: Set Background Offset Of Text Tag
3E74ECD1.hint: Sets the offset of the background of the text tag.

1D8C9244.name: Set Edge Image Of Text Tag
1D8C9244.hint: Sets the image attached to the edge of the background image of this text tag.

00000484.name: Set Color Of Text Tag
00000484.hint: Sets the color of different parts of the text tag.

6A4E1C7A.name: Set Enforce Fog Of War Of Text Tag
6A4E1C7A.hint: Enables or disables fog of war enforcement for the specified text tag.

ACDC47E4.name: Set Visibility Type Of Text Tag
ACDC47E4.hint: Determines how visibility is determined based on fog of war for the text tag. This only takes effect when fog of war enforcement is enabled for the tag.

60AE2D46.name: Set Faded Transparency Of Text Tag
60AE2D46.hint: Sets the transparency of the text tag after it has fully faded out.

35285FED.name: Set Font Size Of Text Tag
35285FED.hint: Sets the font size of all text within in the text tag.

6194C084.name: Set Maximum Size Of Text Tag
6194C084.hint: Sets the maximum size of the specified text tag.

DD59EC03.name: Show/Hide Background For Text Tag
DD59EC03.hint: Shows or hides the background for a particular text tag.

98DD2F6E.name: Show/Hide Text Shadow For Text Tag
98DD2F6E.hint: Shows or hides the text shadows for a particular text tag.

688C8C8E.name: Set Score Timer
688C8C8E.hint: Sets Score timer used when sending a score report

BF7A3439.name: Time Elapsed
BF7A3439.hint: This event fires once the specified amount of time has passed in game.

6D565EB4.name: Periodic Event
6D565EB4.hint: This event fires periodically whenever the time specified elapses.

00000042.name: Start Timer
00000042.hint: Starts a timer, which will automatically count down from the given duration as the game runs.  A repeating timer will restart itself whenever it expires (reaches 0 remaining time).

7133B942.name: Last Started Timer
7133B942.hint: Returns the last timer started via a "Start Timer" action in the trigger.

00000043.name: Restart Timer
00000043.hint: Restarts the timer specified to it's original time.

5C9399D4.name: Stop Timer
5C9399D4.hint: Stops a timer, making its elapsed and remaining time 0.

00000194.name: Timer Is Paused
00000194.hint: Returns true if the timer has been paused.

00000047.name: Duration Of Timer
00000047.hint: Returns the duration left of the timer.

00000049.name: Timer Expires
00000049.hint: This event fires whenever the specified timer reaches zero.  This catches both one-shot and repeating timers.  Use the "Triggering Timer" function to refer to the expiring timer.

19ABD428.name: Triggering Timer
19ABD428.hint: Returns the timer that set off a trigger's "Timer Expires" event.

3FCF7471.name: Create Timer Window
3FCF7471.hint: Creates a new timer window for the timer.  After creation the timer window must be shown for it to appear.  Use "Show/Hide Timer Window" to show the window.

00000469.name: Last Created Timer Window
00000469.hint: Returns the last timer window created using the "Create Timer Window" action.

00000471.name: Show/Hide Timer Window
00000471.hint: Shows or hides the specified timer window.

59B2676D.name: Timer Window Is Visible
59B2676D.hint: Returns ture if the timer window is visible for the specified player.

46B37AA3.name: Anchor Timer Window
46B37AA3.hint: The timer window will be automatically positioned relative to the screen using the given anchor and offset.

0132CF73.name: Move Timer Window
0132CF73.hint: Moves the timer window to the specified screen position. The X coordinate corresponds to the right side of the timer window.

F5D626D2.name: Reset Timer Window Position
F5D626D2.hint: Moves the timer window to the default position along the right edge of the screen.

00000473.name: Set Title For Timer Window
00000473.hint: Sets the title text for the specified timer window.

00000472.name: Set Timer For Timer Window
00000472.hint: Sets the timer for the specified timer window.

00000474.name: Set Time Format For Timer Window
00000474.hint: Sets the time format for the specified timer.

A8D696A4.name: Set Style For Timer Window
A8D696A4.hint: Sets or changes the style of the specified timer window.

CBDA955C.name: Set Gap Width For Timer Window
CBDA955C.hint: Sets the width of the gap between the title and time text when using horizontal styles.

01DB37E9.name: Set Height For Timer Window
01DB37E9.hint: Sets the total height of the timer window. Use zero to reset to the default height.

00000475.name: Set Timer Window Color
00000475.hint: Sets the color and transparency for the specified timer window.

F8CE3E4B.name: Show/Hide Timer Window Border
F8CE3E4B.hint: Shows or hides the border image for a timer window.

C6215151.name: Show/Hide Timer Window Progress Bar
C6215151.hint: Shows a progress bar indicating elapsed or remaining time based on the window style. If the timer duration is Infinite, the bar will always be empty or full.

B4CAC0EE.name: Set Timer Window Progress Color
B4CAC0EE.hint: Sets the color for a progress bar within a timer window. If colors are set for multiple step values, the color will vary as the progress value increases, dividing each step equally across the full progress range.

8B93ABA7.name: Set Timer Window Image Type
8B93ABA7.hint: Sets the image type within a timer window. The image files may be customized in Assets.txt, under UI/TimerWindow.

00000045.name: Elapsed Time Of Timer
00000045.hint: Returns the amount of time that has elapsed for the specified timer.

00000046.name: Remaining Time Of Timer
00000046.hint: Returns the remaining amount of time left on the specified timer. Note that due to rounding limitations, the remaining time of an expired timer may be slightly negative rather than exactly zero. Make sure to check for less than or equal to zero to account for this.

00B542C6.name: Send Transmission For Player
00B542C6.hint: Sends a transmission with sound and an optional portrait actor to the specified players from a source unit or model.  Use "Last Sent Transmission" to refer to this transmission after it has begun.

1543037A.name: Send Transmission (Simple)
1543037A.hint: Sends a transmission with sound to all players from a source unit or model.  Uses speaker and subtitle data from conversation data.  Use "Last Sent Transmission" to refer to this transmission after it has begun.

FDD4A4BA.name: Last Sent Transmission
FDD4A4BA.hint: Returns the last transmission sent via triggers.  Use the "Send Transmission" or "Send Transmission (Simple)" action to send a transmission.

C3330C0E.name: Player Has Active Transmission
C3330C0E.hint: Returns whether any transmissions are active for the specified player.

95E0136A.name: Wait For Transmission
95E0136A.hint: Waits for the specified transmission to finish.

F14A27E9.name: Stop Transmission
F14A27E9.hint: Immediately stops a specific transmission that is currently playing / being sent.  Any triggers that are waiting for the transmission to finish will resume execution.

74A20203.name: Stop All Transmissions
74A20203.hint: Immediately stops all transmissions that are currently playing / being sent.  Any triggers that are waiting for such transmissions to finish will resume execution.

C99843E9.name: Stop Group Transmissions
C99843E9.hint: Immediately stops transmissions that are currently playing / being sent for a player group.  Any triggers that are waiting for such transmissions to finish will resume execution.

C752E622.name: Transmission Is Complete
C752E622.hint: Returns true if the transmission has completed playing, or false if it is still active.

6A8571AA.name: Turn Transmission Option On/Off
6A8571AA.hint: Adjust transmission options that will affect all future transmissions.

B71CCE8B.name: Transmission Comment (Sound)
B71CCE8B.hint: Used to display the speaker and subtitle text for a sound as a comment within the editor. Does not actually do anything.

8B09B461.name: Transmission Comment (Conversation)
8B09B461.hint: Used to display the speaker and subtitle text for a conversation line as a comment within the editor. Does not actually do anything.

ED236D9F.name: Unit Type Transmission Source
ED236D9F.hint: Applies a unit type as the transmission source for use in the transmission portrait.

63326FA7.name: Unit Transmission Source
63326FA7.hint: Applies a unit as the transmission source for use in the transmission portrait.

A2B4587F.name: Model Transmission Source
A2B4587F.hint: Applies a model as the transmission source for use in the transmission portrait.

8EE91657.name: Movie Transmission Source
8EE91657.hint: Applies a movie as the transmission source for use in the transmission portrait.

C551984B.name: No Transmission Source
C551984B.hint: Uses nothing as the transmission source.

05907BE5.name: Set Transmission Source Pause Allowed
05907BE5.hint: If the pause allowed flag is set to true and this transmission source is a movie, the movie can be paused.

DE6FA654.name: Set Transmission Source Streaming Allowed
DE6FA654.hint: If the streaming allowed flag is set to true and this transmission source is a movie, the movie can be streamed if its not local.

80967F7E.name: Set Transmission Source Bypass Message Log
80967F7E.hint: If the bypass message log flag is set to true then the text from this transmission will not be added to the message log.

7C3D2EC1.name: Send Transmission (Advanced) (Deprecated)
7C3D2EC1.hint: Sends a transmission with sound and an optional portrait actor to the specified players from a source unit or model.  Use "Last Sent Transmission" to refer to this transmission after it has begun.

3E151A17.name: Send Transmission (Deprecated)
3E151A17.hint: Sends a transmission with sound to the specified players from a source unit or model.  Use "Last Sent Transmission" to refer to this transmission after it has begun.

00000116.name: Run Trigger
00000116.hint: Executes the specified trigger.  If Trigger A calls "Run Trigger" to execute Trigger B, then Trigger A will not continue execution until either Trigger B returns, reaches the end of its actions, or reaches a "Wait" action.  If Trigger B has a "Wait" action, and the Wait parameter of "Run Trigger" was set to Don't Wait, then Trigger A will resume execution.  If the Wait parameter was set to Wait, then Trigger A will not resume execution until Trigger B has completed or returned.

D9049991.name: Run Trigger By Name
D9049991.hint: Executes the specified trigger.  If Trigger A calls "Run Trigger" to execute Trigger B, then Trigger A will not continue execution until either Trigger B returns, reaches the end of its actions, or reaches a "Wait" action.  If Trigger B has a "Wait" action, and the Wait parameter of "Run Trigger" was set to Don't Wait, then Trigger A will resume execution.  If the Wait parameter was set to Wait, then Trigger A will not resume execution until Trigger B has completed or returned.

698FE891.name: Stop Trigger
698FE891.hint: Kills all instances of the specified trigger that are currently running.

00000111.name: Turn Trigger On/Off
00000111.hint: Turning a trigger off will prevent it from responding to events.  A turned off trigger can still be run directly via a "Run Trigger" action.

00000112.name: Trigger Is On
00000112.hint: Returns true if a trigger is turned on.  Use the "Turn Trigger On/Off" action to turn a trigger on or off.

00000217.name: Current Trigger
00000217.hint: Returns the trigger that calls this action.

81F08ADC.name: Wait For Trigger
81F08ADC.hint: Waits until the specified trigger begins executing, and optionally waits until it has completed as well.

612A3F70.name: Current Trigger Thread SetFlags
612A3F70.hint: This is only used to set flags on the current galaxy thread so that the internal execution can know what type of thread is being executed.

00000410.name: Allow Trigger To Be Skipped
00000410.hint: Allows the current trigger to be skipped when the Required Count number of players hit the escape key.

E45431D8.name: Player Skips Trigger
E45431D8.hint: Occurs when a player attempts to skip a trigger with the Escape key, even if no other players skip it.

5870F9D1.name: Register Events
5870F9D1.hint: When used in a custom event definition, this associates one or more native events with the custom event. When used in a trigger, this dynamically registers new events with the trigger. Note that registering the same event with a trigger multiple times may cause it to execute multiple times in response to the event, so that should generally be avoided.

9B76E7C9.name: Send Generic Event
9B76E7C9.hint: Sends a generic trigger event which can be detected using Generic Event.

B1A02C2E.name: Generic Event
B1A02C2E.hint: Generic events are sent from triggers using the Send Generic Event action.

1ABFD783.name: Generic Event Parameter
1ABFD783.hint: Returns the name of a generic event parameter which can be used within the local data table to store or access event parameters. Store parameters in the table before calling Send Generic Event, and access them in response to the event.

346CD628.name: Triggering Event Name
346CD628.hint: Returns the name of the generic event in response to Generic Event.

561B0A1E.name: Triggering Trigger
561B0A1E.hint: Returns the trigger which was skipped in response to the Player Skips Trigger event.

CA944256.name: Trigger Active Count
CA944256.hint: Returns the number of instances of the specified trigger which are currently executing.

00000114.name: Trigger Execution Count
00000114.hint: Returns the number of times the specified trigger has been executed.

00000113.name: Trigger Evaluation Count
00000113.hint: Returns the number of times the specified trigger has had its conditions evaluated.

6E925AFA.name: Trigger Function Name
6E925AFA.hint: Returns the name of the script function defined for the given trigger.

00000115.name: Evaluate Trigger Conditions
00000115.hint: Tests a trigger's conditions and returns true if they passed.  This does not actually run the actions of the trigger.  Note that the trigger's event is not actually firing, so functions that normally respond to events, such as "Triggering Unit", will not be meaningful in the context of using this function to testing a trigger's conditions.

74DFFAD8.name: Add Actions To Action Queue
74DFFAD8.hint: Adds the specified actions to the Action Queue.  Unless the Action Queue has been paused, the Action Queue will immediately begin running through its actions as soon as it has some.  If there are already actions running in the queue, then new actions added to the queue will wait their turn, and the current trigger will be paused until the actions it added to the queue have executed.

FB4C094A.name: Pause/Unpause Action Queue
FB4C094A.hint: Pauses or unpauses the Action Queue.  Pausing the Action Queue does not pause actions within the trigger that is currently running in the queue, but will prevent actions in subsequent triggers from running until the queue is unpaused.

D1E6BE06.name: Clear Action Queue
D1E6BE06.hint: Clears all actions currently in the action queue.

00000342.name: Action Queue Is Empty
00000342.hint: Returns true if the action queue is empty.

95FF63B8.name: Set Hero Leader Panel Enabled
95FF63B8.hint: If the Hero Leader Panel system is disabled the UI will not be available.

6BEEB011.name: Set Resource Trade Countdown Time
6BEEB011.hint: Disables resource trading for the specified amount of time in seconds.

9B63D84D.name: Set Resource Trading Allowed
9B63D84D.hint: Allows or disallows resource trading for the specified Resource Type

C96CAF2B.name: Set Resource Trading Minor Step
C96CAF2B.hint: The minor step is the amount incremented by clicking the arrows in the Team Resource Panel

FD1B01FD.name: Set Resource Trading Major Step
FD1B01FD.hint: The major step is the amount incremented by clicking the arrows in the Team Resource Panel with the control key held down

38D03E80.name: Hot Key String
38D03E80.hint: Returns the localized text for a given hot key, such as "Alt + G"

0366EE04.name: Text Message
0366EE04.hint: Displays a text message in the specified area of the screen.

33E26C4B.name: Clear Text Messages
33E26C4B.hint: Clears all text messages currently displayed on the screen.

D3A3FDC0.name: Show Cinematic Text
