D3A3FDC0.hint: Displays the specified text in the cinematic text area using the specified parameters.

0667D7EF.name: Hide Cinematic Text
0667D7EF.hint: Hides all cinematic text that is currently displaying for the specified players.

CCA8EC70.name: Show Text Crawl
CCA8EC70.hint: Displays text that types out one character at a time over the specified duration.

2DFC944D.name: Hide Text Crawl
2DFC944D.hint: Hides text crawls that are currently displaying for the specified players.

9A2A3734.name: Key Pressed
9A2A3734.hint: Only register for this event when you absolutely need it, as it will generate network traffic from all players for every button they press.  This event fires when a player presses the specified key.  Use "Key Pressed" to get the key that was pressed.  Use "Alt Key Pressed", "Control Key Pressed", and "Shift Key Pressed" to find out what modifier keys were pressed.

7603DD9E.name: Hotkey Pressed
7603DD9E.hint: Only register for this event when you absolutely need it, as it will generate network traffic from all players for every hotkey they press.  This event fires when a player presses the specified hotkey. Use "HotKey Pressed" to get the hotkey that was pressed.<n/>WARNING: If code handles the hotkey press (for example, Army Select is pressed and code responds by selecting all army units), this event WILL NOT fire!

4537C855.name: Button Pressed
4537C855.hint: Only register for this event when you absolutely need it, as it will generate network traffic from all players for every button they press.  This event fires when a player presses a command card button.  Use "Button Pressed" to get the button that was pressed.

9C6C63CD.name: Mouse Clicked
9C6C63CD.hint: Only register for this event when you absolutely need it, as it will generate network traffic from all players for every mouse click they make.  This event fires when a player clicks a mouse button.  Use "Mouse Clicked Button" to get the button that was clicked.  Use "Mouse Clicked UI Pos X" and "Mouse Clicked UI Pos Y" to get the UI X,Y position where the player clicked the mouse.  Use "Mouse Clicked World Pos X", "Mouse Clicked World Pos Y", and "Mouse Clicked World Pos Z" to get the X,Y,Z world position where the player clicked the mouse.  Use "Alt Key Pressed", "Control Key Pressed", and "Shift Key Pressed" to find out what modifier keys were pressed.

A0A36942.name: Mouse Moved
A0A36942.hint: Only register for this event when you absolutely need it, as it will generate network traffic from all players for every mouse move they make.  This event fires when a player moves themouse.  Use "Mouse Moved UI Pos X" and "Mouse Moved UI Pos Y" to get the UI X,Y position where the player moved the mouse.  Use "Mouse Moved World Pos X", "Mouse Moved World Pos Y", and "Mouse Moved World Pos Z" to get the X,Y,Z world position where the player moved the mouse.

4EF11807.name: Mouse Wheel
4EF11807.hint: Only register for this event when you absolutely need it, as it will generate network traffic from all players for every mouse wheel move they make.  This event fires when a player moves the mouse wheel.  Use "Mouse Wheel Spin" to get the amount the mouse wheel moved.

A506FF54.name: Button Pressed
A506FF54.hint: Returns the button pressed.  Use in response to a "Button Pressed" event.

CCCD0A10.name: Key Pressed
CCCD0A10.hint: Returns the key pressed.  Use in response to a "Key Pressed" event.

86582BB2.name: Hotkey Pressed
86582BB2.hint: Returns the hotkey pressed.  Use in response to a "Hotkey Pressed" event.

274327C0.name: Control Key Pressed
274327C0.hint: Returns true if the control key was pressed.  Use in response to a "Key Pressed", "Mouse Clicked" or "Mouse Wheel" event.

A7C9E6B1.name: Alt Key Pressed
A7C9E6B1.hint: Returns true if the alt key was pressed.  Use in response to a "Key Pressed", "Mouse Clicked" or "Mouse Wheel" event.

DFB0AB0D.name: Shift Key Pressed
DFB0AB0D.hint: Returns true if the shift key was pressed.  Use in response to a "Key Pressed", "Mouse Clicked" or "Mouse Wheel" event.

58FBAD08.name: Mouse Clicked Button
58FBAD08.hint: Returns the mouse button clicked.  Use in response to a "Mouse Clicked" event.

43B3E049.name: Mouse Clicked UI Pos X
43B3E049.hint: Returns the mouse position clicked in the X axis.  Use in response to a "Mouse Clicked" event.

86F097AA.name: Mouse Clicked UI Pos Y
86F097AA.hint: Returns the mouse position clicked in the Y axis.  Use in response to a "Mouse Clicked" event.

D606E2CD.name: Mouse Clicked World Pos X
D606E2CD.hint: Returns the mouse position clicked in the X axis.  Use in response to a "Mouse Clicked" event.

451E6FB0.name: Mouse Clicked World Pos Y
451E6FB0.hint: Returns the mouse position clicked in the Y axis.  Use in response to a "Mouse Clicked" event.

4916AF3C.name: Mouse Clicked World Pos Z
4916AF3C.hint: Returns the mouse position clicked in the Z axis.  Use in response to a "Mouse Clicked" event.

177BC870.name: Mouse Moved UI Pos X
177BC870.hint: Returns the mouse position in the X axis.  Use in response to a "Mouse Moved" event.

48452E5F.name: Mouse Moved UI Pos Y
48452E5F.hint: Returns the mouse position in the Y axis.  Use in response to a "Mouse Moved" event.

D22038F6.name: Mouse Moved World Pos X
D22038F6.hint: Returns the mouse position in the X axis.  Use in response to a "Mouse Moved" event.

032677A8.name: Mouse Moved World Pos Y
032677A8.hint: Returns the mouse position in the Y axis.  Use in response to a "Mouse Moved" event.

3126BE7F.name: Mouse Moved World Pos Z
3126BE7F.hint: Returns the mouse position in the Z axis.  Use in response to a "Mouse Moved" event.

E194768D.name: Mouse Wheel Spin
E194768D.hint: Returns the number of mouse wheel clicks. The number may be fractional.  Use in response to a "Mouse Wheel" event.

9925F414.name: Display Boss Bar
9925F414.hint: Creates and shows a boss bar near the top of the screen.

76ECC716.name: Set Boss Bar Maximum Value
76ECC716.hint: Sets the maximum value for the specified boss bar.  Calling this action will overwrite the boss unit you set through "Set Boss Bar Boss", and will instead rely on the values sent to it through "Set Boss Bar Maximum Value" and "Set Boss Bar Current Value".

ED2C60CE.name: Set Boss Bar Current Value
ED2C60CE.hint: Sets the current value for the specified boss bar.  Calling this action will overwrite the boss unit you set through "Set Boss Bar Boss", and will instead rely on the values sent to it through "Set Boss Bar Maximum Value" and "Set Boss Bar Current Value".

F4F94B84.name: Set Boss Bar Boss
F4F94B84.hint: Sets the unit for the specified boss bar.  Calling this action will overwrite the maximum and current value you set through "Set Boss Bar Maximum Value" and "Set Boss Bar Current Value", and will instead base its value on the specified unit's HP.

231557AC.name: Set Boss Bar Race
231557AC.hint: Sets the race for the specified boss bar, which will change its appearance.

6B027921.name: Move Boss Bar
6B027921.hint: Moves the specified boss bar to the specified coordinates.

8A208EC7.name: Show/Hide Boss Bar
8A208EC7.hint: Shows or hides the specified boss bar.

A0768E88.name: Refresh Boss Bar
A0768E88.hint: Forces the boss bar to redraw.

8EDD3557.name: Set Screen Mode
8EDD3557.hint: Changes the screen mode for the player group over the duration specified.

951D3123.name: Set Minimum Letterbox Height
951D3123.hint: Changes the minimum height of the top and bottom black bars that appear during letterbox screen mode.

643E0E9C.name: Show/Hide Game UI
643E0E9C.hint: Shows or hides the entire game UI.  When shown, the UI will be set back to the visibility state of before it was hidden.

D8594765.name: Add/Remove UI Frame Type For Global Filter List
D8594765.hint: Adds or removes the frame type from a list of which UI frames will NOT be automatically hidden & restored during actions like Cinematic Mode and Show/Hide Game UI.

AE5AF605.name: Show/Hide UI Frame
AE5AF605.hint: Shows or hides the specified frame in the user interface.  Only Blizzard maps are allowed to hide the Battle UI frame.

7937AECA.name: Set BattleNet Button Offset
7937AECA.hint: Allows custom positioning of the BattleNet Button, relative to the bottom right corner of the screen.  Note that there is a "safe rect" constraint that prevents the button and friends list from being too far to the left or too far upwards.

1DD795D5.name: Clear BattleNet Button Offset
1DD795D5.hint: Clear the custom positioning of the BattleNet Button.  This will cause it to return to the default location

D155BA6B.name: UI Frame Is Visible
D155BA6B.hint: Returns true if the specified UI frame is visible for the specified player.

30ACF7AC.name: Show/Hide World
30ACF7AC.hint: Shows or hides the 3D game world for the players specified.

3F56BDA5.name: Show/Hide Achievement Panel
3F56BDA5.hint: Shows or hides the achievement panel for the specified players.

4333673D.name: Show/Hide Mouse Cursor
4333673D.hint: Shows or hides the mouse cursor for the specified players.

8D181A5F.name: Enable/Disable Mouse Cursor Auto Hide
8D181A5F.hint: Auto hide causes the mouse cursor to automatically be hidden if the user hasn't moved the cursor for a period of time.  The cursor will also automatically be shown whenever the cursor is moved.

8C4DB610.name: Enable/Disable Drag Selection
8C4DB610.hint: If drag selection is disabled, the selection box will no longer appear when left clicking and holding down the button while moving the mouse cursor

4AF8B1C6.name: Set Hot Key Profile
4AF8B1C6.hint: Sets a players hotkey profile, so long as they aren't using a custom profile.

00000420.name: Lock Ally Color Setting
00000420.hint: Locks the ally color setting that is selected for all players in the player group.

00000421.name: Unlock Ally Color Setting
00000421.hint: Unlocks ally color settings for the player group.

8D70E663.name: Lock Flyer Helper Display
8D70E663.hint: Locks the flyer helper display that is selected for all players in the player group.

8140F183.name: Unlock Flyer Helper Display
8140F183.hint: Unlocks flyer helper display for the player group.

DD650E92.name: Set Achievement Toast Style
DD650E92.hint: Sets the skin used for achievement toasts.

C9B85BF3.name: Show/Hide Minimap Camera Field of View
C9B85BF3.hint: Sets the minimap camera field of view visibility.

DA96E713.name: Set Minimap Bounds
DA96E713.hint: Sets the Minimap Bounds to the specified Region.

06D19175.name: Enable/Disable Command Type
06D19175.hint: Enables or disables certain types of interface commands.  Use the "Set Command Type Disabled Message" action to customize the message that is displayed when the player attempts to use commands disabled in this manner.

EA56A214.name: Turn Ability Highlight On/Off
EA56A214.hint: The buttons for a highlighted ability command are flashed in the user's command card UI.  If the ability command is contained in a sub-page, like one of the standard "build" commands, the button for the sub-page itself will also be highlighted.

5967E3C2.name: Turn Button Highlight On/Off
5967E3C2.hint: The selected button is flashed in the user's command card UI.  If the button is contained in a sub-page, like one of the standard "build" commands, the button for the sub-page itself will also be highlighted.

7CD40442.name: Set Command Type Disabled Message
7CD40442.hint: Specifies the message to be displayed to players when they attempt to use a command that has been disabled by the "Enable/Disable Command Type" action.

7161E16B.name: Enable/Disable Selection Type
7161E16B.hint: If a Selection Type is disabled the player may not use that Selection Type to change their selected unit(s).

0B3D8934.name: Set Targeting Order
0B3D8934.hint: Setting the unit group to a unit group other than "null" will enter targeting mode for the specified unit group even if they are not selected. This unit group must remain referenced until targeting is completed. Setting the order to "No Order" will end targeting mode. Setting the order as "sticky" will keep it active until canceled or another order is set.

EF83FDD4.name: Enable/Disable Hotkey
EF83FDD4.hint: Enables or disables a specific hotkey command.

F524C907.name: Last Created HelpItem
F524C907.hint: Returns the last created help item.

04120251.name: Display Help Page
04120251.hint: Shows the help panel set to the specified page for the specified players.

D2D484F9.name: Create Tip
D2D484F9.hint: Creates a tip that will display above the command card, and also adds the tip to the help panel.

F38744BA.name: Format Tip Title
F38744BA.hint: Returns the specified text string with some formatting added to it.

8961130D.name: Clear All Tip Alerts
8961130D.hint: Clears all currently displayed tip alerts.  Does not remove the tips themselves, which can still be viewed in the help panel.

E5FF78D8.name: Create Cheat
E5FF78D8.hint: Creates a tip on the help panel with a button that must be pressed in order for the description to be displayed.

9870E390.name: Create Tutorial
9870E390.hint: Creates a tutorial that will display above the command card, and also adds the tutorial to the help panel.

FE9383E0.name: Create Message Log Entry
FE9383E0.hint: Creates a new entry to the message log panel.  If speaker text and subtitle text are left blank they will be filled in with values from the sound link.

DF393ABA.name: Enable/Disable Help Panel Tech Tree Button
DF393ABA.hint: Enables or disables the tech tree button on the help panel for the specified players.

FA71311B.name: Enable/Disable Help Panel Tech Glossary Button
FA71311B.hint: Enables or disables the glossary button on the help panel for the specified players.

23FE04F5.name: Show/Hide Help Panel Tech Tree Race
23FE04F5.hint: Shows or hides a specific race's tech tree on the help panel.

34CD42EC.name: Show/Hide Help For Unit
34CD42EC.hint: Determines whether or not a unit type will show up in the help panel.

0D6A99D5.name: Set Help Panel Default Visibility
0D6A99D5.hint: Determines whether or not units show up in the help panel by default.  Use the "Show/Hide Help For Unit" action to show or hide individual unit types.

EFE15B3B.name: Set Help Item Darkened When Viewed
EFE15B3B.hint: Flags the specified help item to darken when it's marked as having been viewed by the player.

5609879F.name: Alert
5609879F.hint: Event that occurs when a player receives an alert.

7A544B3D.name: Create Alert At Point
7A544B3D.hint: Creates an alert with a spacebar point (point that the camera will jump to when the player presses the spacebar) at the target point displaying the custom alert text.

C97F59B9.name: Create Alert At Unit
C97F59B9.hint: Creates an alert with a spacebar point (point that the camera will jump to when the player presses the spacebar) at the target unit displaying the custom alert text.

51718A32.name: Create Alert With No Source
51718A32.hint: Creates an alert displaying the custom alert text.

9B013ED1.name: Clear Alerts
9B013ED1.hint: Clears all alerts and spacebar points for the specified player.

064BA8D5.name: Command Error
064BA8D5.hint: Event that occurs when a player recieves a command error.

44BB3417.name: Command Error Ability Command
44BB3417.hint: Returns the ability command that was being issued when the command error was hit.

D118DC34.name: Abort Mission
D118DC34.hint: This event fires when a player clicks the abort mission button.

CBC81630.name: Game Menu Item Selected
CBC81630.hint: This event fires when a player selects an item on the Game Menu Dialog.  Use "Game Menu Item Selected" to get the menu item that the player selected.

585EFA98.name: Game Menu Item Selected
585EFA98.hint: Returns the menu item a player selected from the game menu dialog.  Use in response to "Game Menu Item Selected".

9C868B9D.name: Set Game Menu Dialog Item Text
9C868B9D.hint: Sets the text of a specified menu item in the game menu.  Allows customization of the F10 menu.

AE579C3B.name: Set Game Menu Dialog Item Shortcut
AE579C3B.hint: Sets the shortcut keyboard key of a specified menu item in the game menu.  Allows customization of the F10 menu.

52711D8B.name: Show/Hide Game Menu Dialog Item
52711D8B.hint: Shows or hides the specified menu item in the game menu.  Allows customization of the F10 menu.

4A7F9FFE.name: Show Custom Menu
4A7F9FFE.hint: The Custom Menu is similiar in look and functionality to the Game Menu (F10 Menu).  However, the Custom Menu doesn't force items on or off based on the current state of the game.

D1448757.name: Set Custom Menu Dialog Item Text
D1448757.hint: Sets the text of a specified Menu Item in the Custom Menu.

9A2F6C43.name: Set Custom Menu Dialog Item Shortcut
9A2F6C43.hint: Sets the shortcut keyboard key of a specified Menu Item in the Custom Menu.

A3607EC8.name: Show/Hide Custom Menu Dialog Item
A3607EC8.hint: Shows or hides the specified Menu Item in the Custom Menu.

C7B2F062.name: Hide All Custom Menu Dialog Items
C7B2F062.hint: Hides all the Custom Menu dialog items.

8ACCD431.name: Custom Dialog Dismissed
8ACCD431.hint: This event fires when a player selects an option on the Custom Dialog.  Use "Custom Dialog Result" to get the option the player selected.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the player.

109B6B81.name: Custom Dialog Result
109B6B81.hint: Returns the custom dialog item a player selected.  Use in response to "Custom Dialog Dismissed".

8DF4D23C.name: Display Custom Dialog
8DF4D23C.hint: Displays a custom dialog.  Message Dialogs are informational only and will always have a result of yes.  Query dialogs provide the player with a yes or no option.

76E7054D.name: Set Next Movie
76E7054D.hint: The specified movie will play for the given players after the game finishes.

5954876C.name: Set Next Loading Screen
5954876C.hint: Creates the next loading screen if transitioning to a new map from the current one.

5C7238A8.name: Set Next Loading Screen Image Scale
5C7238A8.hint: Sets the next loading screen image scaling method if transitioning to a new map from the current one.

35E95E4D.name: Set Next Loading Screen Text Position
35E95E4D.hint: Adjusts the text position of the next loading screen if transitioning to a new map from the current one.

10C8F1C7.name: Set Restart Loading Screen Tip
10C8F1C7.hint: Sets the loading screen tip to use when restarting the current map.

14463CDD.name: Game Credits Finished
14463CDD.hint: Event is triggered when the end game credits finish rolling for the specified player.

C58C84B5.name: Challenge Mode
C58C84B5.hint: This action will only work for Blizzard maps.

0020B4C0.name: Set Challenge High Score
0020B4C0.hint: This action will only work for Blizzard maps.

DA6CA19C.name: Get Challenge High Score
DA6CA19C.hint: This action will only work for Blizzard maps.

8993E4EE.name: Set Challenge Score Text
8993E4EE.hint: This action will only work for Blizzard maps.

30C9D8A9.name: Set Challenge Completed
30C9D8A9.hint: This action will only work for Blizzard maps.

1017BD97.name: Create Path Display For Unit Type

D4D7CBDD.name: Get Path Display Line Tile Length

9203F453.name: Set Path Display Step Model Scale

BE61468D.name: Get Path Display Step Model Scale

3CF55EBF.name: Set Path Display Abil Class Filter

5B57CA27.name: Set Path Display Minimum Linear Distance
5B57CA27.hint: Linear distance is "as the crow flies" - it ignores all pathing obstacles.

55941BDF.name: Set Path Display Minimum Travel Distance
55941BDF.hint: Travel distance measures the accumulated separation between each turn on a path.

5F676AE0.name: Get Path Display Minimum Travel Distance
5F676AE0.hint: Travel distance measures the accumulated separation between each turn on a path.

2EB2DDB1.name: Set Path Display Minimum Turn Count

A734BA14.name: Get Path Display Minimum Turn Count

31DBC058.name: Unit Show Kill Display
31DBC058.hint: Used to turn on or off the kill counter shown when a unit is selected

F2DE967D.name: Unit Can Path To Point
F2DE967D.hint: This returns whether or not the unit can path to the specified point.

6CE05436.name: Unit Can Path To Unit
6CE05436.hint: This returns whether or not the unit can path to the specified unit.

F247156C.name: Create Units With Default Facing
F247156C.hint: Creates units using the default facing angle of the unit.  Use the "Last Created Unit" and "Last Created Units" functions to refer to the created units.

F20A0011.name: Create Units With Point Facing
F20A0011.hint: Creates units using the facing angle of a point.  Use the "Last Created Unit" and "Last Created Units" functions to refer to the created units.

6C39A0DF.name: Create Units Facing Angle
6C39A0DF.hint: Creates units facing a specified angle.  Use the "Last Created Unit" and "Last Created Units" functions to refer to the created units.

C835E90F.name: Create Units Facing Point
C835E90F.hint: Creates units facing a specified point.  Use the "Last Created Unit" and "Last Created Units" functions to refer to the created units.

00000076.name: Last Created Unit
00000076.hint: Returns the last unit created via a "Create Units" action.  This function ignores units created by other triggers.

00000141.name: Last Created Units
00000141.hint: Returns the last group of units created via a "Create Units" action.  This function ignores units created by other triggers.

E62014FA.name: Original Caster Of Unit
E62014FA.hint: Returns the unit caster that created this unit

7BB77F9D.name: Effect That Created Unit
7BB77F9D.hint: Returns the effect that created this unit

F5662180.name: Replace Unit
F5662180.hint: Use "Last Replaced Unit" to refer to the replacement unit.  Note that any variables referring to the old unit will need to be updated.

10EBC0A6.name: Last Replaced Unit
10EBC0A6.hint: Returns the last replacement unit created via "Replace Unit".

00000082.name: Change Owner
00000082.hint: Changes the ownership of a unit to another player.

FF16983A.name: Unit Owner Changes
FF16983A.hint: This event fires when thw owning player of a unit changes.  Use "Triggering Unit" to get the unit, and "Old Unit Owner" and "New Unit Owner" to get the old and new owners.

2EFFA9C5.name: Old Unit Owner
2EFFA9C5.hint: Returns the previous owner of a unit, when used in response to "Unit Owner Changes".

7CFC4EDA.name: New Unit Owner
7CFC4EDA.hint: Returns the new owner of a unit, when used in response to "Unit Owner Changes".

FA586BEC.name: Rescue Unit Group
FA586BEC.hint: Causes the units in a unit group to be rescued, changing ownership and changing or retaining color.

00000078.name: Remove Unit
00000078.hint: Removes a unit from the game.

00000081.name: Owner Of Unit
00000081.hint: Returns the owner of a unit.

00000216.name: Unit Is Alive
00000216.hint: Returns true if a unit is alive.

1A05F1CA.name: Unit Is Valid
1A05F1CA.hint: Returns true if a unit is valid.

0D42CF15.name: Unit Group Is Dead
0D42CF15.hint: Returns true if all units in the unit group are dead.  An empty unit group is considered to be dead.

0E8A5B30.name: Move Unit Instantly
0E8A5B30.hint: Moves a unit instantly to the specified point.  The Blend parameter causes the unit art to be interpolated between its old position and the new position over the duration of the next game loop.  Without blending, the unit art will instantly pop to the new location.

00000086.name: Make Unit Face Angle
00000086.hint: Makes a unit face a specified angle.

D5445D96.name: Make Unit Face Point
D5445D96.hint: Makes a unit face a specified point.

00000083.name: Position Of Unit
00000083.hint: Returns the position of a unit.

F4E5D65D.name: Goal Position Of Unit
F4E5D65D.hint: Returns the goal (target) position of a unit.

00000085.name: Facing Angle Of Unit
00000085.hint: Returns the facing angle of the unit.

00000388.name: Pause/Unpause All Units
00000388.hint: Pauses or unpauses all units on the map.

16D16133.name: Sleep/WakeUp Unit
16D16133.hint: Sleeps or wakes up the specified unit.

443F1CA3.name: Share Vision of Unit
443F1CA3.hint: Shares vision of a unit with another player.

8518EA3D.name: Unit Is Paused
8518EA3D.hint: Returns true if a unit is paused.

F68639E0.name: Unit Is Sleepiing
F68639E0.hint: Returns true if a unit is sleeping.

49A95989.name: Unit Is Hidden
49A95989.hint: Returns true if a unit is hidden.

007DF42C.name: Unit Is Visible To Player
007DF42C.hint: Returns true if the specified unit is visible to the specified player.

49392C74.name: Set Unit Custom Value
49392C74.hint: Sets a unit's custom value.  This is an arbitrary property that can be recalled using "Custom Value Of Unit".

82D826FA.name: Custom Value Of Unit
82D826FA.hint: Returns a custom value of a unit.

00000041.name: Unit Enters/Leaves Region
00000041.hint: This event fires when a unit enters or leaves a region.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the player that was controlling the unit.  Use "Triggering Region" to get the region that the unit either entered or left.  Use "Triggering Unit" to get the unit.

00000094.name: Triggering Region
00000094.hint: Returns the triggering region.  Use in response to "Unit Enters/Leaves Region".

E267A52A.name: Unit Enters/Leaves Point
E267A52A.hint: This event fires when a unit enters or leaves a certain distance around a point.  Use "Triggering Unit" to get the unit.

E54B2D20.name: Unit Enters/Leaves Range Of Unit
E54B2D20.hint: This event fires when a unit enters or leaves a distance around another unit.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the player that was controlling the unit.  Use "Triggering Unit" to get the unit.

B9E1327D.name: Triggering Range Unit
B9E1327D.hint: Returns the unit with which the triggering unit came in range. Used in response to Unit Enters/Leaves Range Of Unit.

22E8E351.name: Unit In Region
22E8E351.hint: Returns true if a unit is in the specified region.

4B2AE007.name: Agent Of Player For Unit
4B2AE007.hint: Returns the unit that is currently assigned as the specified player's purchasing agent for the specified shop unit.

4F04D443.name: Change Empty Unit Variables In Events
4F04D443.hint: When unit events refer to a unit variable, this option determines how empty values are treated. By default, empty unit variables are considered "any unit", and the event will fire for all units. This can be changed to "no unit", and the event will never fire if the variable is empty.

FF29FC7A.name: Name of Unit
FF29FC7A.hint: Returns the name of a specific unit. This function should be preferred if you wish to account for behavior-based name overrides rather than displaying the name of the unit type.

55BC29B4.name: Ideal Harvester Count
55BC29B4.hint: Returns the ideal harvester count for this unit. The recommended number of workers that should be harvesting to/from the given unit.

0350F5A4.name: Current Harvester Count
0350F5A4.hint: Returns the current harvester count for this unit. The number of workers that are harvesting to/from the given unit.

4CE7F001.name: Get Unit Damage Dealt Time
4CE7F001.hint: Returns time for how long it's been since the unit has dealt damage.

5E68F70D.name: Get Unit Damage Taken Time
5E68F70D.hint: Returns time for how long it's been since the unit has taken damage.

FC12F300.name: Weapon Used In Attack
FC12F300.hint: Returns the weapon that was used.  Used in response to "Unit Starts Attacking" and "Unit Is Attacked".

F7A67C8E.name: Item Used In Attack
F7A67C8E.hint: Returns the item that was used.  Used in response to "Unit Dies" and "Unit Takes Damage".

23D22D79.name: Item Type Used In Attack
23D22D79.hint: Returns the item type that was used.  Used in response to "Unit Dies" and "Unit Takes Damage".

00000090.name: Unit Dies
00000090.hint: This event fires when a unit dies.  Use "Damage Source Position" to get the position of the unit that dealt the killing blow.  Use "Killing Player" to get the owner of the unit that dealt the killing blow.  Use "Killing Unit" to get the unit that dealt the killing blow.  Use "Triggering Death Type Check" to get the death type.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the owner of the unit that died.  Use "Triggering Unit" to get the unit that died.  Use "Experience Level Of Unit" to get the experience level of the unit that died.  Use "Total Experience Of Unit" to get the total number of experience points the unit had before it died.

00000243.name: Triggering Death Type Check
00000243.hint: Returns true if a unit is dying from a given type/cause of death.  Use this in response to a "Unit Dies" event.

3DC1F123.name: Unit Is Being Removed
3DC1F123.hint: This event fires when a unit is removed from the game.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the owner of the unit.  Use "Triggering Unit" to get the unit.

B81FF416.name: Unit Starts Attacking (Deprecated)
B81FF416.hint: This event fires when a unit starts attacking.  Use "Attacking Unit" or "Triggering Unit" to get the attacker.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the owner of the attacker.

2BC92977.name: Unit Starts Attacking
2BC92977.hint: This event fires when a unit starts attacking.  Use "Attacking Unit" or "Triggering Unit" to get the attacker.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the owner of the attacker.

721F018F.name: Unit Is Attacked (Deprecated)
721F018F.hint: This event fires when a unit is attacked.  Use "Attacking Unit" to refer to the unit performing the attack.  Use "Triggering Unit" to refer to the unit being attacked.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the owner of the unit being attacked.

D10A3CBB.name: Unit Is Attacked
D10A3CBB.hint: This event fires when a unit is attacked.  Use "Attacking Unit" to refer to the unit performing the attack.  Use "Triggering Unit" to refer to the unit being attacked.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the owner of the unit being attacked.

4ACABF10.name: Attacking Unit
4ACABF10.hint: When called in response to a "Unit Is Attacked" event, this refers to the unit performing the attack.

6D5C96AC.name: Unit Absorbs Damage
6D5C96AC.hint: This event fires when a unit absorbs damage due to a behavior damage response.  Use "Triggering Unit" to get the unit that absorbed damage.  Use "Triggering Behavior" to get the behavior that absorbed damage on the unit.  Use "Triggering Damage Absorbed" to get the amount of damage absorbed.  Use "Damaging Unit" and "Damaging Player" to get the unit and player that caused the damage.  Use "Damaging Effect" to get the effect that caused the damage.

5C010D48.name: Unit Takes Damage
5C010D48.hint: This event fires when a unit takes damage.  Use "Damage Source Position" to get the position of the damage source.  Use "Damaging Player" to get the owner of the unit that is dealing damage.  Use "Damaging Unit" to get the unit that is dealing damage.  Use "Triggering Damage Amount" to get the amount of damage being dealt.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the owner of the unit that is taking damage.  Use "Triggering Unit" to get the unit that is taking damage.

00000098.name: Triggering Damage Taken
00000098.hint: Returns the triggering damage amount, excluding damage absorbed by damage modification behaviors.

C3E29B47.name: Triggering Damage Attempted
C3E29B47.hint: Returns the triggering damage amount attempted.  This is the damage done before clamping against the amount of life the target unit has.  Not modified by damage responses.

FECF5F24.name: Triggering Damage Attempted Vitals
FECF5F24.hint: Returns the triggering damage amount attempted to vitals.  This is the damage done before clamping against the amount of life the target unit has.  Modified by damage responses.

98DA6AD1.name: Triggering Damage Absorbed
98DA6AD1.hint: Returns the triggering damage amount, including damage absorbed by damage modification behaviors.

3E5CC42D.name: Triggering Damage Behavior Shield
3E5CC42D.hint: Returns the triggering damage amount absorbed by behavior shields (Damage Response Modify Limit)

7A2BE368.name: Triggering Vitals Leeched
7A2BE368.hint: Returns the vitals leeched by the damaging unit.

1BD6D194.name: Triggering Unit Kill XP
1BD6D194.hint: Returns the kill XP value of the triggering unit.

00000101.name: Damage Source Position
00000101.hint: Returns the damage source position or where the unit who is dealing damage is standing at.

3E814E10.name: Unit is Healed
3E814E10.hint: This event fires when a unit is healed through effects. Use "Healing Unit" to get the unit casting the heal.  Use "Healing Player" to get the owner of the unit that is dealing damage. Use "Triggering Heal Given" to get the amount healed. Use "Triggering Heal Vital Type" to get the vital type that was healed. Use "Triggering Player" to get the owner of the unit that is healed. Use "Triggering Unit" to get the unit that is healed.

5D86D199.name: Triggering Heal Vital Type
5D86D199.hint: Returns the triggering heal vital type.

E0DF688F.name: Acquired Target
E0DF688F.hint: Returns the acquired target of a unit.

565520E9.name: Unit Is Revived
565520E9.hint: This event fires when a unit is revived.  Use "Triggering Unit" to get the unit that was revived.

61F48E33.name: Triggering Item Used
61F48E33.hint: Returns the item used in the event.  Used in response to "Unit Gains Experience".

B3949D45.name: Triggering Effect Used
B3949D45.hint: Returns the effect used.  Used in response to "Unit Gains Experience".

00000089.name: Issue Order
00000089.hint: Issues an order to a unit.

00000108.name: Issue Order To Unit Group
00000108.hint: Issues an order to all the units in the specified unit group.

CD2C7578.name: Unit Order Count
CD2C7578.hint: Returns the count of orders on a unit.

1C5B0649.name: Unit Order
1C5B0649.hint: Returns an order for a unit.

4BF769E7.name: Unit Order Is Acquired
4BF769E7.hint: Returns true if the unit's indexed order has been acquired rather than issued explicitly.

FD4B3BB0.name: Unit Has Order With Ability
FD4B3BB0.hint: Returns true if the unit has an order at any index with the ability

6D29DCBA.name: Unit Is Issued Order
6D29DCBA.hint: This event fires when a unit is issued an order.  Use "Triggering Order" to get the order.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the player that issued the order.  Use "Triggering Unit" to get the unit that was issued the order.

44545BCD.name: Unit Becomes Idle
44545BCD.hint: This event fires when a unit becomes or stops idling.

31D7ABB2.name: Wait Until Unit Becomes Idle
31D7ABB2.hint: Waits until a unit either becomes idle or discontinues being idle, depending on the Idle parameter.

04955B8F.name: Wait Until Unit Group Becomes Idle
04955B8F.hint: Waits until all the units in a unit group either becomes idle or discontinues being idle, depending on the Idle parameter.

F4ED4CD8.name: Unit Rally Point Count
F4ED4CD8.hint: Returns the number of rally points a unit has.

8AD76FFF.name: Unit Rally Point Target Count
8AD76FFF.hint: Returns the rally point target count of a unit.

3411EE1A.name: Unit Rally Point Target Point
3411EE1A.hint: Returns the the target point of a rally point.

E4BD0151.name: Unit Rally Point Target Unit
E4BD0151.hint: Returns the target unit of a rally point.

7E8105DE.name: Unit Order Get Progress
7E8105DE.hint: Get the progress of the current order for the given unit.

00000079.name: Unit Type Of Unit
00000079.hint: Returns the unit type for the specified unit.

AF2CDB5E.name: Unit Tag
AF2CDB5E.hint: A unit's tag is a unique integer associated with that unit. The tag will never change and will never be associated with a different unit.

1DE1CB2A.name: Unit Property Changes
1DE1CB2A.hint: This event fires when a unit's property changes.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the owner of the unit whose property changed.  Use "Triggering Unit" to get the unit whose property changed.

68CDC79B.name: Triggering Unit Property
68CDC79B.hint: Returns the triggering unit property in response to "Unit Property Changes" events.

ABFA76F7.name: Triggering Unit Property Change (Integer)
ABFA76F7.hint: Returns the triggering unit property change in response to "Unit Property Changes" events.

AF08AFB4.name: Triggering Unit Property Change (Real)
AF08AFB4.hint: Returns the triggering unit property change in response to "Unit Property Changes" events.

02FA0FB6.name: Make Unit Uncommandable
02FA0FB6.hint: Makes a unit commandable or uncommandable.

00000191.name: Unit Classification Check
00000191.hint: Returns true if a unit is a specific class type.

A6058F5C.name: Unit Type Classification Check
A6058F5C.hint: Returns true if the specified unit type has the specified flag.

7A0CB31F.name: Unit Type Attribute Check
7A0CB31F.hint: Returns true if the unit has the specified attribute.

00000335.name: Unit Targetable Check
00000335.hint: Returns true if a unit is targetable.

EE7AB1E8.name: Unit Is Invulnerable
EE7AB1E8.hint: Returns true if a unit is invulnerable.

6D10EF52.name: Unit Kills
6D10EF52.hint: Returns the amount of kills a unit possesses.

05917C7C.name: Unit Resources
05917C7C.hint: Returns the amount of resources a unit has.

E00E7137.name: Unit Attachment Point
E00E7137.hint: Returns the current position of a unit attachment point.

4C8D7F8C.name: Name Of Unit Type
4C8D7F8C.hint: Returns the name of a unit type.

98274AAB.name: Gender Code Of Unit Type
98274AAB.hint: Returns the gender code of a unit type for use within language rules for localized text.

DD095653.name: Unit Type Cost
DD095653.hint: Returns the cost of a unit type.

492B580C.name: Unit Type Is Affected By Upgrade
492B580C.hint: Returns true if the specified unit type is listed in the specified upgrade's affected unit array.

70AC193B.name: Reset Movement Speed
70AC193B.hint: Resets the maximum speed value for a unit.

00000149.name: Unit Uses Mover
00000149.hint: Returns true if a unit uses the specified mover.

E90538F1.name: Unit Type Uses Mover
E90538F1.hint: Returns true if a unit type uses the specified mover.

A0CD12F3.name: Unit Type From String
A0CD12F3.hint: Converts a string to a unit type.  If the string does not match a valid unit type, the result will be empty.

A14A2FA0.name: Set Unit Info Button - Ability Tooltip
A14A2FA0.hint: Sets the info text for the specified unit.

178CE7C2.name: Set Unit Info Button - Button Tooltip
178CE7C2.hint: Sets the info text for the specified unit.

3A57DDE5.name: Set Unit Info Button - Item Tooltip
3A57DDE5.hint: Sets the tooltip text for the specified item.

913EDE3A.name: Reset Unit Info Button - Ability Tooltip
913EDE3A.hint: Sets the info text for the specified unit.

D1F8F338.name: Reset Unit Info Button - Button Tooltip
D1F8F338.hint: Sets the info text for the specified unit.

0A37213A.name: Reset Unit Info Button - Item Tooltip
0A37213A.hint: Sets the info text for the specified unit.

CA642D45.name: Set Unit Command Button Tooltip
CA642D45.hint: Sets the info text for the specified unit.

7D13FE06.name: Reset Unit Command Button Tooltip
7D13FE06.hint: Sets the info text for the specified unit.

6710855E.name: Set Unit Highlight Cursor
6710855E.hint: Sets the highlight cursor for the specified unit.

02B2BBC6.name: Set Unit Info
02B2BBC6.hint: Sets the info text for the specified unit.

F6DFE3E7.name: Set Unit Info Text
F6DFE3E7.hint: Sets the info text for the specified unit without modifying the tip or subtip.

2919EF94.name: Set Unit Info SubTip
2919EF94.hint: Sets the info subtip for the specified unit without modifying the tip or text.

F116F8F1.name: Clear Unit Info
F116F8F1.hint: Clears the info text for the specified unit.

6D097F01.name: Set Unit Status Bar State (Deprecated)
6D097F01.hint: Forces the status bar on or off for the specified unit.

15DDAB3C.name: Hide Unit Status Bar
15DDAB3C.hint: If the game setting for unit status bar display is Always, this function doesn't work.

07C44396.name: Set Unit Model Variation
07C44396.hint: Changes a unit's model to the specified model with the specified variation and can alter the textures with the specified texture props string.

B9B1D01B.name: Height Of Unit
B9B1D01B.hint: Returns the height of the specified unit.

FF9944FC.name: Change Unit Damage
FF9944FC.hint: Modifies the amount of damage a unit deals or takes.  Minimal means 10% damage.  Mega means 300% damage.

E9D2B243.name: Add On Child
E9D2B243.hint: Returns an add on unit attached to the provided parent

2F7FDD5C.name: Add On Parent
2F7FDD5C.hint: Returns the add on parent of the specified child unit.

390C5C49.name: Unit Filter Match
390C5C49.hint: Returns true if the specified unit matches the specified filter criteria from the perspective of the specified player.

00000357.name: Set State Of Unit Filter
00000357.hint: Sets a state on the specified unit filter.

00000358.name: State Of Unit Filter
00000358.hint: Returns the state of the specified index of the specified unit filter.

3C562CE8.name: Convert Target Filter String To Unit Filter
3C562CE8.hint: Takes a target filter string (obtained from the catalog) and returns a unit filter.

0C7C13FA.name: Create Cargo Units
0C7C13FA.hint: Creates cargo units inside a unit's cargo bay.  Use the "Last Created Cargo Unit" and "Last Created Cargo Units" functions to refer to the created units.

FEEC5BBE.name: Last Created Cargo Unit
FEEC5BBE.hint: Returns the last unit created via the "Create Cargo Units" action.  This function ignores units created by other triggers.

D2239866.name: Last Created Cargo Units
D2239866.hint: Returns the last group of units created via the "Create Cargo Units" action.  This function ignores units created by other triggers.

0D7C0352.name: Unit Is Cargo
0D7C0352.hint: Returns true if the specified unit is considered a cargo unit.

F512F82A.name: Unit Is Inside Unit Transport
F512F82A.hint: Returns true if the specified unit is inside another unit.

348CCDBA.name: Unit Is Inside Player Transport
348CCDBA.hint: Returns true if the specified unit is inside a player-wide transport (e.g., a Nydus network).

00000230.name: Cargo Unit In Transport
00000230.hint: Returns the unit at the specified index in the specified unit's cargo hold.

00000233.name: Cargo Units In Transport
00000233.hint: Returns a unit group with all the units in the specified unit's cargo hold.

0E513B33.name: Transport Property Of Unit
0E513B33.hint: Returns the specified property for the specified unit.

F7013450.name: Transport Of Unit
F7013450.hint: Returns the transport a unit is in.

00000208.name: Unit Loads/Unloads Cargo
00000208.hint: This event fires when a unit loads or unloads cargo.  Use "Triggering Cargo Unit" to get the unit that was loaded or unloaded.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the owner of the transport unit.  Use "Triggering Unit" to get the transport unit.

00000209.name: Triggering Cargo Unit
00000209.hint: Returns the triggering cargo unit.  Used in response to a "Unit Loads/Unloads Cargo" event.

544A98EF.name: Create Inventory Item
544A98EF.hint: Creaters an item in a unit's inventory.  Use the "Last Created Inventory Item" function to refer to the created item.

075C97E3.name: Last Created Inventory Item
075C97E3.hint: Returns the last item created via the "Create Inventory Item" action.  This function ignores items created by other triggers.

B4BEBD9E.name: Inventory Item Carried
B4BEBD9E.hint: Returns a specific inventory item carried by the unit.

F2BC8E79.name: Inventory Item Carrier
F2BC8E79.hint: Returns the unit that is currently carrying the specified inventory item.

1BC52DDD.name: Inventory Item Container
1BC52DDD.hint: Returns the container index that the specified inventory item is stored in.

DF56EA04.name: Inventory Item Slot
DF56EA04.hint: Returns the slot index for the specified inventory item.

54051DA3.name: Inventory Item Index
54051DA3.hint: Returns the internal index for the specified inventory item.

B4F0E8F8.name: Inventory Item Count
B4F0E8F8.hint: Returns the inventory item count for the specified unit.

B7CC6780.name: Inventory Items Carried
B7CC6780.hint: Returns a unit group containing all items carried by the specified unit.

A4FBCE8E.name: Move Inventory Item
A4FBCE8E.hint: Moves an inventory to the specified slot in the specified container.

52B99407.name: Unit Acquires Powerup
52B99407.hint: This event fires when a unit acquires a powerup.  Use "Triggering Powerup" to get the powerup.

F27365D4.name: Triggering Powerup
F27365D4.hint: Returns the triggering powerup.  Used in response to "Unit Acquires Powerup".

4766099B.name: Unit Manipulates Inventory
4766099B.hint: This event fires when a unit performs the specified action on the specified inventory item.  Use "Triggering Inventory Item" to get the inventory item, "Triggering Inventory Item Container" to get the container the item resides in, "Triggering Inventory Item Slot" to get the slot the item occupies, "Triggering Inventory Item Target Point" to get the point targeted by the action, and "Triggering Inventory Item Target Unit" to get the unit targeted by the action.

835EFAFB.name: Triggering Inventory Manipulation
835EFAFB.hint: Returns the inventory manipulation type that triggered this event.

D0EBBB91.name: Triggering Inventory Item
D0EBBB91.hint: Returns the triggering inventory item.  Used in response to "Unit Manipulates Inventory".

B94C6E96.name: Triggering Inventory Item Container
B94C6E96.hint: Returns the triggering inventory item's container.  Used in response to "Unit Manipulates Inventory".

D613946A.name: Triggering Inventory Item Slot
D613946A.hint: Returns the triggering inventory item's slot.  Used in response to "Unit Manipulates Inventory".

C211B081.name: Triggering Inventory Item Target Point
C211B081.hint: Returns the point targeted by the action that caused the "Unit Manipulates Inventory" event to fire.

A3ADDDEE.name: Triggering Inventory Item Target Unit
A3ADDDEE.hint: Returns the unit targeted by the action that caused the "Unit Manipulates Inventory" event to fire.

843B0E58.name: Remove Weapon From Unit
843B0E58.hint: Removes the specified weapon from the specified unit.

CE396866.name: Add Weapon To Unit
CE396866.hint: Adds the specified weapon to the specified unit using the specified turret.

7045D649.name: Number Of Weapons On Unit
7045D649.hint: Returns the number of weapons on a unit.

E8D948E0.name: Unit Weapon
E8D948E0.hint: Returns the weapon at the specified index on the specified unit.

981AB385.name: Weapon Is Enabled
981AB385.hint: Returns true if a weapon is enabled for a unit.

2E6C3EA6.name: Weapon Target Check
2E6C3EA6.hint: Returns true if a unit weapon can target a specific target.

CE962B10.name: Weapon Cooldown Remaining
CE962B10.hint: Returns a unit's remaining weapon cooldown.

9DBAA1BE.name: Add Ammo To Magazine
9DBAA1BE.hint: Adds rounds of ammo to a magazine. (Example: Adds x Interceptors to a Carrier's bay.)

10A82307.name: Last Created Magazine Ammo Unit
10A82307.hint: Returns the last unit created via the "Add Ammo To Magazine" action.  This function ignores units created by other triggers.

5E302B9D.name: Last Created Magazine Ammo Units
5E302B9D.hint: Returns the last group of units created via the "Add Ammo To Magazine" action.  This function ignores units created by other triggers.

00000211.name: Magazine Count Of Unit
00000211.hint: Returns the number of rounds in an ability magazine for a unit.

2263B76C.name: Unit Can Attack Unit Type
2263B76C.hint: Returns true if the specified unit has an enabled weapon with target filters that match the specified target unit type.

C191F300.name: Unit In Range And Able To Attack Target
C191F300.hint: Returns true if the specified unit is in range and currently able to attack the given target. This function does not factor in is weapon cooldowns.

A4E0AE63.name: Set Weapon Cooldown Remaining
A4E0AE63.hint: Set the remaining cooldown to 0 to let the weapon fire as soon as possible.

69D0B7FE.name: Unit Gains Experience
69D0B7FE.hint: This event fires when a unit gains experience.  Use "Triggering Behavior" to get the behavior.  Use "Triggering Experience Gained" to get the amount of experience.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the owner of the unit that gained experience.  Use "Triggering Unit" to get the unit that gained experience.

58A61D51.name: Unit Gains Experience Level
58A61D51.hint: This event fires when a unit gains an experience level.  Use "Triggering Behavior" to get the behavior.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the owner of the unit that gained a level.  Use "Triggering Unit" to get the unit that gained a level.

1DC3411C.name: Unit XP Get Current XP
1DC3411C.hint: Returns the current xp of a unit

9B8C2BCE.name: Unit XP Add XP
9B8C2BCE.hint: Adds XP to the current unit

398A6E5C.name: Unit XP Set Current XP
398A6E5C.hint: Sets the current xp of a unit

8E739839.name: Unit XP Get XP For Level
8E739839.hint: Returns the total xp required for a specific level

F712D7BE.name: Unit XP Set XP For Level
F712D7BE.hint: Sets the required xp for a specific level

6C7EDC40.name: Unit XP Get Current Level
6C7EDC40.hint: Returns the current level of a unit

CE1D487E.name: Unit XP Set Current Level
CE1D487E.hint: Sets the current level of a unit

925849D7.name: Unit XP Get Num Levels
925849D7.hint: Returns the number of levels available for a unit

00000353.name: Triggering Experience Gained
00000353.hint: Returns the triggering experience gained.  Used in response to "Unit Gains Experience".

456ED0A9.name: Unit Attribute Change
456ED0A9.hint: This event fires when a unit's attribute points change.  Use "Triggering Attribute Points" to get the number of attribute points.  Use "Triggering Behavior" to get the behavior.

22EA61EC.name: Triggering Attribute Points
22EA61EC.hint: Returns the triggering attribute points.  Used in response to "Unit Attribute Change".

00000354.name: Total Experience Of Unit
00000354.hint: Returns the total experience a unit possesses.

00000352.name: Experience Level Of Unit
00000352.hint: Returns the experience value of a unit.

00000390.name: Enable/Disable Experience Gain For Unit
00000390.hint: Enables or disables experience gain for the specified unit.

25FDDB2A.name: Set Unit Progress
25FDDB2A.hint: Sets a unit's build/train/etc. progress to a percentage of total completion.  This works for training, research, magazine ammo, building construction, add-on construction, and warp-in.  This does not work for morphs or specializations.

A05A9417.name: Unit Progress (Percent)
A05A9417.hint: Returns the unit progress in a training slot.

D674ADD7.name: Pause/Resume/Cancel Unit Progress Bar
D674ADD7.hint: Stops the construction progress bar of a unit.

1D771D8A.name: Unit Progress Bar Check
1D771D8A.hint: Returns true if a unit progress bar is at a certain state.

264BD339.name: Unit Is Under Construction
264BD339.hint: Returns true if a unit is under construction.  This function does not work for dead units.

8ACFE903.name: Unit Arming Progress
8ACFE903.hint: This event fires when a unit's arming progress reaches a certain stage.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the player that triggered the arm ability.  Use "Triggering Unit" to get the arming unit.  Use "Triggering Progress Unit Type" to get the unit type of the unit in the queue.  Use "Triggering Progress Unit" to get the unit in the queue.

B0FA20B6.name: Unit Construction Progress
B0FA20B6.hint: This event fires when a unit's construction stage reaches a certain progress.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the player that triggered construction.  Use "Triggering Unit" to get the unit that is doing the constructing.  Use "Triggering Progress Unit Type" to get the unit type of the unit that is under construction.  Use "Triggering Progress Unit" to get the unit that is under construction.

559B4BE2.name: Unit Learn Progress
559B4BE2.hint: This event fires when a unit's learning stage reaches a certain progress.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the player that triggered construction.  Use "Triggering Unit" to get the unit that is doing the learning. Use "Triggering Progress Ability" to get the ability being learned.

D8B5FD69.name: Unit Research Progress
D8B5FD69.hint: This event fires when a unit's research progress reaches a certain point.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the player that started the research.  Use "Triggering Unit" to get the unit that is doing the research.  Use "Triggering Progress Upgrade" to get the upgrade being researched.

008A1B94.name: Unit Revive Progress
008A1B94.hint: This event fires when a unit's revive progress reaches a certain stage.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the player that started the revive.  Use "Triggering Unit" to get the unit doing the reviving.  Use "Triggering Progress Unit Type" to get the unit type of the unit being revived.  Use "Triggering Progress Unit" to get the unit being revived.

0C94C58C.name: Unit Specialization Progress
0C94C58C.hint: This event fires when the unit's specialization progress reaches a specified point.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the player that started the specialization.  Use "Triggering Progress Effect" to get the effect that will run when specialization completes.  Use "Triggering Unit" to get the unit doing the specializing.

82E80323.name: Unit Training Progress
82E80323.hint: This event fires when a unit's training progress reaches a certain stage.  Use "Triggering Player" to get the player that started the training.  Use "Triggering Unit" to get the unit doing the training.  Use "Triggering Progress Unit Type" to get the unit type of the unit being trained.  Use "Triggering Progress Unit" to get the unit being trained.

0489C434.name: Triggering Progress Ability
0489C434.hint: Returns the triggering progress ability.  Use in response to "Unit Learn Progress".

00000269.name: Triggering Progress Effect
00000269.hint: Returns the triggering progress effect.  Use in response to "Unit Specialization Progress".

00000419.name: Triggering Progress Unit
00000419.hint: Returns the triggering progress unit.  Used in response to "Unit Arming Progress", "Unit Construction Progress", "Unit Learn Progress", "Unit Research Progress", "Unit Revive Progress", "Unit Specialization Progress", or "Unit Training Progress".

00000271.name: Triggering Progress Unit Type
00000271.hint: Returns the triggering progress unit type.  Used in response to "Unit Arming Progress", "Unit Construction Progress", or "Unit Training Progress".

00000270.name: Triggering Progress Upgrade
00000270.hint: Returns the triggering progress upgrade.  Used in response to "Unit Research Progress".

00000398.name: Number Of Items In Training Queue Slot
00000398.hint: Returns the number of items in the specified training queue slot.

A813DBCB.name: Queued Object In Training Queue Slot

51E35D58.name: Queued Behavior Type In Training Queue Slot
51E35D58.hint: Returns the behavior type of a unit in a specific training slot.

B97B1F15.name: Queued Upgrade Type In Training Queue Slot
B97B1F15.hint: Returns the type of a unit in a specific training slot.

44C0972D.name: Training Queue Property Of Unit
44C0972D.hint: Returns the training queue property of a unit.

00000402.name: Training Queue Slot Type Check
00000402.hint: Returns true if a unit in training is training in the specified slot.

0130ACAD.name: Training Queue Time
0130ACAD.hint: Returns the training queue time for the unit in the specified training slot.

B20BC13F.name: Remove Charge Regen Time For Unit Behavior (Deprecated)
B20BC13F.hint: Clears the amount of time it takes to regenerate the specified behavior charge link.

9C41471B.name: Remove Charge Regen Time For Unit Ability (Deprecated)
